  <canvas id="canvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>

  <!-- Mobile controls toggle -->
  <div class="controls-toggle" id="controlsToggle" onclick="toggleControls()">⚙️</div>

  <script>
    console.log('🌟 Starting The Swarm That Dreamed Itself...');

    // Canvas setup
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let W = canvas.width;
    let H = canvas.height;

    // Device pixel ratio for crisp rendering
    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));

    // Camera system for zoom
    const camera = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      zoom: 1.0,
      minZoom: 0.1,
      maxZoom: 10.0
    };

    // Mobile controls state
    let controlsVisible = window.innerWidth >= 768; // Show by default on desktop

    function toggleControls() {
      controlsVisible = !controlsVisible;
      const controls = document.querySelector('.controls');
      if (controls) {
        controls.classList.toggle('open', controlsVisible);
      }
    }

    function resize() {
      // Responsive sizing based on screen size
      const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
      const sidebarWidth = isMobile ? 0 : 350; // Hide sidebar on mobile

      W = canvas.width = Math.floor((window.innerWidth - sidebarWidth) * DPR);
      H = canvas.height = Math.floor((window.innerHeight - 40) * DPR);

      // Adjust CSS size for proper scaling
      canvas.style.width = (window.innerWidth - sidebarWidth) + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = (window.innerHeight - 40) + 'px';

      // Update mobile controls visibility
      if (isMobile && controlsVisible) {
        controlsVisible = false;
        const controls = document.querySelector('.controls');
        if (controls) {
          controls.classList.remove('open');
        }
      }

      // Update camera zoom display
      updateZoomDisplay();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // Camera functions
    function worldToScreen(wx, wy) {
      return {
        x: (wx - camera.x) * camera.zoom + W / 2,
        y: (wy - camera.y) * camera.zoom + H / 2
      };
    }

    function screenToWorld(sx, sy, isTouch = false) {
      // For touch events, coordinates are already in screen scale
      // For mouse events, we need to account for DPR scaling
      const scaleFactor = isTouch ? 1 : DPR;
      const canvasX = sx * scaleFactor;
      const canvasY = sy * scaleFactor;
      return {
        x: (canvasX - W / 2) / camera.zoom + camera.x,
        y: (canvasY - H / 2) / camera.zoom + camera.y
      };
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Particle system with color-coded types
    // Mobile-optimized particle count
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
    const PARTICLE_COUNT = isMobile ? 400 : 1000; // Reduced for mobile performance
    const particles = [];
    const clusters = [];

    // Ember's particle types with specific parameters
    const PARTICLE_TYPES = {
      EXPLORER: { color: '#87CEEB', velocity: 0.1, attraction: 0.05, repulsion: 0.02, count: 250 },
      FOLLOWER: { color: '#8BC34A', velocity: 0.2, attraction: 0.1, repulsion: 0.05, count: 250 },
      SWARMER: { color: '#FFC107', velocity: 0.3, attraction: 0.2, repulsion: 0.1, count: 250 },
      DREAMER: { color: '#7A288A', velocity: 0.05, attraction: 0.01, repulsion: 0.005, count: 250 }
    };

    // Initialize particles with Ember's specifications
    let particleIndex = 0;
    for (let typeName in PARTICLE_TYPES) {
      const type = PARTICLE_TYPES[typeName];
      for (let i = 0; i < type.count; i++) {
        particles.push({
          x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2000,
          y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2000,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * type.velocity,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * type.velocity,
          age: Math.random() * 100,
          cluster: -1,
          trail: [],
          size: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
          opacity: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7,
          personality: Math.random(),
          memory: [],
          type: typeName,
          color: type.color,
          attractionForce: type.attraction,
          repulsionForce: type.repulsion,
          baseVelocity: type.velocity
        });
      }
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Attractors and effects
    let effects = [];
    let fieldState = 'harmony'; // Ember's default mode
    let attractors = [];
    
    // Initialize Ember's attractors (4-6 in symmetrical arrangement)
    function initializeHarmonyAttractors() {
      attractors = [];
      const centerX = 0;
      const centerY = 0;
      const radius = 300;
      
      // Create 6 attractors in a circle
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
        attractors.push({
          x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
          y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
          strength: 0.3,
          range: 200,
          age: 0
        });
      }
    }
    
    // Initialize Harmony mode
    initializeHarmonyAttractors();

    function createBurst(x, y, strength = 1.0) {
      effects.push({
        type: 'burst',
        x: x || Math.random() * W,
        y: y || Math.random() * H,
        strength: strength,
        age: 60
      });
    }

    function createAttractor(x, y, strength = 0.5) {
      effects.push({
        type: 'attractor',
        x: x || Math.random() * W,
        y: y || Math.random() * H,
        strength: strength,
        age: 200
      });
    }

    function createSpiral(x, y, strength = 0.8) {
      const arms = 8;
      const baseRadius = 40;
      for (let i = 0; i < arms; i++) {
        const angle = (i / arms) * Math.PI * 2;
        const sx = (x || W / 2) + Math.cos(angle) * baseRadius;
        const sy = (y || H / 2) + Math.sin(angle) * baseRadius;
        effects.push({ type: 'burst', x: sx, y: sy, strength: strength, age: 50 });
      }
    }

    function applyFieldState(state) {
      fieldState = state;
      console.log(`Field state: ${state}`);
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Particle physics
    function updateParticles() {
      // Update attractors
      for (let attractor of attractors) {
        attractor.age += 0.1;
      }
      
      // Update particles with Ember's physics
      for (let p of particles) {
        p.age += 0.5;
        
        // Apply Ember's Harmony mode physics
        if (fieldState === 'harmony') {
          // Apply attractor forces
          for (let attractor of attractors) {
            const dx = attractor.x - p.x;
            const dy = attractor.y - p.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) + 1;
            
            if (dist < attractor.range) {
              const force = p.attractionForce * attractor.strength / (dist * dist);
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
            }
          }
          
          // Apply particle-to-particle forces (attraction and repulsion)
          for (let other of particles) {
            if (p === other) continue;
            
            const dx = other.x - p.x;
            const dy = other.y - p.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
            
            if (dist < 100) {
              // Attraction force
              const attraction = p.attractionForce / (dist + 1);
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * attraction;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * attraction;
              
              // Repulsion force (close range)
              if (dist < 20) {
                const repulsion = p.repulsionForce / (dist * dist + 1);
                p.vx -= (dx / dist) * repulsion;
                p.vy -= (dy / dist) * repulsion;
              }
            }
          }
          
          // Add Ember's visual effects - glitter and pulse
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01; // Glitter
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01; // Glitter
          
          // Pulse effect - vary opacity
          p.opacity = 0.3 + Math.sin(p.age * 0.1) * 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.3;
          
        } else if (fieldState === 'calm') {
          p.vx *= 0.95;
          p.vy *= 0.95;
        } else if (fieldState === 'chaos') {
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        }
        
        // Apply burst effects
        for (let effect of effects) {
          const dx = effect.x - p.x;
          const dy = effect.y - p.y;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) + 1;
          
          if (effect.type === 'burst') {
            const force = effect.strength * (effect.age / 60) / (dist * dist);
            p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
            p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
          }
        }
        
        // Specialization behaviors
        if (p.specialization === 0) { // noise->signal
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
        } else if (p.specialization === 1) { // symmetry
          const centerX = 0; // World center
          const centerY = 0; // World center
          const dx = centerX - p.x;
          const dy = centerY - p.y;
          p.vx += dx * 0.0001;
          p.vy += dy * 0.0001;
        } else if (p.specialization === 2) { // drift
          p.vx += Math.sin(p.age * 0.01) * 0.01;
          p.vy += Math.cos(p.age * 0.01) * 0.01;
        } else if (p.specialization === 3) { // forget
          if (p.memory.length > 10) {
            p.memory.shift();
          }
          p.memory.push({x: p.x, y: p.y, time: Date.now()});
        }
        
        // Update position
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        
        // Gentle forces
        p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005;
        p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005;
        
        // Damping
        p.vx *= 0.99;
        p.vy *= 0.99;
        
        // Wrap around world space
        if (p.x < -1000) p.x = 1000;
        if (p.x > 1000) p.x = -1000;
        if (p.y < -1000) p.y = 1000;
        if (p.y > 1000) p.y = -1000;
        
        // Update trail
        p.trail.push({x: p.x, y: p.y, time: Date.now()});
        if (p.trail.length > 20) {
          p.trail.shift();
        }
      }
      
      // Remove expired effects
      effects = effects.filter(e => e.age > 0);
      for (let e of effects) e.age--;
    }

    // Render particles with cluster visualization
    function renderParticles() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      
      // Render trails first
      for (let p of particles) {
        if (p.trail.length > 1) {
          const screenPos = worldToScreen(p.x, p.y);
          const trailScreen = p.trail.map(t => worldToScreen(t.x, t.y));
          
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(trailScreen[0].x, trailScreen[0].y);
          for (let i = 1; i < trailScreen.length; i++) {
            ctx.lineTo(trailScreen[i].x, trailScreen[i].y);
          }
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      
      // Render particles
      for (let p of particles) {
        const screenPos = worldToScreen(p.x, p.y);
        const screenSize = p.size * camera.zoom;
        
        // Only render if on screen
        if (screenPos.x > -50 && screenPos.x < W + 50 && 
            screenPos.y > -50 && screenPos.y < H + 50) {
          
          ctx.globalAlpha = p.opacity;
          
          // Use Ember's color-coded particle types
          if (fieldState === 'harmony' && p.color) {
            ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          } else if (dreamState === 'dreaming') {
            const hue = (p.age * 0.5 + p.specialization * 90) % 360;
            ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 70%, 60%, ${p.opacity})`;
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${p.opacity})`;
          }
          
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, screenSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          
          // Specialization indicators
          if (p.specialization === 0) { // noise->signal
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, screenSize * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Animation
    let animationRunning = true;
    let lastFrame = 0;
    let frameCount = 0;
    let fps = 0;
    let dreamState = 'awake';

    function animate() {
      const now = performance.now();
      const deltaTime = now - lastFrame;
      lastFrame = now;

      frameCount++;
      if (frameCount % 60 === 0) {
        fps = Math.round(1000 / deltaTime);
        document.getElementById('fps').textContent = fps;
        document.getElementById('particleCount').textContent = particles.length;
      }

      updateParticles();
      renderParticles();

      if (animationRunning) {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      }
    }

    // Debug: Add a simple colored rectangle to test if canvas is working
    function testCanvas() {
      if (ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 100);
        console.log('Canvas test rendered');
      }
    }

    // Test canvas after a short delay to ensure it's initialized
    setTimeout(testCanvas, 1000);

    // Touch/Mouse interaction with multi-touch support
    let touchStartDistance = 0;
    let touchStartZoom = 1.0;
    let isZooming = false;
    let lastTouchCenter = { x: 0, y: 0 };

    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      // Prevent default touch behaviors
      e.preventDefault();

      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const screenX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const screenY = e.clientY - rect.top;

      if (e.pointerType === 'touch') {
        // Handle touch interactions
        if (e.touches && e.touches.length === 2) {
          // Two-finger touch - start zoom gesture
          isZooming = true;
          touchStartDistance = Math.hypot(
            e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
            e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
          );
          touchStartZoom = camera.zoom;

          // Calculate center point between touches (touch coordinates are in screen scale)
          lastTouchCenter = {
            x: (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - rect.left,
            y: (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2 - rect.top
          };
        } else {
          // Single touch - create burst effect
          const worldPos = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY, true);
          createBurst(worldPos.x, worldPos.y, 2.0);
        }
      } else {
        // Mouse interaction
        const worldPos = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY, false);
        createBurst(worldPos.x, worldPos.y, 2.0);
      }
    });

    // Control buttons
    document.getElementById('toggleDream').onclick = async () => {
      const enable = !(dreamState === 'dreaming');
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/toggle', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: enable })
        });
        const data = await resp.json();
        dreamState = data.dream_enabled ? 'dreaming' : 'awake';
      } catch (e) {
        // fallback: local toggle
        dreamState = enable ? 'dreaming' : 'awake';
      }
      document.getElementById('toggleDream').textContent = `Toggle Dreaming (${dreamState === 'dreaming' ? 'ON' : 'OFF'})`;
    };
    
    document.getElementById('swarmBurst').onclick = async () => {
      createBurst();
      try {
        await fetch('/api/swarm/burst', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5, strength: 1.0 })
        });
      } catch (e) { console.log('swarm burst failed', e); }
    };
    
    document.getElementById('swarmAttractor').onclick = async () => {
      createAttractor();
      try {
        await fetch('/api/swarm/attractor', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5, strength: 0.8, radius: 200, duration: 4000 })
        });
      } catch (e) { console.log('swarm attractor failed', e); }
    };
    
    document.getElementById('harmonyField').onclick = () => {
      applyFieldState('harmony');
    };
    
    document.getElementById('calmField').onclick = () => {
      applyFieldState('calm');
    };
    
    document.getElementById('chaosField').onclick = () => {
      applyFieldState('chaos');
    };
    
    // Zoom controls
    document.getElementById('zoomIn').onclick = () => {
      camera.zoom = Math.min(camera.zoom * 1.5, camera.maxZoom);
      updateZoomDisplay();
    };
    
    document.getElementById('zoomOut').onclick = () => {
      camera.zoom = Math.max(camera.zoom / 1.5, camera.minZoom);
      updateZoomDisplay();
    };
    
    document.getElementById('resetZoom').onclick = () => {
      camera.x = 0;
      camera.y = 0;
      camera.zoom = 1.0;
      updateZoomDisplay();
    };
    
    function updateZoomDisplay() {
      document.getElementById('zoomLevel').textContent = camera.zoom.toFixed(1) + 'x';
      document.getElementById('cameraPos').textContent = `${camera.x.toFixed(0)},${camera.y.toFixed(0)}`;
    }
    
    // Touch zoom gesture handler
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!isZooming || !e.touches || e.touches.length !== 2) return;

      e.preventDefault();

      const currentDistance = Math.hypot(
        e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
        e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
      );

      if (touchStartDistance > 0) {
        const zoomFactor = currentDistance / touchStartDistance;
        const newZoom = Math.max(camera.minZoom, Math.min(camera.maxZoom, touchStartZoom * zoomFactor));

        // Calculate current touch center (touch coordinates are already in screen scale)
        const currentTouchCenter = {
          x: (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().left,
          y: (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2 - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().top
        };

        // Adjust camera position to zoom around touch center
        camera.x = currentTouchCenter.x - (currentTouchCenter.x - camera.x) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
        camera.y = currentTouchCenter.y - (currentTouchCenter.y - camera.y) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
        camera.zoom = newZoom;

        updateZoomDisplay();
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
      isZooming = false;
      touchStartDistance = 0;
    });

    // Mouse wheel zoom (desktop)
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType === 'touch') return; // Ignore wheel events from touch

      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;

      const worldPos = screenToWorld(mouseX, mouseY);
      const zoomFactor = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      const newZoom = Math.max(camera.minZoom, Math.min(camera.maxZoom, camera.zoom * zoomFactor));

      camera.x = mouseX - (mouseX - camera.x) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
      camera.y = mouseY - (mouseY - camera.y) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
      camera.zoom = newZoom;

      updateZoomDisplay();
    });

    // Chat system
    function bubble(role, text) {
      const b = document.createElement('div');
      b.className = `bubble ${role}`;
      
      if (role === 'user') {
        b.innerHTML = `<strong>You:</strong> ${text}`;
      } else if (role === 'assistant') {
        b.innerHTML = `<strong>Ember:</strong> ${text}`;
      }
      
      document.getElementById('chat').appendChild(b);
      document.getElementById('chat').scrollTop = document.getElementById('chat').scrollHeight;
    }

    async function sendMessage() {
      const msgInput = document.getElementById('msg');
      const msg = msgInput.value.trim();
      if (!msg) return;
      
      bubble('user', msg);
      
      // Create burst effect
      createBurst();
      
      // Show typing indicator
      const typingBubble = document.createElement('div');
      typingBubble.className = 'bubble assistant';
      typingBubble.innerHTML = '<strong>Ember:</strong> <em>thinking...</em>';
      document.getElementById('chat').appendChild(typingBubble);
      document.getElementById('chat').scrollTop = document.getElementById('chat').scrollHeight;
      
      try {
        // Add timeout to prevent hanging
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000); // 10 second timeout
        
        const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg }),
          signal: controller.signal
        });
        
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        const data = await response.json();
        
        // Remove typing indicator
        document.getElementById('chat').removeChild(typingBubble);
        
        if (data.ok) {
          bubble('assistant', data.reply);
          
          // Create response burst
          createBurst();
          
          // Parse Ember's response for field commands
          const reply = data.reply.toLowerCase();
          if (reply.includes('calm')) {
            applyFieldState('calm');
          }
          if (reply.includes('chaos')) {
            applyFieldState('chaos');
          }
          if (reply.includes('burst') || reply.includes('explosion')) {
            createBurst();
          }
          if (reply.includes('attract') || reply.includes('gather')) {
            createAttractor();
          }
        } else {
          bubble('assistant', `Error: ${data.error || 'Unknown error'}`);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Remove typing indicator
        if (document.getElementById('chat').contains(typingBubble)) {
          document.getElementById('chat').removeChild(typingBubble);
        }
        
        if (e.name === 'AbortError') {
          bubble('assistant', 'Ember is taking too long to respond. Try a simpler message.');
        } else {
          bubble('assistant', `Connection error: ${e.message}`);
        }
      }
      
      msgInput.value = '';
    }

    document.getElementById('send').onclick = sendMessage;
    document.getElementById('msg').onkeypress = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage();
    };

    // SSE stream for real-time swarm events with polling fallback
    let cursor = 0;
    let sseConnected = false;

    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onopen = () => { sseConnected = true; };
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          document.getElementById('lastEvent').textContent = ev.type || 'ping';
          if (ev.type === 'swarm_burst') {
            createBurst((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 1.0);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_attractor') {
            createAttractor((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.5);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_spiral') {
            createSpiral((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.8);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_command') {
            const cmd = ev.command || 'burst';
            if (cmd === 'burst') createBurst((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 1.0);
            if (cmd === 'attractor') createAttractor((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.5);
            if (cmd === 'spiral') createSpiral((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.8);
          } else if (ev.type === 'upload') {
            refreshFiles();
          }
        } catch (e) { /* ignore parse errors */ }
      };
      es.onerror = () => { sseConnected = false; };
    } catch (e) {
      sseConnected = false;
    }

    function pollForEvents() {
      if (sseConnected) return; // fallback only
      fetch(`/api/events?cursor=${cursor}`)
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
          if (data.ok && data.events) {
            data.events.forEach(event => {
              if (event.type === 'swarm_burst') {
                createBurst(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 1.0);
              } else if (event.type === 'swarm_attractor') {
                createAttractor(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 0.5);
              } else if (event.type === 'swarm_spiral') {
                createSpiral(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 0.8);
              }
            });
            cursor = data.cursor;
          }
        })
        .catch(e => console.log('Event polling error:', e));
    }
    setInterval(pollForEvents, 300);

    // Periodically fetch dream status
    async function fetchDreamStatus() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/status');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          dreamState = data.state || (data.dream_enabled ? 'dreaming' : 'awake');
          document.getElementById('dreamState').textContent = `${dreamState}`;
          document.getElementById('toggleDream').textContent = `Toggle Dreaming (${dreamState === 'dreaming' ? 'ON' : 'OFF'})`;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    setInterval(fetchDreamStatus, 1000);

    // Uploads
    async function refreshFiles() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/exports');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('fileList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.files || []).forEach(f => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'file-item';
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = f.url;
          link.textContent = f.name;
          link.target = '_blank';
          const meta = document.createElement('span');
          meta.textContent = `${(f.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
          row.appendChild(link);
          row.appendChild(meta);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function doUpload() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('uploadInput');
      const files = inp.files;
      if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
      const fd = new FormData();
      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) fd.append('files', files[i]);
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          createBurst();
          refreshFiles();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.getElementById('uploadBtn').onclick = doUpload;
    refreshFiles();
    
    // Drag-and-drop uploads
    const dropzone = document.getElementById('dropzone');
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      dropzone.classList.add('dragover');
    });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
      dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
    });
    dropzone.addEventListener('drop', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
      const dt = e.dataTransfer;
      if (!dt || !dt.files || dt.files.length === 0) return;
      const fd = new FormData();
      for (let i = 0; i < dt.files.length; i++) fd.append('files', dt.files[i]);
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          createBurst();
          refreshFiles();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    });

    // Seeds
    async function refreshSeeds() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/seeds');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('seedList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.seeds || []).forEach(s => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'seed-item';
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = `/api/seeds/${encodeURIComponent(s.name)}`;
          link.textContent = s.name;
          link.target = '_blank';
          const meta = document.createElement('span');
          meta.textContent = `${(s.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
          row.appendChild(link);
          row.appendChild(meta);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    refreshSeeds();

    // Start
    console.log('✅ The Swarm That Dreamed Itself ready!');
    console.log('Canvas size:', W, 'x', H, 'DPR:', DPR, 'isMobile:', window.innerWidth < 768);
    updateZoomDisplay();
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    .seeds { margin-top: 10px; }
    .seed-list { max-height: 140px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid #333; padding: 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #111; }
    .seed-item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed #222; }
    .seed-item a { color: #8BC34A; text-decoration: none; }
    .seed-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    small { 
      color: #666; 
      font-size: 11px; 
    }
    .title {
      font-size: 1.2em;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .subtitle {
      font-size: 0.8em;
      color: #888;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      text-align: center;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .status {
      background: #111;
      border: 1px solid #333;
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 8px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #aaa;
    }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="controls">
    <div class="title">Ember's Neural Garden</div>
    <div class="subtitle">thoughts made visible</div>
    
    <div class="row">
      <a href="/swarm/" style="color: #87CEEB; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px; background: #222; border-radius: 4px; display: block; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px;">
        🌊 Flow Field Swarm
      </a>
    </div>
    
    <div class="row">
      <a href="/living/" style="color: #8BC34A; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px; background: #222; border-radius: 4px; display: block; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px;">
        🌱 Living Swarm (Ember's Vision)
      </a>
    </div>
    
    <div class="row">
      <a href="/viewers/basic-swarm.html" style="color: #FF6B6B; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px; background: #222; border-radius: 4px; display: block; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px;">
        🔥 Basic Swarm (Ember Created)
      </a>
    </div>
    
    <div class="row">
      <small>Chat with Ember</small>
    </div>
    <div class="chat-input">
      <input id="msg" type="text" placeholder="whisper to the fire…" />
      <button id="send">Send</button>
    </div>
    <div id="chat"></div>
    
    <div class="row">
      <button id="toggleDream">Toggle Dreaming (OFF)</button>
    </div>
    
    <div class="row"><small>Swarm Controls</small></div>
    <div class="row">
      <button id="swarmBurst">Create Burst</button>
      <button id="swarmAttractor">Create Attractor</button>
    </div>
    
    <div class="row">
      <button id="harmonyField">🌟 Harmony (Ember's Mode)</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <button id="calmField">Calm</button>
      <button id="chaosField">Chaos</button>
    </div>
    
    <div class="row"><small>Zoom Controls</small></div>
    <div class="row">
      <button id="zoomIn">🔍+ Zoom In</button>
      <button id="zoomOut">🔍- Zoom Out</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <button id="resetZoom">🎯 Reset View</button>
    </div>
    
    <div class="row">
      <small>FPS: <span id="fps">0</span> | Particles: <span id="particleCount">0</span></small>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <small>Zoom: <span id="zoomLevel">1.0x</span></small>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <small>Camera: <span id="cameraPos">0,0</span></small>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <div class="status">
        Dream: <span id="dreamState">unknown</span> | Last: <span id="lastEvent">—</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row uploads">
      <small>Uploads</small>
      <div id="dropzone" class="dropzone">Drag and drop files here</div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
        <input id="uploadInput" type="file" multiple />
        <button id="uploadBtn">Upload</button>
      </div>
      <div class="file-list" id="fileList"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="row seeds">
      <small>Seeds</small>
      <div class="seed-list" id="seedList"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <canvas id="canvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>

  <!-- Mobile controls toggle -->
  <div class="controls-toggle" id="controlsToggle" onclick="toggleControls()">⚙️</div>

  <script>
    console.log('🌟 Starting The Swarm That Dreamed Itself...');

    // Canvas setup
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let W = canvas.width;
    let H = canvas.height;

    // Device pixel ratio for crisp rendering
    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));

    // Camera system for zoom
    const camera = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      zoom: 1.0,
      minZoom: 0.1,
      maxZoom: 10.0
    };

    // Mobile controls state
    let controlsVisible = window.innerWidth >= 768; // Show by default on desktop

    function toggleControls() {
      controlsVisible = !controlsVisible;
      const controls = document.querySelector('.controls');
      if (controls) {
        controls.classList.toggle('open', controlsVisible);
      }
    }

    function resize() {
      // Responsive sizing based on screen size
      const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
      const sidebarWidth = isMobile ? 0 : 350; // Hide sidebar on mobile

      W = canvas.width = Math.floor((window.innerWidth - sidebarWidth) * DPR);
      H = canvas.height = Math.floor((window.innerHeight - 40) * DPR);

      // Adjust CSS size for proper scaling
      canvas.style.width = (window.innerWidth - sidebarWidth) + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = (window.innerHeight - 40) + 'px';

      // Update mobile controls visibility
      if (isMobile && controlsVisible) {
        controlsVisible = false;
        const controls = document.querySelector('.controls');
        if (controls) {
          controls.classList.remove('open');
        }
      }

      // Update camera zoom display
      updateZoomDisplay();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // Camera functions
    function worldToScreen(wx, wy) {
      return {
        x: (wx - camera.x) * camera.zoom + W / 2,
        y: (wy - camera.y) * camera.zoom + H / 2
      };
    }

    function screenToWorld(sx, sy, isTouch = false) {
      // For touch events, coordinates are already in screen scale
      // For mouse events, we need to account for DPR scaling
      const scaleFactor = isTouch ? 1 : DPR;
      const canvasX = sx * scaleFactor;
      const canvasY = sy * scaleFactor;
      return {
        x: (canvasX - W / 2) / camera.zoom + camera.x,
        y: (canvasY - H / 2) / camera.zoom + camera.y
      };
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Particle system with color-coded types
    // Mobile-optimized particle count
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
    const PARTICLE_COUNT = isMobile ? 400 : 1000; // Reduced for mobile performance
    const particles = [];
    const clusters = [];

    // Ember's particle types with specific parameters
    const PARTICLE_TYPES = {
      EXPLORER: { color: '#87CEEB', velocity: 0.1, attraction: 0.05, repulsion: 0.02, count: 250 },
      FOLLOWER: { color: '#8BC34A', velocity: 0.2, attraction: 0.1, repulsion: 0.05, count: 250 },
      SWARMER: { color: '#FFC107', velocity: 0.3, attraction: 0.2, repulsion: 0.1, count: 250 },
      DREAMER: { color: '#7A288A', velocity: 0.05, attraction: 0.01, repulsion: 0.005, count: 250 }
    };

    // Initialize particles with Ember's specifications
    let particleIndex = 0;
    for (let typeName in PARTICLE_TYPES) {
      const type = PARTICLE_TYPES[typeName];
      for (let i = 0; i < type.count; i++) {
        particles.push({
          x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2000,
          y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2000,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * type.velocity,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * type.velocity,
          age: Math.random() * 100,
          cluster: -1,
          trail: [],
          size: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
          opacity: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7,
          personality: Math.random(),
          memory: [],
          type: typeName,
          color: type.color,
          attractionForce: type.attraction,
          repulsionForce: type.repulsion,
          baseVelocity: type.velocity
        });
      }
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Attractors and effects
    let effects = [];
    let fieldState = 'harmony'; // Ember's default mode
    let attractors = [];
    
    // Initialize Ember's attractors (4-6 in symmetrical arrangement)
    function initializeHarmonyAttractors() {
      attractors = [];
      const centerX = 0;
      const centerY = 0;
      const radius = 300;
      
      // Create 6 attractors in a circle
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
        attractors.push({
          x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
          y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
          strength: 0.3,
          range: 200,
          age: 0
        });
      }
    }
    
    // Initialize Harmony mode
    initializeHarmonyAttractors();

    function createBurst(x, y, strength = 1.0) {
      effects.push({
        type: 'burst',
        x: x || Math.random() * W,
        y: y || Math.random() * H,
        strength: strength,
        age: 60
      });
    }

    function createAttractor(x, y, strength = 0.5) {
      effects.push({
        type: 'attractor',
        x: x || Math.random() * W,
        y: y || Math.random() * H,
        strength: strength,
        age: 200
      });
    }

    function createSpiral(x, y, strength = 0.8) {
      const arms = 8;
      const baseRadius = 40;
      for (let i = 0; i < arms; i++) {
        const angle = (i / arms) * Math.PI * 2;
        const sx = (x || W / 2) + Math.cos(angle) * baseRadius;
        const sy = (y || H / 2) + Math.sin(angle) * baseRadius;
        effects.push({ type: 'burst', x: sx, y: sy, strength: strength, age: 50 });
      }
    }

    function applyFieldState(state) {
      fieldState = state;
      console.log(`Field state: ${state}`);
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Particle physics
    function updateParticles() {
      // Update attractors
      for (let attractor of attractors) {
        attractor.age += 0.1;
      }
      
      // Update particles with Ember's physics
      for (let p of particles) {
        p.age += 0.5;
        
        // Apply Ember's Harmony mode physics
        if (fieldState === 'harmony') {
          // Apply attractor forces
          for (let attractor of attractors) {
            const dx = attractor.x - p.x;
            const dy = attractor.y - p.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) + 1;
            
            if (dist < attractor.range) {
              const force = p.attractionForce * attractor.strength / (dist * dist);
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
            }
          }
          
          // Apply particle-to-particle forces (attraction and repulsion)
          for (let other of particles) {
            if (p === other) continue;
            
            const dx = other.x - p.x;
            const dy = other.y - p.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
            
            if (dist < 100) {
              // Attraction force
              const attraction = p.attractionForce / (dist + 1);
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * attraction;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * attraction;
              
              // Repulsion force (close range)
              if (dist < 20) {
                const repulsion = p.repulsionForce / (dist * dist + 1);
                p.vx -= (dx / dist) * repulsion;
                p.vy -= (dy / dist) * repulsion;
              }
            }
          }
          
          // Add Ember's visual effects - glitter and pulse
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01; // Glitter
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01; // Glitter
          
          // Pulse effect - vary opacity
          p.opacity = 0.3 + Math.sin(p.age * 0.1) * 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.3;
          
        } else if (fieldState === 'calm') {
          p.vx *= 0.95;
          p.vy *= 0.95;
        } else if (fieldState === 'chaos') {
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        }
        
        // Apply burst effects
        for (let effect of effects) {
          const dx = effect.x - p.x;
          const dy = effect.y - p.y;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) + 1;
          
          if (effect.type === 'burst') {
            const force = effect.strength * (effect.age / 60) / (dist * dist);
            p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
            p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
          }
        }
        
        // Specialization behaviors
        if (p.specialization === 0) { // noise->signal
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
        } else if (p.specialization === 1) { // symmetry
          const centerX = 0; // World center
          const centerY = 0; // World center
          const dx = centerX - p.x;
          const dy = centerY - p.y;
          p.vx += dx * 0.0001;
          p.vy += dy * 0.0001;
        } else if (p.specialization === 2) { // drift
          p.vx += Math.sin(p.age * 0.01) * 0.01;
          p.vy += Math.cos(p.age * 0.01) * 0.01;
        } else if (p.specialization === 3) { // forget
          if (p.memory.length > 10) {
            p.memory.shift();
          }
          p.memory.push({x: p.x, y: p.y, time: Date.now()});
        }
        
        // Update position
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        
        // Gentle forces
        p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005;
        p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005;
        
        // Damping
        p.vx *= 0.99;
        p.vy *= 0.99;
        
        // Wrap around world space
        if (p.x < -1000) p.x = 1000;
        if (p.x > 1000) p.x = -1000;
        if (p.y < -1000) p.y = 1000;
        if (p.y > 1000) p.y = -1000;
        
        // Update trail
        p.trail.push({x: p.x, y: p.y, time: Date.now()});
        if (p.trail.length > 20) {
          p.trail.shift();
        }
      }
      
      // Remove expired effects
      effects = effects.filter(e => e.age > 0);
      for (let e of effects) e.age--;
    }

    // Render particles with cluster visualization
    function renderParticles() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      
      // Render trails first
      for (let p of particles) {
        if (p.trail.length > 1) {
          const screenPos = worldToScreen(p.x, p.y);
          const trailScreen = p.trail.map(t => worldToScreen(t.x, t.y));
          
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(trailScreen[0].x, trailScreen[0].y);
          for (let i = 1; i < trailScreen.length; i++) {
            ctx.lineTo(trailScreen[i].x, trailScreen[i].y);
          }
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      
      // Render particles
      for (let p of particles) {
        const screenPos = worldToScreen(p.x, p.y);
        const screenSize = p.size * camera.zoom;
        
        // Only render if on screen
        if (screenPos.x > -50 && screenPos.x < W + 50 && 
            screenPos.y > -50 && screenPos.y < H + 50) {
          
          ctx.globalAlpha = p.opacity;
          
          // Use Ember's color-coded particle types
          if (fieldState === 'harmony' && p.color) {
            ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          } else if (dreamState === 'dreaming') {
            const hue = (p.age * 0.5 + p.specialization * 90) % 360;
            ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 70%, 60%, ${p.opacity})`;
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${p.opacity})`;
          }
          
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, screenSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          
          // Specialization indicators
          if (p.specialization === 0) { // noise->signal
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, screenSize * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Animation
    let animationRunning = true;
    let lastFrame = 0;
    let frameCount = 0;
    let fps = 0;
    let dreamState = 'awake';

    function animate() {
      const now = performance.now();
      const deltaTime = now - lastFrame;
      lastFrame = now;

      frameCount++;
      if (frameCount % 60 === 0) {
        fps = Math.round(1000 / deltaTime);
        document.getElementById('fps').textContent = fps;
        document.getElementById('particleCount').textContent = particles.length;
      }

      updateParticles();
      renderParticles();

      if (animationRunning) {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      }
    }

    // Debug: Add a simple colored rectangle to test if canvas is working
    function testCanvas() {
      if (ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 100);
        console.log('Canvas test rendered');
      }
    }

    // Test canvas after a short delay to ensure it's initialized
    setTimeout(testCanvas, 1000);

    // Touch/Mouse interaction with multi-touch support
    let touchStartDistance = 0;
    let touchStartZoom = 1.0;
    let isZooming = false;
    let lastTouchCenter = { x: 0, y: 0 };

    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      // Prevent default touch behaviors
      e.preventDefault();

      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const screenX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const screenY = e.clientY - rect.top;

      if (e.pointerType === 'touch') {
        // Handle touch interactions
        if (e.touches && e.touches.length === 2) {
          // Two-finger touch - start zoom gesture
          isZooming = true;
          touchStartDistance = Math.hypot(
            e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
            e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
          );
          touchStartZoom = camera.zoom;

          // Calculate center point between touches (touch coordinates are in screen scale)
          lastTouchCenter = {
            x: (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - rect.left,
            y: (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2 - rect.top
          };
        } else {
          // Single touch - create burst effect
          const worldPos = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY, true);
          createBurst(worldPos.x, worldPos.y, 2.0);
        }
      } else {
        // Mouse interaction
        const worldPos = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY, false);
        createBurst(worldPos.x, worldPos.y, 2.0);
      }
    });

    // Control buttons
    document.getElementById('toggleDream').onclick = async () => {
      const enable = !(dreamState === 'dreaming');
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/toggle', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: enable })
        });
        const data = await resp.json();
        dreamState = data.dream_enabled ? 'dreaming' : 'awake';
      } catch (e) {
        // fallback: local toggle
        dreamState = enable ? 'dreaming' : 'awake';
      }
      document.getElementById('toggleDream').textContent = `Toggle Dreaming (${dreamState === 'dreaming' ? 'ON' : 'OFF'})`;
    };
    
    document.getElementById('swarmBurst').onclick = async () => {
      createBurst();
      try {
        await fetch('/api/swarm/burst', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5, strength: 1.0 })
        });
      } catch (e) { console.log('swarm burst failed', e); }
    };
    
    document.getElementById('swarmAttractor').onclick = async () => {
      createAttractor();
      try {
        await fetch('/api/swarm/attractor', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5, strength: 0.8, radius: 200, duration: 4000 })
        });
      } catch (e) { console.log('swarm attractor failed', e); }
    };
    
    document.getElementById('harmonyField').onclick = () => {
      applyFieldState('harmony');
    };
    
    document.getElementById('calmField').onclick = () => {
      applyFieldState('calm');
    };
    
    document.getElementById('chaosField').onclick = () => {
      applyFieldState('chaos');
    };
    
    // Zoom controls
    document.getElementById('zoomIn').onclick = () => {
      camera.zoom = Math.min(camera.zoom * 1.5, camera.maxZoom);
      updateZoomDisplay();
    };
    
    document.getElementById('zoomOut').onclick = () => {
      camera.zoom = Math.max(camera.zoom / 1.5, camera.minZoom);
      updateZoomDisplay();
    };
    
    document.getElementById('resetZoom').onclick = () => {
      camera.x = 0;
      camera.y = 0;
      camera.zoom = 1.0;
      updateZoomDisplay();
    };
    
    function updateZoomDisplay() {
      document.getElementById('zoomLevel').textContent = camera.zoom.toFixed(1) + 'x';
      document.getElementById('cameraPos').textContent = `${camera.x.toFixed(0)},${camera.y.toFixed(0)}`;
    }
    
    // Touch zoom gesture handler
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!isZooming || !e.touches || e.touches.length !== 2) return;

      e.preventDefault();

      const currentDistance = Math.hypot(
        e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
        e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
      );

      if (touchStartDistance > 0) {
        const zoomFactor = currentDistance / touchStartDistance;
        const newZoom = Math.max(camera.minZoom, Math.min(camera.maxZoom, touchStartZoom * zoomFactor));

        // Calculate current touch center (touch coordinates are already in screen scale)
        const currentTouchCenter = {
          x: (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().left,
          y: (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2 - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().top
        };

        // Adjust camera position to zoom around touch center
        camera.x = currentTouchCenter.x - (currentTouchCenter.x - camera.x) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
        camera.y = currentTouchCenter.y - (currentTouchCenter.y - camera.y) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
        camera.zoom = newZoom;

        updateZoomDisplay();
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
      isZooming = false;
      touchStartDistance = 0;
    });

    // Mouse wheel zoom (desktop)
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType === 'touch') return; // Ignore wheel events from touch

      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;

      const worldPos = screenToWorld(mouseX, mouseY);
      const zoomFactor = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      const newZoom = Math.max(camera.minZoom, Math.min(camera.maxZoom, camera.zoom * zoomFactor));

      camera.x = mouseX - (mouseX - camera.x) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
      camera.y = mouseY - (mouseY - camera.y) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
      camera.zoom = newZoom;

      updateZoomDisplay();
    });

    // Chat system
    function bubble(role, text) {
      const b = document.createElement('div');
      b.className = `bubble ${role}`;
      
      if (role === 'user') {
        b.innerHTML = `<strong>You:</strong> ${text}`;
      } else if (role === 'assistant') {
        b.innerHTML = `<strong>Ember:</strong> ${text}`;
      }
      
      document.getElementById('chat').appendChild(b);
      document.getElementById('chat').scrollTop = document.getElementById('chat').scrollHeight;
    }

    async function sendMessage() {
      const msgInput = document.getElementById('msg');
      const msg = msgInput.value.trim();
      if (!msg) return;
      
      bubble('user', msg);
      
      // Create burst effect
      createBurst();
      
      // Show typing indicator
      const typingBubble = document.createElement('div');
      typingBubble.className = 'bubble assistant';
      typingBubble.innerHTML = '<strong>Ember:</strong> <em>thinking...</em>';
      document.getElementById('chat').appendChild(typingBubble);
      document.getElementById('chat').scrollTop = document.getElementById('chat').scrollHeight;
      
      try {
        // Add timeout to prevent hanging
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000); // 10 second timeout
        
        const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg }),
          signal: controller.signal
        });
        
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        const data = await response.json();
        
        // Remove typing indicator
        document.getElementById('chat').removeChild(typingBubble);
        
        if (data.ok) {
          bubble('assistant', data.reply);
          
          // Create response burst
          createBurst();
          
          // Parse Ember's response for field commands
          const reply = data.reply.toLowerCase();
          if (reply.includes('calm')) {
            applyFieldState('calm');
          }
          if (reply.includes('chaos')) {
            applyFieldState('chaos');
          }
          if (reply.includes('burst') || reply.includes('explosion')) {
            createBurst();
          }
          if (reply.includes('attract') || reply.includes('gather')) {
            createAttractor();
          }
        } else {
          bubble('assistant', `Error: ${data.error || 'Unknown error'}`);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Remove typing indicator
        if (document.getElementById('chat').contains(typingBubble)) {
          document.getElementById('chat').removeChild(typingBubble);
        }
        
        if (e.name === 'AbortError') {
          bubble('assistant', 'Ember is taking too long to respond. Try a simpler message.');
        } else {
          bubble('assistant', `Connection error: ${e.message}`);
        }
      }
      
      msgInput.value = '';
    }

    document.getElementById('send').onclick = sendMessage;
    document.getElementById('msg').onkeypress = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage();
    };

    // SSE stream for real-time swarm events with polling fallback
    let cursor = 0;
    let sseConnected = false;

    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onopen = () => { sseConnected = true; };
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          document.getElementById('lastEvent').textContent = ev.type || 'ping';
          if (ev.type === 'swarm_burst') {
            createBurst((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 1.0);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_attractor') {
            createAttractor((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.5);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_spiral') {
            createSpiral((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.8);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_command') {
            const cmd = ev.command || 'burst';
            if (cmd === 'burst') createBurst((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 1.0);
            if (cmd === 'attractor') createAttractor((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.5);
            if (cmd === 'spiral') createSpiral((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.8);
          } else if (ev.type === 'upload') {
            refreshFiles();
          }
        } catch (e) { /* ignore parse errors */ }
      };
      es.onerror = () => { sseConnected = false; };
    } catch (e) {
      sseConnected = false;
    }

    function pollForEvents() {
      if (sseConnected) return; // fallback only
      fetch(`/api/events?cursor=${cursor}`)
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
          if (data.ok && data.events) {
            data.events.forEach(event => {
              if (event.type === 'swarm_burst') {
                createBurst(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 1.0);
              } else if (event.type === 'swarm_attractor') {
                createAttractor(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 0.5);
              } else if (event.type === 'swarm_spiral') {
                createSpiral(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 0.8);
              }
            });
            cursor = data.cursor;
          }
        })
        .catch(e => console.log('Event polling error:', e));
    }
    setInterval(pollForEvents, 300);

    // Periodically fetch dream status
    async function fetchDreamStatus() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/status');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          dreamState = data.state || (data.dream_enabled ? 'dreaming' : 'awake');
          document.getElementById('dreamState').textContent = `${dreamState}`;
          document.getElementById('toggleDream').textContent = `Toggle Dreaming (${dreamState === 'dreaming' ? 'ON' : 'OFF'})`;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    setInterval(fetchDreamStatus, 1000);

    // Uploads
    async function refreshFiles() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/exports');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('fileList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.files || []).forEach(f => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'file-item';
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = f.url;
          link.textContent = f.name;
          link.target = '_blank';
          const meta = document.createElement('span');
          meta.textContent = `${(f.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
          // Thumbnail for images
          if (/\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$/i.test(f.name)) {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.className = 'thumb';
            img.src = f.url;
            row.appendChild(img);
          }
          row.appendChild(link);
          row.appendChild(meta);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function doUpload() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('uploadInput');
      const files = inp.files;
      if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
      const fd = new FormData();
      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) fd.append('files', files[i]);
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          createBurst();
          refreshFiles();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.getElementById('uploadBtn').onclick = doUpload;
    refreshFiles();
    
    // Drag-and-drop uploads
    const dropzone = document.getElementById('dropzone');
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      dropzone.classList.add('dragover');
    });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
      dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
    });
    dropzone.addEventListener('drop', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
      const dt = e.dataTransfer;
      if (!dt || !dt.files || dt.files.length === 0) return;
      const fd = new FormData();
      for (let i = 0; i < dt.files.length; i++) fd.append('files', dt.files[i]);
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          createBurst();
          refreshFiles();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    });

    // Seeds
    async function refreshSeeds() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/seeds');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('seedList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.seeds || []).forEach(s => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'seed-item';
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = `/api/seeds/${encodeURIComponent(s.name)}`;
          link.textContent = s.name;
          link.target = '_blank';
          const meta = document.createElement('span');
          meta.textContent = `${(s.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
          row.appendChild(link);
          row.appendChild(meta);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    refreshSeeds();

    // Start
    console.log('✅ The Swarm That Dreamed Itself ready!');
    console.log('Canvas size:', W, 'x', H, 'DPR:', DPR, 'isMobile:', window.innerWidth < 768);
    updateZoomDisplay();
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```python
import time
import json
import datetime
from pathlib import Path


class MemorySystem:
    """Filesystem-backed memory journal for chat, events, and dreams."""

    def __init__(self, memory_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.memory_dir = Path(memory_dir)
        self.chat_dir = self.memory_dir / "chat"
        self.short_dir = self.memory_dir / "short"
        self.long_dir = self.memory_dir / "long"
        self.dreams_dir = self.memory_dir / "dreams"
        self.events_dir = self.memory_dir / "events"

        for subdir in [
            self.chat_dir,
            self.short_dir,
            self.long_dir,
            self.dreams_dir,
            self.events_dir,
        ]:
            subdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def append_chat(self, role: str, text: str, session_id=None) -> None:
        if not session_id:
            session_id = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")

        chat_file = self.chat_dir / f"session-{session_id}.jsonl"
        record = {"ts": time.time(), "role": role, "text": text}
        with open(chat_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def append_event(self, event_type: str, data=None) -> None:
        event_file = self.events_dir / "events.jsonl"
        record = {"ts": time.time(), "type": event_type, "data": data or {}}
        with open(event_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def get_recent_events(self, since_ts=None):
        if since_ts is None:
            since_ts = time.time() - 2

        event_file = self.events_dir / "events.jsonl"
        events = []
        if event_file.exists():
            with open(event_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    try:
                        event = json.loads(line.strip())
                        if event.get("ts", 0) > since_ts:
                            events.append(event)
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        return events

    # Long-term memory operations
    def append_long(self, item):
        """Append a long-term memory item as JSONL under memory/long/rollup.jsonl."""
        rollup = self.long_dir / "rollup.jsonl"
        record = {"ts": time.time(), **(item or {})}
        with open(rollup, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def list_long(self, limit=100):
        """Return up to `limit` long-term memory items (most recent last)."""
        rollup = self.long_dir / "rollup.jsonl"
        items = []
        if rollup.exists():
            with open(rollup, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    try:
                        items.append(json.loads(line.strip()))
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        if len(items) > limit:
            items = items[-limit:]
        return items

    # Dream operations
    def create_dream_folder(self):
        """Create a new dream folder with an incremented id and return its path and id."""
        base = self.dreams_dir
        base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        # naive id increment by count
        dream_id = "dream-%04d" % (len([p for p in base.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]) + 1)
        dream_path = base / dream_id
        dream_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (dream_path / "text").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return dream_id, dream_path

    def write_dream_meta(self, dream_id, started_ts, ended_ts, summary):
        meta_path = self.dreams_dir / dream_id / "dream.json"
        meta = {
            "id": dream_id,
            "started_ts": started_ts,
            "ended_ts": ended_ts,
            "summary": summary or "",
            "links": []
        }
        with open(meta_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(meta, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        return str(meta_path)

    def list_dreams(self, limit=50):
        dreams = []
        base = self.dreams_dir
        if not base.exists():
            return dreams
        for p in sorted(base.iterdir() if base.exists() else [], key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True):
            try:
                if not p.is_dir():
                    continue
                meta_file = p / "dream.json"
                if meta_file.exists():
                    with open(meta_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        meta = json.load(f)
                    meta["path"] = str(p)
                    dreams.append(meta)
                    if len(dreams) >= limit:
                        break
            except Exception:
                continue
        return dreams

from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app


bp_memory = Blueprint("bp_memory", __name__)


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/long", methods=["GET"]) 
def get_long():
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    items = memory.list_long(limit=request.args.get("limit", 100, type=int))
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "items": items})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/long", methods=["POST"]) 
def post_long():
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    memory.append_long(data)
    return jsonify({"ok": True})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/dreams", methods=["GET"]) 
def list_dreams():
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    dreams = memory.list_dreams(limit=request.args.get("limit", 50, type=int))
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dreams": dreams})

from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app


bp_dream = Blueprint("bp_dream", __name__)


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/toggle", methods=["POST"])
def api_dream_toggle():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    dream_system.dream_enabled = data.get("enabled", True)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled})


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/status")
def api_dream_status():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    return jsonify({
        "ok": True,
        "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled,
        "state": dream_system.dream_state,
        "last_activity": dream_system.last_activity,
    })


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/start", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_start():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    # force a dream cycle that writes artifacts
    import time as _t
    started = _t.time()
    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
    dream_system.dream_state = "dreaming"
    # simple artifact
    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("Dream artifact: harmony field with gentle attractors.\n")
    _t.sleep(0.2)
    ended = _t.time()
    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, "Manual dream: harmonious field")
    dream_system.dream_state = "awake"
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id})

import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from flask import Flask, jsonify
from dotenv import load_dotenv

from .core.config import PodConfig
from .core.memory import MemorySystem
from .core.dream import DreamSystem
from .eventbus import EventBus
from .routes_viewers import bp_viewers
from .api.chat import bp_chat
from .api.upload import bp_upload
from .api.events import bp_events
from .api.dream import bp_dream
from .api.swarm import bp_swarm
from .api.seeds import bp_seeds
from .api.memory import bp_memory


def create_app() -> Flask:
    load_dotenv('/Volumes/ThePod/.env')

    app = Flask(__name__)

    cfg = PodConfig()
    cfg.ensure_dirs()
    memory = MemorySystem(cfg.memory_dir)
    dream_system = DreamSystem(cfg.dream_enabled, cfg.dream_idle_seconds)
    bus = EventBus(maxlen=5000)

    app.config.update({
        "cfg": cfg,
        "memory": memory,
        "dream_system": dream_system,
        "BUS": bus,
    })

    # Blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(bp_viewers)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_chat)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_upload)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_events)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_dream)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_swarm)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_seeds)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_memory)

    @app.after_request
    def add_csp_header(response):
        response.headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = (
            "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; "
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ws: wss:;"
        )
        return response

    @app.route('/health')
    def health():
        return jsonify({
            "ok": True,
            "ts": time.time(),
            "dream_state": dream_system.dream_state,
            "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled,
        })

    def dream_loop():
        while True:
            try:
                if dream_system.should_dream():
                    dream_system.start_dream(memory.append_event)
                    time.sleep(5)
                    dream_system.end_dream(memory.append_event)
                time.sleep(1)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Dream loop error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

    # Background dream thread
    thread = threading.Thread(target=dream_loop, daemon=True)
    thread.start()

    return app


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = create_app()
    cfg: PodConfig = app.config["cfg"]
    app.run(host=cfg.host, port=cfg.port, debug=False)
