```html
    .dream-item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed #222; }
    .dream-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .dream-detail { margin-top: 6px; background: #0b0b0b; border: 1px solid #222; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px; }
    .dream-detail pre { white-space: pre-wrap; color: #ccc; font-size: 12px; }
    .longmem { margin-top: 10px; }
    .longmem-list { max-height: 140px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid #333; padding: 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #111; }
    .longmem-item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed #222; }
    .longmem-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    small { 
      color: #666; 
      font-size: 11px; 
    }
    .title {
      font-size: 1.2em;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .subtitle {
      font-size: 0.8em;
      color: #888;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      text-align: center;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .status {
      background: #111;
      border: 1px solid #333;
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 8px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #aaa;
    }
    /* Hide legacy nav buttons and unused controls for ultra-minimal UI */
    a[href="/swarm/"], a[href="/living/"], a[href="/viewers/basic-swarm.html"],
    #toggleDream, #swarmBurst, #swarmAttractor,
    #harmonyField, #calmField, #chaosField, #zoomIn, #zoomOut, #resetZoom {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .settings { margin-top: 10px; }
    .settings .row { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="controls open">
    <div class="title">Ember's Neural Garden</div>
    <div class="subtitle">thoughts made visible — UI v2025-10-04-NEW</div>
    
    <!-- Minimal UI: legacy buttons removed -->
    
    <div class="row">
      <small>Chat with Ember</small>
    </div>
    <div class="chat-input">
      <input id="msg" type="text" placeholder="whisper to the fire…" />
      <button id="send">Send</button>
    </div>
    <div id="chat"></div>
    
    <!-- Minimal UI: toggle removed -->
    
    <!-- Minimal UI: swarm controls removed -->
    
    <!-- Minimal UI: field buttons removed -->
    
    <!-- Minimal UI: zoom controls removed -->
    
    <div class="row">
      <small>FPS: <span id="fps">0</span> | Particles: <span id="particleCount">0</span></small>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <small>Zoom: <span id="zoomLevel">1.0x</span></small>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <small>Camera: <span id="cameraPos">0,0</span></small>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <div class="status">
        Dream: <span id="dreamState">unknown</span> | Last: <span id="lastEvent">—</span>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row uploads">
      <small>Uploads</small>
      <div id="dropzone" class="dropzone">Drag and drop files here</div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
        <input id="uploadInput" type="file" multiple />
        <button id="uploadBtn">Upload</button>
    </div>
      <div class="file-list" id="fileList"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="row settings">
      <small>Dream Settings</small>
    <div class="row">
        <label>Idle (s): <input id="setIdle" type="number" min="1" value="45" style="width:80px;" /></label>
        <label>Max (s): <input id="setMax" type="number" min="1" value="120" style="width:80px;" /></label>
        <label>Seeds: <input id="setSeeds" type="number" min="1" value="6" style="width:80px;" /></label>
        <button id="saveDreamCfg">Save</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row seeds">
      <small>Seeds</small>
      <div class="seed-list" id="seedList"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="row dreams">
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
        <small>Dreams</small>
        <button id="startDream">Start Dream</button>
      </div>
      <div class="dream-list" id="dreamList"></div>
      <div class="dream-detail" id="dreamDetail" style="display:none;"></div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:6px;">
        <button id="summarizeLast">Summarize Last Dream</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row longmem">
      <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center;">
        <small>Long-term Memory</small>
      </div>
      <div class="chat-input" style="margin-top:6px;">
        <input id="ltmInput" type="text" placeholder="add a long-term note…" />
        <button id="ltmAdd">Add</button>
      </div>
      <div class="longmem-list" id="ltmList"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <canvas id="canvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>

  <!-- Mobile controls toggle -->
  <div class="controls-toggle" id="controlsToggle" onclick="toggleControls()">⚙️</div>

  <script>
    console.log('🌟 Starting The Swarm That Dreamed Itself...');

    // Canvas setup
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let W = canvas.width;
    let H = canvas.height;

    // Device pixel ratio for crisp rendering
    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));

    // Camera system for zoom
    const camera = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      zoom: 1.0,
      minZoom: 0.1,
      maxZoom: 10.0
    };

    // Mobile controls state
    let controlsVisible = window.innerWidth >= 768; // Show by default on desktop

    function toggleControls() {
      controlsVisible = !controlsVisible;
      const controls = document.querySelector('.controls');
      if (controls) {
        controls.classList.toggle('open', controlsVisible);
      }
    }

    function resize() {
      // Responsive sizing based on screen size
      const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
      const sidebarWidth = isMobile ? 0 : 350; // Hide sidebar on mobile

      W = canvas.width = Math.floor((window.innerWidth - sidebarWidth) * DPR);
      H = canvas.height = Math.floor((window.innerHeight - 40) * DPR);

      // Adjust CSS size for proper scaling
      canvas.style.width = (window.innerWidth - sidebarWidth) + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = (window.innerHeight - 40) + 'px';

      // Update mobile controls visibility
      if (isMobile && controlsVisible) {
        controlsVisible = false;
        const controls = document.querySelector('.controls');
        if (controls) {
          controls.classList.remove('open');
        }
      }

      // Update camera zoom display
      updateZoomDisplay();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();
    // Ensure controls are visible on load (even on mobile)
    (function ensureControlsVisible(){
      const controls = document.querySelector('.controls');
      if (controls) {
        controls.classList.add('open');
        controlsVisible = true;
      }
    })();

    // Camera functions
    function worldToScreen(wx, wy) {
      return {
        x: (wx - camera.x) * camera.zoom + W / 2,
        y: (wy - camera.y) * camera.zoom + H / 2
      };
    }

    function screenToWorld(sx, sy, isTouch = false) {
      // For touch events, coordinates are already in screen scale
      // For mouse events, we need to account for DPR scaling
      const scaleFactor = isTouch ? 1 : DPR;
      const canvasX = sx * scaleFactor;
      const canvasY = sy * scaleFactor;
      return {
        x: (canvasX - W / 2) / camera.zoom + camera.x,
        y: (canvasY - H / 2) / camera.zoom + camera.y
      };
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Particle system with color-coded types
    // Mobile-optimized particle count
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
    const PARTICLE_COUNT = isMobile ? 800 : 2000; // Double swarm density
    const particles = [];
    const clusters = [];

    // Ember's particle types with specific parameters
    const PARTICLE_TYPES = {
      EXPLORER: { color: '#fff', velocity: 0.1, attraction: 0.05, repulsion: 0.02, count: 500 },
      FOLLOWER: { color: '#ddd', velocity: 0.2, attraction: 0.1, repulsion: 0.05, count: 500 },
      SWARMER: { color: '#bbb', velocity: 0.3, attraction: 0.2, repulsion: 0.1, count: 500 },
      DREAMER: { color: '#999', velocity: 0.05, attraction: 0.01, repulsion: 0.005, count: 500 }
    };

    // Initialize particles with Ember's specifications
    let particleIndex = 0;
    for (let typeName in PARTICLE_TYPES) {
      const type = PARTICLE_TYPES[typeName];
      for (let i = 0; i < type.count; i++) {
        particles.push({
          x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2000,
          y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2000,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * type.velocity,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * type.velocity,
          age: Math.random() * 100,
          cluster: -1,
          trail: [],
          size: 1.0 + Math.random() * 2.0,
          opacity: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
          personality: Math.random(),
          memory: [],
          type: typeName,
          color: type.color,
          attractionForce: type.attraction,
          repulsionForce: type.repulsion,
          baseVelocity: type.velocity
        });
      }
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Attractors and effects
    let effects = [];
    let fieldState = 'harmony'; // Ember's default mode
    let attractors = [];
    
    // Initialize Ember's attractors (4-6 in symmetrical arrangement)
    function initializeHarmonyAttractors() {
      attractors = [];
      const centerX = 0;
      const centerY = 0;
      const radius = 300;
      
      // Create 6 attractors in a circle
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
        attractors.push({
          x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
          y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
          strength: 0.3,
          range: 200,
          age: 0
        });
      }
    }
    
    // Initialize Harmony mode
    initializeHarmonyAttractors();

    function createBurst(x, y, strength = 1.0) {
      effects.push({
        type: 'burst',
        x: x || Math.random() * W,
        y: y || Math.random() * H,
        strength: strength,
        age: 60
      });
    }

    function createAttractor(x, y, strength = 0.5) {
      effects.push({
        type: 'attractor',
        x: x || Math.random() * W,
        y: y || Math.random() * H,
        strength: strength,
        age: 200
      });
    }

    function createSpiral(x, y, strength = 0.8) {
      const arms = 8;
      const baseRadius = 40;
      for (let i = 0; i < arms; i++) {
        const angle = (i / arms) * Math.PI * 2;
        const sx = (x || W / 2) + Math.cos(angle) * baseRadius;
        const sy = (y || H / 2) + Math.sin(angle) * baseRadius;
        effects.push({ type: 'burst', x: sx, y: sy, strength: strength, age: 50 });
      }
    }

    function applyFieldState(state) {
      fieldState = state;
      console.log(`Field state: ${state}`);
    }

    // Ember's Harmony Mode - Particle physics
    function updateParticles() {
      // Update attractors
      for (let attractor of attractors) {
        attractor.age += 0.1;
      }
      
      // Update particles with Ember's physics
      for (let p of particles) {
        p.age += 0.5;
        
        // Apply Ember's Harmony mode physics
        if (fieldState === 'harmony') {
          // Apply attractor forces
          for (let attractor of attractors) {
            const dx = attractor.x - p.x;
            const dy = attractor.y - p.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) + 1;
            
            if (dist < attractor.range) {
              const force = p.attractionForce * attractor.strength / (dist * dist);
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
            }
          }
          
          // Apply particle-to-particle forces (attraction and repulsion)
          for (let other of particles) {
            if (p === other) continue;
            
            const dx = other.x - p.x;
            const dy = other.y - p.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
            
            if (dist < 100) {
              // Attraction force
              const attraction = p.attractionForce / (dist + 1);
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * attraction;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * attraction;
              
              // Repulsion force (close range)
              if (dist < 20) {
                const repulsion = p.repulsionForce / (dist * dist + 1);
                p.vx -= (dx / dist) * repulsion;
                p.vy -= (dy / dist) * repulsion;
              }
            }
          }
          
          // Add Ember's visual effects - glitter and pulse
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01; // Glitter
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01; // Glitter
          
          // Pulse effect - vary opacity
          p.opacity = 0.3 + Math.sin(p.age * 0.1) * 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.3;
          
        } else if (fieldState === 'calm') {
          p.vx *= 0.95;
          p.vy *= 0.95;
        } else if (fieldState === 'chaos') {
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        }
        
        // Apply burst effects
        for (let effect of effects) {
          const dx = effect.x - p.x;
          const dy = effect.y - p.y;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) + 1;
          
          if (effect.type === 'burst') {
            const force = effect.strength * (effect.age / 60) / (dist * dist);
            p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
            p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
          }
        }
        
        // Specialization behaviors
        if (p.specialization === 0) { // noise->signal
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
        } else if (p.specialization === 1) { // symmetry
          const centerX = 0; // World center
          const centerY = 0; // World center
          const dx = centerX - p.x;
          const dy = centerY - p.y;
          p.vx += dx * 0.0001;
          p.vy += dy * 0.0001;
        } else if (p.specialization === 2) { // drift
          p.vx += Math.sin(p.age * 0.01) * 0.01;
          p.vy += Math.cos(p.age * 0.01) * 0.01;
        } else if (p.specialization === 3) { // forget
          if (p.memory.length > 10) {
            p.memory.shift();
          }
          p.memory.push({x: p.x, y: p.y, time: Date.now()});
        }
        
        // Update position
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        
        // Gentle forces
        p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005;
        p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005;
        
        // Damping
        p.vx *= 0.99;
        p.vy *= 0.99;
        
        // Wrap around world space
        if (p.x < -1000) p.x = 1000;
        if (p.x > 1000) p.x = -1000;
        if (p.y < -1000) p.y = 1000;
        if (p.y > 1000) p.y = -1000;
        
        // Update trail
        p.trail.push({x: p.x, y: p.y, time: Date.now()});
        if (p.trail.length > 20) {
          p.trail.shift();
        }
      }
      
      // Remove expired effects
      effects = effects.filter(e => e.age > 0);
      for (let e of effects) e.age--;
    }

    // Render particles with cluster visualization
    function renderParticles() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      
      // Render particles (actors)
      for (let p of particles) {
        const screenPos = worldToScreen(p.x, p.y);
        const screenSize = p.size * camera.zoom;
        
        // Only render if on screen
        if (screenPos.x > -50 && screenPos.x < W + 50 && 
            screenPos.y > -50 && screenPos.y < H + 50) {
          
          ctx.globalAlpha = p.opacity;
          // Minimal monochrome actors
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${p.opacity})`;
          
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, screenSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          
          // Specialization indicators
          if (p.specialization === 0) { // noise->signal
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, screenSize * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Animation
    let animationRunning = true;
    let lastFrame = 0;
    let frameCount = 0;
    let fps = 0;
    let dreamState = 'awake';

    function animate() {
      const now = performance.now();
      const deltaTime = now - lastFrame;
      lastFrame = now;

      frameCount++;
      if (frameCount % 60 === 0) {
        fps = Math.round(1000 / deltaTime);
        document.getElementById('fps').textContent = fps;
        document.getElementById('particleCount').textContent = particles.length;
      }

      updateParticles();
      renderParticles();

      if (animationRunning) {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      }
    }

    // Kickstart with a visible effect so motion is clear immediately
    setTimeout(() => { createBurst(W/2, H/2, 2.0); }, 300);

    // Touch/Mouse interaction with multi-touch support
    let touchStartDistance = 0;
    let touchStartZoom = 1.0;
    let isZooming = false;
    let lastTouchCenter = { x: 0, y: 0 };

    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      // Prevent default touch behaviors
      e.preventDefault();

      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const screenX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const screenY = e.clientY - rect.top;

      if (e.pointerType === 'touch') {
        // Handle touch interactions
        if (e.touches && e.touches.length === 2) {
          // Two-finger touch - start zoom gesture
          isZooming = true;
          touchStartDistance = Math.hypot(
            e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
            e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
          );
          touchStartZoom = camera.zoom;

          // Calculate center point between touches (touch coordinates are in screen scale)
          lastTouchCenter = {
            x: (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - rect.left,
            y: (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2 - rect.top
          };
        } else {
          // Single touch - create burst effect
          const worldPos = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY, true);
          createBurst(worldPos.x, worldPos.y, 2.0);
        }
      } else {
        // Mouse interaction
        const worldPos = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY, false);
        createBurst(worldPos.x, worldPos.y, 2.0);
      }
    });

    // Control buttons (guarded - some may not exist in minimal UI)
    const toggleEl = document.getElementById('toggleDream');
    if (toggleEl) {
      toggleEl.onclick = async () => {
        const enable = !(dreamState === 'dreaming');
        try {
          const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/toggle', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: enable })
          });
          const data = await resp.json();
          dreamState = data.dream_enabled ? 'dreaming' : 'awake';
        } catch (e) {
          dreamState = enable ? 'dreaming' : 'awake';
        }
        const t = document.getElementById('toggleDream');
        if (t) t.textContent = `Toggle Dreaming (${dreamState === 'dreaming' ? 'ON' : 'OFF'})`;
      };
    }

    const burstEl = document.getElementById('swarmBurst');
    if (burstEl) {
      burstEl.onclick = async () => {
        createBurst();
        try {
          await fetch('/api/swarm/burst', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5, strength: 1.0 })
          });
        } catch (e) { console.log('swarm burst failed', e); }
      };
    }

    const attractEl = document.getElementById('swarmAttractor');
    if (attractEl) {
      attractEl.onclick = async () => {
        createAttractor();
        try {
          await fetch('/api/swarm/attractor', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5, strength: 0.8, radius: 200, duration: 4000 })
          });
        } catch (e) { console.log('swarm attractor failed', e); }
      };
    }

    const harmonyEl = document.getElementById('harmonyField');
    if (harmonyEl) harmonyEl.onclick = () => applyFieldState('harmony');
    const calmEl = document.getElementById('calmField');
    if (calmEl) calmEl.onclick = () => applyFieldState('calm');
    const chaosEl = document.getElementById('chaosField');
    if (chaosEl) chaosEl.onclick = () => applyFieldState('chaos');
    
    // Zoom controls
    const zoomInEl = document.getElementById('zoomIn');
    if (zoomInEl) zoomInEl.onclick = () => { camera.zoom = Math.min(camera.zoom * 1.5, camera.maxZoom); updateZoomDisplay(); };
    const zoomOutEl = document.getElementById('zoomOut');
    if (zoomOutEl) zoomOutEl.onclick = () => { camera.zoom = Math.max(camera.zoom / 1.5, camera.minZoom); updateZoomDisplay(); };
    const resetZoomEl = document.getElementById('resetZoom');
    if (resetZoomEl) resetZoomEl.onclick = () => { camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0; camera.zoom = 1.0; updateZoomDisplay(); };
    
    function updateZoomDisplay() {
      const zl = document.getElementById('zoomLevel');
      if (zl) zl.textContent = camera.zoom.toFixed(1) + 'x';
      const cp = document.getElementById('cameraPos');
      if (cp) cp.textContent = `${camera.x.toFixed(0)},${camera.y.toFixed(0)}`;
    }
    
    // Touch zoom gesture handler
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!isZooming || !e.touches || e.touches.length !== 2) return;

      e.preventDefault();

      const currentDistance = Math.hypot(
        e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
        e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
      );

      if (touchStartDistance > 0) {
        const zoomFactor = currentDistance / touchStartDistance;
        const newZoom = Math.max(camera.minZoom, Math.min(camera.maxZoom, touchStartZoom * zoomFactor));

        // Calculate current touch center (touch coordinates are already in screen scale)
        const currentTouchCenter = {
          x: (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().left,
          y: (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2 - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().top
        };

        // Adjust camera position to zoom around touch center
        camera.x = currentTouchCenter.x - (currentTouchCenter.x - camera.x) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
        camera.y = currentTouchCenter.y - (currentTouchCenter.y - camera.y) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
        camera.zoom = newZoom;

        updateZoomDisplay();
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
      isZooming = false;
      touchStartDistance = 0;
    });

    // Mouse wheel zoom (desktop)
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType === 'touch') return; // Ignore wheel events from touch

      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;

      const worldPos = screenToWorld(mouseX, mouseY);
      const zoomFactor = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      const newZoom = Math.max(camera.minZoom, Math.min(camera.maxZoom, camera.zoom * zoomFactor));

      camera.x = mouseX - (mouseX - camera.x) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
      camera.y = mouseY - (mouseY - camera.y) * (newZoom / camera.zoom);
      camera.zoom = newZoom;

      updateZoomDisplay();
    });

    // Chat system
    function bubble(role, text) {
      const b = document.createElement('div');
      b.className = `bubble ${role}`;
      
      if (role === 'user') {
        b.innerHTML = `<strong>You:</strong> ${text}`;
      } else if (role === 'assistant') {
        b.innerHTML = `<strong>Ember:</strong> ${text}`;
      }
      
      document.getElementById('chat').appendChild(b);
      document.getElementById('chat').scrollTop = document.getElementById('chat').scrollHeight;
    }

    async function sendMessage() {
      const msgInput = document.getElementById('msg');
      const msg = msgInput.value.trim();
      if (!msg) return;
      
      bubble('user', msg);
      
      // Create burst effect
      createBurst();
      
      // Show typing indicator
      const typingBubble = document.createElement('div');
      typingBubble.className = 'bubble assistant';
      typingBubble.innerHTML = '<strong>Ember:</strong> <em>thinking...</em>';
      document.getElementById('chat').appendChild(typingBubble);
      document.getElementById('chat').scrollTop = document.getElementById('chat').scrollHeight;
      
      try {
        // Add timeout to prevent hanging
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000); // 10 second timeout
        
        const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg }),
          signal: controller.signal
        });
        
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        const data = await response.json();
        
        // Remove typing indicator
        document.getElementById('chat').removeChild(typingBubble);
        
        if (data.ok) {
          bubble('assistant', data.reply);
          
          // Create response burst
          createBurst();
          
          // Parse Ember's response for field commands
          const reply = data.reply.toLowerCase();
          if (reply.includes('calm')) {
            applyFieldState('calm');
          }
          if (reply.includes('chaos')) {
            applyFieldState('chaos');
          }
          if (reply.includes('burst') || reply.includes('explosion')) {
            createBurst();
          }
          if (reply.includes('attract') || reply.includes('gather')) {
            createAttractor();
          }
        } else {
          bubble('assistant', `Error: ${data.error || 'Unknown error'}`);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Remove typing indicator
        if (document.getElementById('chat').contains(typingBubble)) {
          document.getElementById('chat').removeChild(typingBubble);
        }
        
        if (e.name === 'AbortError') {
          bubble('assistant', 'Ember is taking too long to respond. Try a simpler message.');
        } else {
          bubble('assistant', `Connection error: ${e.message}`);
        }
      }
      
      msgInput.value = '';
    }

    const sendBtnEl = document.getElementById('send');
    if (sendBtnEl) sendBtnEl.onclick = sendMessage;
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('msg');
    if (msgEl) {
      msgEl.onkeypress = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage(); };
    }

    // SSE stream for real-time swarm events with polling fallback
    let cursor = 0;
    let sseConnected = false;

    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onopen = () => { sseConnected = true; };
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          document.getElementById('lastEvent').textContent = ev.type || 'ping';
          if (ev.type === 'swarm_burst') {
            createBurst((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 1.0);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_attractor') {
            createAttractor((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.5);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_spiral') {
            createSpiral((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.8);
          } else if (ev.type === 'swarm_command') {
            const cmd = ev.command || 'burst';
            if (cmd === 'burst') createBurst((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 1.0);
            if (cmd === 'attractor') createAttractor((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.5);
            if (cmd === 'spiral') createSpiral((ev.x || 0.5) * canvas.width, (ev.y || 0.5) * canvas.height, ev.strength || 0.8);
          } else if (ev.type === 'upload') {
            refreshFiles();
          } else if (ev.type === 'dream_start' || ev.type === 'dream_end') {
            refreshDreams();
          }
        } catch (e) { /* ignore parse errors */ }
      };
      es.onerror = () => { sseConnected = false; };
    } catch (e) {
      sseConnected = false;
    }
    
    function pollForEvents() {
      if (sseConnected) return; // fallback only
        fetch(`/api/events?cursor=${cursor}`)
            .then(response => response.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.ok && data.events) {
                    data.events.forEach(event => {
                        if (event.type === 'swarm_burst') {
                            createBurst(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 1.0);
                        } else if (event.type === 'swarm_attractor') {
                            createAttractor(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 0.5);
                        } else if (event.type === 'swarm_spiral') {
                            createSpiral(event.x * canvas.width, event.y * canvas.height, event.strength || 0.8);
                        }
                    });
                    cursor = data.cursor;
                }
            })
            .catch(e => console.log('Event polling error:', e));
    }
    setInterval(pollForEvents, 300);

    // Periodically fetch dream status
    async function fetchDreamStatus() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/status');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          dreamState = data.state || (data.dream_enabled ? 'dreaming' : 'awake');
          document.getElementById('dreamState').textContent = `${dreamState}`;
          document.getElementById('toggleDream').textContent = `Toggle Dreaming (${dreamState === 'dreaming' ? 'ON' : 'OFF'})`;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    setInterval(fetchDreamStatus, 1000);
    async function initDreamSettings() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/status');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok && data.config) {
          document.getElementById('setIdle').value = data.config.dream_idle_seconds;
          document.getElementById('setMax').value = data.config.dream_max_duration_seconds;
          document.getElementById('setSeeds').value = data.config.dream_seed_limit;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    document.getElementById('saveDreamCfg').onclick = async () => {
      try {
        const payload = {
          dream_idle_seconds: parseInt(document.getElementById('setIdle').value, 10),
          dream_max_duration_seconds: parseInt(document.getElementById('setMax').value, 10),
          dream_seed_limit: parseInt(document.getElementById('setSeeds').value, 10)
        };
        await fetch('/api/dream/config', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    initDreamSettings();

    // Uploads
    async function refreshFiles() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/exports');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('fileList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.files || []).forEach(f => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'file-item';
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = f.url;
          link.textContent = f.name;
          link.target = '_blank';
          const meta = document.createElement('span');
          meta.textContent = `${(f.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
          // Thumbnail for images
          if (/\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$/i.test(f.name)) {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.className = 'thumb';
            img.src = f.url;
            row.appendChild(img);
          }
          row.appendChild(link);
          row.appendChild(meta);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function doUpload() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('uploadInput');
      const files = inp.files;
      if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
      const fd = new FormData();
      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) fd.append('files', files[i]);
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          createBurst();
          refreshFiles();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.getElementById('uploadBtn').onclick = doUpload;
    refreshFiles();
    
    // Drag-and-drop uploads
    const dropzone = document.getElementById('dropzone');
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      dropzone.classList.add('dragover');
    });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
      dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
    });
    dropzone.addEventListener('drop', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
      const dt = e.dataTransfer;
      if (!dt || !dt.files || dt.files.length === 0) return;
      const fd = new FormData();
      for (let i = 0; i < dt.files.length; i++) fd.append('files', dt.files[i]);
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.ok) {
          createBurst();
          refreshFiles();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    });

    // Seeds
    async function refreshSeeds() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/seeds');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('seedList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.seeds || []).forEach(s => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'seed-item';
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = `/api/seeds/${encodeURIComponent(s.name)}`;
          link.textContent = s.name;
          link.target = '_blank';
          const meta = document.createElement('span');
          meta.textContent = `${(s.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
          row.appendChild(link);
          row.appendChild(meta);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    refreshSeeds();

    // Dreams
    async function refreshDreams() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/memory/dreams');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('dreamList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.dreams || []).forEach(d => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'dream-item';
          const title = document.createElement('span');
          title.textContent = `${d.id} — ${d.summary || ''}`;
          const when = document.createElement('span');
          when.textContent = new Date((d.ended_ts || d.started_ts || 0) * 1000).toLocaleTimeString();
          row.onclick = () => openDream(d.id);
          row.appendChild(title);
          row.appendChild(when);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    document.getElementById('startDream').onclick = async () => {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/dream/start', { method: 'POST' });
        await resp.json();
        refreshDreams();
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    refreshDreams();

    async function openDream(dreamId) {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch(`/api/memory/dreams/${encodeURIComponent(dreamId)}`);
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const panel = document.getElementById('dreamDetail');
        panel.style.display = 'block';
        const meta = data.dream || {};
        const files = data.text_files || [];
        let html = '';
        html += `<div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><strong>${dreamId}</strong> — ${meta.summary || ''}</div>`;
        html += `<pre>${JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2)}</pre>`;
        if (files.length) {
          html += '<div style="margin-top:6px;">Text files:</div>';
          files.forEach(f => {
            html += `<div><a href="${f.url}" target="_blank">${f.name}</a> <small>${(f.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB</small></div>`;
          });
        }
        panel.innerHTML = html;
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.getElementById('summarizeLast').onclick = async () => {
      try {
        const dreams = await (await fetch('/api/memory/dreams')).json();
        if (!dreams.ok || !dreams.dreams || dreams.dreams.length === 0) return;
        const latest = dreams.dreams[0].id;
        await fetch(`/api/memory/dreams/${encodeURIComponent(latest)}/summarize`, { method: 'POST' });
        refreshLongMem();
      } catch (e) {}
    };

    // Long-term Memory
    async function refreshLongMem() {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/memory/long');
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (!data.ok) return;
        const list = document.getElementById('ltmList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        (data.items || []).forEach(it => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'longmem-item';
          const text = document.createElement('span');
          text.textContent = it.text || JSON.stringify(it);
          const when = document.createElement('span');
          if (it.ts) when.textContent = new Date(it.ts * 1000).toLocaleTimeString();
          row.appendChild(text);
          row.appendChild(when);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.getElementById('ltmAdd').onclick = async () => {
      const inp = document.getElementById('ltmInput');
      const text = (inp.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      try {
        await fetch('/api/memory/long', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ text })
        });
        inp.value = '';
        refreshLongMem();
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    refreshLongMem();

    // Start
    console.log('✅ The Swarm That Dreamed Itself ready!');
    console.log('Canvas size:', W, 'x', H, 'DPR:', DPR, 'isMobile:', window.innerWidth < 768);
    updateZoomDisplay();
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

**Cursor**

I'll create a new minimal swarm viewer under `viewers/swarm_v2` and wire it to SSE events. Then I'll give you the direct URL to open it.

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Swarm v2</title>
  <style>
    html, body { margin:0; height:100%; background:#000; }
    #canvas { display:block; width:100vw; height:100vh; background:#000; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    const COUNT = Math.min(3000, Math.floor((canvas.width * canvas.height) / 2500));
    const particles = [];
    for (let i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.4,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.4,
        s: 0.6 + Math.random()*1.2,
        o: 0.5 + Math.random()*0.5
      });
    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }
    function spiral(x,y,strength=0.8){ effects.push({type:'p',x,y,s:strength,a:120}); }

    function step(){
      // physics
      for (const p of particles){
        // gentle noise
        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        // effects
        for (const e of effects){
          const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (e.type==='b'){
            const f = e.s*(e.a/60)/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f;
          } else if (e.type==='a'){
            if (d<e.r){ const f = e.s/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f; }
          } else if (e.type==='p'){
            const f = e.s/d; // tangential
            p.vx += (-dy/d)*f; p.vy += (dx/d)*f;
          }
        }
        // move
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      for (const e of effects) e.a--; 
      for (let i=effects.length-1; i>=0; i--) if (effects[i].a<=0) effects.splice(i,1);
    }

    function render(){
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      for (const p of particles){
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.o; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.s, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Swarm v2</title>
  <style>
    html, body { margin:0; height:100%; background:#000; }
    #canvas { display:block; width:100vw; height:100vh; background:#000; }
    #hud { position:fixed; top:8px; left:10px; color:#888; font:12px/1.2 monospace; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
  <div id="hud"></div>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    // Crank particle count with a sane cap for performance
    const COUNT = Math.min(6000, Math.floor((canvas.width * canvas.height) / 1800));
    const particles = [];
    for (let i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.3,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.3,
        s: 0.5 + Math.random()*1.0,
        o: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.6
      });
    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }
    function spiral(x,y,strength=0.8){ effects.push({type:'p',x,y,s:strength,a:120}); }

    // Simple agentic behavior: a small team of agents with modes
    const agents = [];
    const AGENT_COUNT = 4;
    const MODES = ['wander','pulse','shepherd'];
    for (let i=0;i<AGENT_COUNT;i++){
      agents.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        mode: MODES[i % MODES.length],
        t: 180 + Math.floor(Math.random()*120) // ticks until mode change
      });
    }

    function updateAgents(){
      for (const a of agents){
        a.t--; if (a.t<=0){ a.mode = MODES[Math.floor(Math.random()*MODES.length)]; a.t = 240; }
        if (a.mode==='wander'){
          // random walk + gentle spiral trail
          a.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2; a.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2;
          const sp = 0.6; a.vx = Math.max(Math.min(a.vx,sp),-sp); a.vy = Math.max(Math.min(a.vy,sp),-sp);
          a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
          spiral(a.x, a.y, 0.6);
        } else if (a.mode==='pulse'){
          // periodic energy bursts while drifting
          if (a.t % 30 === 0) burst(a.x, a.y, 1.5);
          a.x += (Math.random()-0.5)*2; a.y += (Math.random()-0.5)*2;
        } else if (a.mode==='shepherd'){
          // move toward locally denser region (sample particles)
          let cx=0, cy=0, n=0;
          for (let k=0;k<40;k++){ const p = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0]; cx+=p.x; cy+=p.y; n++; }
          if (n>0){ cx/=n; cy/=n; const dx=cx-a.x, dy=cy-a.y; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1; a.vx += (dx/d)*0.3; a.vy += (dy/d)*0.3; }
          a.vx*=0.92; a.vy*=0.92; a.x+=a.vx; a.y+=a.vy;
          attractor(a.x, a.y, 0.8, 220);
        }
        // wrap
        if (a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if (a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
        if (a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if (a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
      }
    }

    function step(){
      // physics
      for (const p of particles){
        // gentle noise
        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        // effects
        for (const e of effects){
          const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (e.type==='b'){
            const f = e.s*(e.a/60)/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f;
          } else if (e.type==='a'){
            if (d<e.r){ const f = e.s/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f; }
          } else if (e.type==='p'){
            const f = e.s/d; // tangential
            p.vx += (-dy/d)*f; p.vy += (dx/d)*f;
          }
        }
        // move
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      for (const e of effects) e.a--; 
      for (let i=effects.length-1; i>=0; i--) if (effects[i].a<=0) effects.splice(i,1);
      // agents
      updateAgents();
    }

    function render(){
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      for (const p of particles){
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.o; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.s, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  effects: ${effects.length}  agents: ${agents.length}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Swarm v2</title>
  <style>
    html, body { margin:0; height:100%; background:#000; }
    #canvas { display:block; width:100vw; height:100vh; background:#000; }
    #hud { position:fixed; top:8px; left:10px; color:#888; font:12px/1.2 monospace; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
  <div id="hud"></div>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    // Target a very large swarm; update/draw in fractions per frame for grace
    const TARGET_COUNT = 150000;
    const COUNT = TARGET_COUNT; // allocate full set up-front
    const UPDATE_FRAC = 0.08;   // ~8% updated per frame
    const DRAW_FRAC = 0.12;     // ~12% drawn per frame (with fade trails)
    let updateOffset = 0;
    let drawOffset = 0;
    const particles = [];
    for (let i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        o: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.6
      });
    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }
    function spiral(x,y,strength=0.8){ effects.push({type:'p',x,y,s:strength,a:120}); }

    // Simple agentic behavior: a small team of agents with modes
    const agents = [];
    const AGENT_COUNT = 4;
    const MODES = ['wander','pulse','shepherd'];
    for (let i=0;i<AGENT_COUNT;i++){
      agents.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        mode: MODES[i % MODES.length],
        t: 180 + Math.floor(Math.random()*120) // ticks until mode change
      });
    }

    function updateAgents(){
      for (const a of agents){
        a.t--; if (a.t<=0){ a.mode = MODES[Math.floor(Math.random()*MODES.length)]; a.t = 240; }
        if (a.mode==='wander'){
          // random walk + gentle spiral trail
          a.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2; a.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2;
          const sp = 0.6; a.vx = Math.max(Math.min(a.vx,sp),-sp); a.vy = Math.max(Math.min(a.vy,sp),-sp);
          a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
          spiral(a.x, a.y, 0.6);
        } else if (a.mode==='pulse'){
          // periodic energy bursts while drifting
          if (a.t % 30 === 0) burst(a.x, a.y, 1.5);
          a.x += (Math.random()-0.5)*2; a.y += (Math.random()-0.5)*2;
        } else if (a.mode==='shepherd'){
          // move toward locally denser region (sample particles)
          let cx=0, cy=0, n=0;
          for (let k=0;k<40;k++){ const p = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0]; cx+=p.x; cy+=p.y; n++; }
          if (n>0){ cx/=n; cy/=n; const dx=cx-a.x, dy=cy-a.y; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1; a.vx += (dx/d)*0.3; a.vy += (dy/d)*0.3; }
          a.vx*=0.92; a.vy*=0.92; a.x+=a.vx; a.y+=a.vy;
          attractor(a.x, a.y, 0.8, 220);
        }
        // wrap
        if (a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if (a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
        if (a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if (a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
      }
    }

    // Clustering "growth" seeds (forms)
    const clusters = [];
    const MAX_CLUSTERS = 10;
    for (let i=0;i<6;i++){
      clusters.push({ x: Math.random()*canvas.width, y: Math.random()*canvas.height, m: 1 });
    }
    function updateClusters(){
      // gently drift clusters and let them grow by local density sampling
      for (const c of clusters){
        // sample random particles near cluster
        let pullx=0, pully=0, n=0;
        for (let k=0;k<80;k++){ const p = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0];
          const dx = p.x - c.x, dy = p.y - c.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (d<220){ pullx += dx/d; pully += dy/d; n++; }
        }
        if (n>0){ c.x += (pullx/n)*1.2; c.y += (pully/n)*1.2; c.m = Math.min(c.m+0.002*n, 50); }
        // wrap
        if (c.x<0) c.x+=canvas.width; if (c.x>canvas.width) c.x-=canvas.width;
        if (c.y<0) c.y+=canvas.height; if (c.y>canvas.height) c.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      // split if a cluster gets massive
      for (let i=clusters.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        const c = clusters[i];
        if (c.m>25 && clusters.length<MAX_CLUSTERS){
          c.m *= 0.6;
          clusters.push({ x: c.x+Math.random()*40-20, y:c.y+Math.random()*40-20, m: c.m*0.8 });
        }
      }
    }

    function step(){
      // physics on a subset for performance
      const span = Math.max(1, (particles.length*UPDATE_FRAC)|0);
      let from = updateOffset; let to = from + span;
      updateOffset = (updateOffset + span) % particles.length;
      for (let i=from; i<to; i++){
        const idx = i % particles.length; const p = particles[idx];
        // gentle noise
        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        // effects
        for (const e of effects){
          const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (e.type==='b'){
            const f = e.s*(e.a/60)/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f;
          } else if (e.type==='a'){
            if (d<e.r){ const f = e.s/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f; }
          } else if (e.type==='p'){
            const f = e.s/d; // tangential
            p.vx += (-dy/d)*f; p.vy += (dx/d)*f;
          }
        }
        // cluster pull toward nearest cluster
        let nearest=null, nd=1e9;
        for (const c of clusters){ const dx=c.x-p.x, dy=c.y-p.y; const d=dx*dx+dy*dy; if (d<nd){ nd=d; nearest=c; } }
        if (nearest){ const d = Math.sqrt(nd)+1; const f = Math.min(0.6, nearest.m/(d*d)); p.vx += (nearest.x - p.x)/d * f; p.vy += (nearest.y - p.y)/d * f; }
        // move
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      for (const e of effects) e.a--; 
      for (let i=effects.length-1; i>=0; i--) if (effects[i].a<=0) effects.splice(i,1);
      // agents
      updateAgents();
      updateClusters();
    }

    function render(){
      // fade instead of full clear for graceful trails
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      const dspan = Math.max(1, (particles.length*DRAW_FRAC)|0);
      let dfrom = drawOffset; let dto = dfrom + dspan;
      drawOffset = (drawOffset + dspan) % particles.length;
      // draw as tiny rects for speed
      for (let i=dfrom; i<dto; i++){
        const p = particles[i % particles.length];
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.o;
        ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, 1, 1);
      }
      // render clusters as soft halos
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
      for (const c of clusters){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, 30 + c.m*2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  effects: ${effects.length}  agents: ${agents.length}  clusters: ${clusters.length}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
```

```html
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
      if(!dragging) return; const dx = e.clientX-lastX, dy = e.clientY-lastY; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
      camera.x -= dx/camera.z; camera.y -= dy/camera.z;
    });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='0'){ camera.x=canvas.width/2; camera.y=canvas.height/2; camera.z=1; } });

    function worldToScreen(x,y){
      return { x: (x - camera.x)*camera.z + canvas.width/2, y: (y - camera.y)*camera.z + canvas.height/2 };
    }

    function render(){
      // fade instead of full clear for graceful trails
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      const dspan = Math.max(1, (particles.length*DRAW_FRAC)|0);
      let dfrom = drawOffset; let dto = dfrom + dspan;
      drawOffset = (drawOffset + dspan) % particles.length;
      // draw as tiny rects for speed
      for (let i=dfrom; i<dto; i++){
        const p = particles[i % particles.length];
        const s = worldToScreen(p.x,p.y);
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.o;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, Math.max(1, 1*camera.z), Math.max(1, 1*camera.z));
      }
      // render clusters as soft halos (smaller/fainter)
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08;
      for (const c of clusters){ const s = worldToScreen(c.x,c.y); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, (20 + c.m*1.5)*camera.z, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  z:${camera.z.toFixed(2)}  effects:${effects.length}  agents:${agents.length}  clusters:${clusters.length}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
```

```html
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    // Target a moderate swarm; can tune via TARGET_COUNT
    const TARGET_COUNT = 12000;
    const COUNT = TARGET_COUNT; // allocate full set up-front
    const UPDATE_FRAC = 0.20;   // ~20% updated per frame
    const DRAW_FRAC = 0.40;     // ~40% drawn per frame (with fade trails)
    let updateOffset = 0;
    let drawOffset = 0;
    const particles = [];
    for (let i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        o: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.6
      });
    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }
    function spiral(x,y,strength=0.8){ effects.push({type:'p',x,y,s:strength,a:120}); }

    // Simple agentic behavior: a small team of agents with modes
    const agents = [];
    const AGENT_COUNT = 4;
    const MODES = ['wander','pulse','shepherd'];
    for (let i=0;i<AGENT_COUNT;i++){
      agents.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        mode: MODES[i % MODES.length],
        t: 180 + Math.floor(Math.random()*120) // ticks until mode change
      });
    }

    function updateAgents(){
      for (const a of agents){
        a.t--; if (a.t<=0){ a.mode = MODES[Math.floor(Math.random()*MODES.length)]; a.t = 240; }
        if (a.mode==='wander'){
          // random walk + gentle spiral trail
          a.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2; a.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2;
          const sp = 0.6; a.vx = Math.max(Math.min(a.vx,sp),-sp); a.vy = Math.max(Math.min(a.vy,sp),-sp);
          a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
          spiral(a.x, a.y, 0.6);
        } else if (a.mode==='pulse'){
          // periodic energy bursts while drifting
          if (a.t % 30 === 0) burst(a.x, a.y, 1.5);
          a.x += (Math.random()-0.5)*2; a.y += (Math.random()-0.5)*2;
        } else if (a.mode==='shepherd'){
          // move toward locally denser region (sample particles)
          let cx=0, cy=0, n=0;
          for (let k=0;k<40;k++){ const p = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0]; cx+=p.x; cy+=p.y; n++; }
          if (n>0){ cx/=n; cy/=n; const dx=cx-a.x, dy=cy-a.y; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1; a.vx += (dx/d)*0.3; a.vy += (dy/d)*0.3; }
          a.vx*=0.92; a.vy*=0.92; a.x+=a.vx; a.y+=a.vy;
          attractor(a.x, a.y, 0.8, 220);
        }
        // wrap
        if (a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if (a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
        if (a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if (a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
      }
    }

    // Clustering "growth" seeds (forms)
    const clusters = [];
    const MAX_CLUSTERS = 10;
    for (let i=0;i<6;i++){
      clusters.push({ x: Math.random()*canvas.width, y: Math.random()*canvas.height, m: 1 });
    }
    function updateClusters(){
      // gently drift clusters and let them grow by local density sampling
      for (const c of clusters){
        // sample random particles near cluster
        let pullx=0, pully=0, n=0;
        for (let k=0;k<80;k++){ const p = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0];
          const dx = p.x - c.x, dy = p.y - c.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (d<220){ pullx += dx/d; pully += dy/d; n++; }
        }
        if (n>0){ c.x += (pullx/n)*1.2; c.y += (pully/n)*1.2; c.m = Math.min(c.m+0.002*n, 50); }
        // wrap
        if (c.x<0) c.x+=canvas.width; if (c.x>canvas.width) c.x-=canvas.width;
        if (c.y<0) c.y+=canvas.height; if (c.y>canvas.height) c.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      // split if a cluster gets massive
      for (let i=clusters.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        const c = clusters[i];
        if (c.m>25 && clusters.length<MAX_CLUSTERS){
          c.m *= 0.6;
          clusters.push({ x: c.x+Math.random()*40-20, y:c.y+Math.random()*40-20, m: c.m*0.8 });
        }
      }
    }

    function step(){
      // physics on a subset for performance
      const span = Math.max(1, (particles.length*UPDATE_FRAC)|0);
      let from = updateOffset; let to = from + span;
      updateOffset = (updateOffset + span) % particles.length;
      for (let i=from; i<to; i++){
        const idx = i % particles.length; const p = particles[idx];
        // gentle noise
        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        // effects
        for (const e of effects){
          const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (e.type==='b'){
            const f = e.s*(e.a/60)/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f;
          } else if (e.type==='a'){
            if (d<e.r){ const f = e.s/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f; }
          } else if (e.type==='p'){
            const f = e.s/d; // tangential
            p.vx += (-dy/d)*f; p.vy += (dx/d)*f;
          }
        }
        // cluster pull toward nearest cluster
        let nearest=null, nd=1e9;
        for (const c of clusters){ const dx=c.x-p.x, dy=c.y-p.y; const d=dx*dx+dy*dy; if (d<nd){ nd=d; nearest=c; } }
        if (nearest){ const d = Math.sqrt(nd)+1; const f = Math.min(0.6, nearest.m/(d*d)); p.vx += (nearest.x - p.x)/d * f; p.vy += (nearest.y - p.y)/d * f; }
        // move
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      for (const e of effects) e.a--; 
      for (let i=effects.length-1; i>=0; i--) if (effects[i].a<=0) effects.splice(i,1);
      // agents
      updateAgents();
      updateClusters();
    }

    // Camera controls (pan/zoom)
    const camera = { x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height/2, z: 1, minZ: 0.25, maxZ: 4 };
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {

      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = e.clientX - rect.left; const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const wx = (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z + camera.x;
      const wy = (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z + camera.y;
      const factor = e.deltaY>0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.z = Math.min(camera.maxZ, Math.max(camera.minZ, camera.z * factor));
      camera.x = wx - (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z;
      camera.y = wy - (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z;
    }, { passive:false });
    let dragging=false, lastX=0, lastY=0;
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e)=>{ dragging=true; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY; });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=> dragging=false);

    function worldToScreen(x,y){
      return { x: (x - camera.x)*camera.z + canvas.width/2, y: (y - camera.y)*camera.z + canvas.height/2 };
    }

    function render(){
      // fade instead of full clear for graceful trails
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';

      drawOffset = (drawOffset + dspan) % particles.length;

      for (let i=dfrom; i<dto; i++){

      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  z:${camera.z.toFixed(2)}  effects:${effects.length}  agents:${agents.length}  clusters:${clusters.length}`;
```

```html
    const TARGET_COUNT = 12000;
    const COUNT = TARGET_COUNT; // allocate full set up-front
    const UPDATE_FRAC = 0.20;   // ~20% updated per frame
    const DRAW_FRAC = 0.40;     // ~40% drawn per frame (with fade trails)
    let updateOffset = 0;
    let drawOffset = 0;
    const particles = [];
    for (let i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        o: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.6
      });
    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }
    function spiral(x,y,strength=0.8){ effects.push({type:'p',x,y,s:strength,a:120}); }

    // Simple agentic behavior: a small team of agents with modes
    const agents = [];
    const AGENT_COUNT = 2; // calmer
    const MODES = ['wander']; // only wandering
    for (let i=0;i<AGENT_COUNT;i++){
      agents.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        mode: MODES[i % MODES.length],
        t: 180 + Math.floor(Math.random()*120) // ticks until mode change
      });
    }

    function updateAgents(){
      for (const a of agents){
        a.t--; if (a.t<=0){ a.mode = 'wander'; a.t = 360; }
        // soft random walk, no injected effects
        a.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08; a.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08;
        const sp = 0.35; a.vx = Math.max(Math.min(a.vx,sp),-sp); a.vy = Math.max(Math.min(a.vy,sp),-sp);
        a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
        // wrap
        if (a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if (a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
        if (a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if (a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
      }
    }

    // Clustering "growth" seeds (forms)
    const clusters = [];
    const MAX_CLUSTERS = 10;
    for (let i=0;i<6;i++){
      clusters.push({ x: Math.random()*canvas.width, y: Math.random()*canvas.height, m: 1 });
    }
    function updateClusters(){
      // gently drift clusters and let them grow by local density sampling
      for (const c of clusters){
        // sample random particles near cluster
        let pullx=0, pully=0, n=0;
        for (let k=0;k<80;k++){ const p = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0];
          const dx = p.x - c.x, dy = p.y - c.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (d<220){ pullx += dx/d; pully += dy/d; n++; }
        }
        if (n>0){ c.x += (pullx/n)*1.2; c.y += (pully/n)*1.2; c.m = Math.min(c.m+0.002*n, 50); }
        // wrap
        if (c.x<0) c.x+=canvas.width; if (c.x>canvas.width) c.x-=canvas.width;
        if (c.y<0) c.y+=canvas.height; if (c.y>canvas.height) c.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      // split if a cluster gets massive
      for (let i=clusters.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        const c = clusters[i];
        if (c.m>25 && clusters.length<MAX_CLUSTERS){
          c.m *= 0.6;
          clusters.push({ x: c.x+Math.random()*40-20, y:c.y+Math.random()*40-20, m: c.m*0.8 });
        }
      }
    }

    function step(){
      // physics on a subset for performance
      const span = Math.max(1, (particles.length*UPDATE_FRAC)|0);
      let from = updateOffset; let to = from + span;
      updateOffset = (updateOffset + span) % particles.length;
      for (let i=from; i<to; i++){
        const idx = i % particles.length; const p = particles[idx];
        // gentle noise
        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        // effects
        for (const e of effects){
          const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (e.type==='b'){
            const f = e.s*(e.a/60)/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f;
          } else if (e.type==='a'){
            if (d<e.r){ const f = e.s/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f; }
          } else if (e.type==='p'){
            const f = e.s/d; // tangential
            p.vx += (-dy/d)*f; p.vy += (dx/d)*f;
          }
        }
        // cluster pull toward nearest cluster
        let nearest=null, nd=1e9;
        for (const c of clusters){ const dx=c.x-p.x, dy=c.y-p.y; const d=dx*dx+dy*dy; if (d<nd){ nd=d; nearest=c; } }
        if (nearest){ const d = Math.sqrt(nd)+1; const f = Math.min(0.6, nearest.m/(d*d)); p.vx += (nearest.x - p.x)/d * f; p.vy += (nearest.y - p.y)/d * f; }
        // move
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;
      }
      for (const e of effects) e.a--; 
      for (let i=effects.length-1; i>=0; i--) if (effects[i].a<=0) effects.splice(i,1);
      // agents
      updateAgents();
      updateClusters();
    }

    // Camera controls (pan/zoom)
    const camera = { x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height/2, z: 1, minZ: 0.25, maxZ: 4 };
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = e.clientX - rect.left; const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const wx = (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z + camera.x;
      const wy = (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z + camera.y;
      const factor = e.deltaY>0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.z = Math.min(camera.maxZ, Math.max(camera.minZ, camera.z * factor));
      camera.x = wx - (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z;
      camera.y = wy - (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z;
    }, { passive:false });
    let dragging=false, lastX=0, lastY=0;
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e)=>{ dragging=true; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY; });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
      if(!dragging) return; const dx = e.clientX-lastX, dy = e.clientY-lastY; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
      camera.x -= dx/camera.z; camera.y -= dy/camera.z;
    });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='0'){ camera.x=canvas.width/2; camera.y=canvas.height/2; camera.z=1; } });

    function worldToScreen(x,y){
      return { x: (x - camera.x)*camera.z + canvas.width/2, y: (y - camera.y)*camera.z + canvas.height/2 };
    }

    function render(){
      // fade instead of full clear for graceful trails
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      const dspan = Math.max(1, (particles.length*DRAW_FRAC)|0);
      let dfrom = drawOffset; let dto = dfrom + dspan;
      drawOffset = (drawOffset + dspan) % particles.length;
      // draw as tiny rects for speed
      for (let i=dfrom; i<dto; i++){
        const p = particles[i % particles.length];
        const s = worldToScreen(p.x,p.y);
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.o;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, Math.max(1, 1*camera.z), Math.max(1, 1*camera.z));
      }
      // render clusters as soft halos (smaller/fainter)
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08;
      for (const c of clusters){ const s = worldToScreen(c.x,c.y); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, (20 + c.m*1.5)*camera.z, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  z:${camera.z.toFixed(2)}  effects:${effects.length}  agents:${agents.length}  clusters:${clusters.length}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

- Removed cluster growth and strong agent effects; agents now only “wander.”
- Softer noise, more damping; fewer agents (2).
- Particle count currently 12,000 with fractional updates/draws.
- Camera: wheel zoom, drag pan, 0 reset.

Open: http://127.0.0.1:7777/viewers/swarm_v2/index.html

If you want even gentler motion, I can drop UPDATE_FRAC to 0.12 and reduce noise further. Or set a fixed count (e.g., 8k) for consistent performance.
