```html
<body>
  <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
  <div id="hud"></div>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    // Target a cohesive swarm; tune here
    const TARGET_COUNT = 8000;
    const COUNT = TARGET_COUNT; // allocate full set up-front
    const UPDATE_FRAC = 0.20;   // ~20% updated per frame
    const DRAW_FRAC = 1.00;     // draw all particles each frame for single-layer feel
    let updateOffset = 0;
    let drawOffset = 0;
    let t = 0; // time for breeze
    const particles = [];
    const FREE_FRAC = 0.35; // ~35% do their own thing
    const MOODS = ['curious','shy','social','wanderer'];
    let FREE_COUNT = 0;
    // z-depth range for parallax: -5000 to +5000
    for (let i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      const isFree = (Math.random() < FREE_FRAC);
      const mood = MOODS[(Math.random()*MOODS.length)|0];
      const szRoll = Math.random();
      const baseSize = (szRoll < 0.05) ? (4 + Math.random()*2) : (szRoll < 0.15) ? (0.5 + Math.random()*0.5) : (1.2 + Math.random()*1.4);
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        z: (Math.random()-0.5)*10000, // depth: -5000 to +5000
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        vz: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.05,  // slow z drift
        o: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.6,
        free: isFree,
        mood: mood,
        gx: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        gy: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        gt: 300 + (Math.random()*600|0),
        // per-particle "personality" weights
        coh: 0.006 + Math.random()*0.012,   // cohesion weight
        ali: 0.006 + Math.random()*0.020,   // alignment weight
        sep: 0.030 + Math.random()*0.050,   // separation weight
        jit: 0.002 + Math.random()*0.004,   // jitter
        pS:  0.004 + Math.random()*0.008,   // pulse speed
        pPhi: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,      // pulse phase
        sz:  baseSize,                      // base size (varied)
        state: (Math.random()<0.5?'explore':'rest'),
        stateT: 240 + (Math.random()*480|0),
        decisionT: 60 + (Math.random()*120|0), // decision timer
        trailAlpha: (Math.random()<0.15) ? (0.15 + Math.random()*0.25) : 0, // only some leave trails
        trail: [],
        blobPts: 8 + ((Math.random()*8)|0), // amoeba vertices
        blobPhase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2
      });
      if (particles[i].free) FREE_COUNT++;
    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }
    function spiral(x,y,strength=0.8){ effects.push({type:'p',x,y,s:strength,a:120}); }

    // Simple agentic behavior: a small team of agents with modes
    const agents = [];
    const AGENT_COUNT = 2; // calmer
    const MODES = ['wander']; // only wandering
    for (let i=0;i<AGENT_COUNT;i++){
      agents.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        mode: MODES[i % MODES.length],
        t: 180 + Math.floor(Math.random()*120) // ticks until mode change
      });
    }

    function updateAgents(){
      for (const a of agents){
        a.t--; if (a.t<=0){ a.mode = 'wander'; a.t = 360; }
        // soft random walk, no injected effects
        a.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08; a.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08;
        const sp = 0.35; a.vx = Math.max(Math.min(a.vx,sp),-sp); a.vy = Math.max(Math.min(a.vy,sp),-sp);
        a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
        // wrap
        if (a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if (a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
        if (a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if (a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
      }
    }

    // Clustering disabled for calmer drift
    const clusters = [];
    function updateClusters(){}

    function step(){
      t += 1;
      // gentle global breeze that slowly rotates
      const bx = Math.cos(t * 0.0018) * 0.02;
      const by = Math.sin(t * 0.0013) * 0.015;
      // physics on a subset for performance
      const span = Math.max(1, (particles.length*UPDATE_FRAC)|0);
      let from = updateOffset; let to = from + span;
      updateOffset = (updateOffset + span) % particles.length;
      for (let i=from; i<to; i++){
        const idx = i % particles.length; const p = particles[idx];
        // state transitions tweak personality over time
        p.stateT--; if (p.stateT<=0){ p.state = (p.state==='rest'?'explore':'rest'); p.stateT = 240 + (Math.random()*480|0); }
        const stateBoost = (p.state==='explore') ? 1.0 : 0.6;
        // occasional "decisions" - sudden direction changes
        p.decisionT--; if (p.decisionT<=0){
          p.decisionT = 60 + (Math.random()*120|0);
          if (Math.random()<0.3){ p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.8; p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.8; } // dart
          else if (Math.random()<0.2){ p.vx *= 0.2; p.vy *= 0.2; } // pause
        }
        // gentle noise (calm) + personality jitter
        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*(0.003 + p.jit);
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*(0.003 + p.jit);
        // apply breeze
        p.vx += bx;
        p.vy += by;
        // effects
        for (const e of effects){
          const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (e.type==='b'){
            const f = 0.5*e.s*(e.a/60)/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f;
          } else if (e.type==='a'){
            if (d<e.r){ const f = 0.6*e.s/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f; }
          } else if (e.type==='p'){
            const f = 0.4*e.s/d; // tangential softer
            p.vx += (-dy/d)*f; p.vy += (dx/d)*f;
          }
        }
        // mood-based behavior
        if (p.free || p.mood==='wanderer'){
          // independent goal-seeking
          p.gt--; if (p.gt<=0){ p.gx = Math.random()*canvas.width; p.gy = Math.random()*canvas.height; p.gt = 300 + (Math.random()*600|0); }
          const dx = p.gx - p.x, dy = p.gy - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          p.vx += (dx/d)*0.04; p.vy += (dy/d)*0.04;
          p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02; p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        } else {
          // local flocking: cohesion, alignment, separation (personality-weighted)
          let cx=0, cy=0, nvx=0, nvy=0, sx=0, sy=0, n=0; const R=60, R2=R*R, Rsep=18, Rsep2=Rsep*Rsep;
          for (let k=0;k<16;k++){ const q = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0];
            const dx = q.x - p.x, dy = q.y - p.y; const d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy; if (d2<R2 && d2>0){ cx += q.x; cy += q.y; nvx += q.vx; nvy += q.vy; n++; if (d2<Rsep2){ sx -= dx; sy -= dy; } }
          }
          if (n>0){
            // cohesion (social mood seeks denser areas)
            cx/=n; cy/=n; let dx=cx-p.x, dy=cy-p.y; let d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
            const cohMult = (p.mood==='social') ? 2.0 : (p.mood==='shy') ? 0.3 : 1.0;
            p.vx += (dx/d)*(p.coh*stateBoost*cohMult);
            // alignment
            nvx/=n; nvy/=n; p.vx += nvx*(p.ali*stateBoost*0.6); p.vy += nvy*(p.ali*stateBoost*0.6);
            // separation (shy pushes harder away)
            const sepMult = (p.mood==='shy') ? 2.5 : 1.0;
            d=Math.hypot(sx,sy)+1; p.vx += (sx/d)*(p.sep*sepMult); p.vy += (sy/d)*(p.sep*sepMult);
          }
          // curious particles spiral around local center
          if (p.mood==='curious' && n>0){ const dx=cx-p.x, dy=cy-p.y; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1; p.vx += (-dy/d)*0.02; p.vy += (dx/d)*0.02; }
          // cluster pull toward nearest cluster
          if (n>10 && clusters.length<12){ clusters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, m: Math.min(8, 1.2 + n*0.2) }); }
          let nearest=null, nd=1e9;
          for (const c of clusters){ const dx=c.x-p.x, dy=c.y-p.y; const d=dx*dx+dy*dy; if (d<nd){ nd=d; nearest=c; } }
          if (nearest){ const d = Math.sqrt(nd)+1; const f = Math.min(0.4, nearest.m/(d*d)); p.vx += (nearest.x - p.x)/d * f; p.vy += (nearest.y - p.y)/d * f; }
        }
        // trail tracking
        if (p.trailAlpha>0){ p.trail.push({x:p.x, y:p.y, z:p.z, a:p.trailAlpha}); if (p.trail.length>12) p.trail.shift(); }
        // move (including z)
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.z += p.vz; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99; p.vz*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;
        // z wraps too (for infinite depth)
        if (p.z<-5000) p.z+=10000; if (p.z>5000) p.z-=10000;
      }
      for (const e of effects) e.a--; 
      for (let i=effects.length-1; i>=0; i--) if (effects[i].a<=0) effects.splice(i,1);
      // agents
      updateAgents();
      updateClusters();
    }

    // Camera controls (pan/zoom) - infinite zoom
    const camera = { x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height/2, z: 3 }; // start zoomed in
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = e.clientX - rect.left; const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const wx = (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z + camera.x;
      const wy = (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z + camera.y;
      const factor = e.deltaY>0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.z *= factor; // no limits
      camera.x = wx - (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z;
      camera.y = wy - (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z;
    }, { passive:false });
    let dragging=false, lastX=0, lastY=0;
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e)=>{ dragging=true; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY; });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
      if(!dragging) return; const dx = e.clientX-lastX, dy = e.clientY-lastY; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
      camera.x -= dx/camera.z; camera.y -= dy/camera.z;
    });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='0'){ camera.x=canvas.width/2; camera.y=canvas.height/2; camera.z=1; } });

    function worldToScreen(x,y,z){
      // perspective: z affects scale (closer = bigger)
      const perspective = 1000; // focal length
      const scale = perspective / (perspective + z);
      return {
        x: (x - camera.x)*camera.z*scale + canvas.width/2,
        y: (y - camera.y)*camera.z*scale + canvas.height/2,
        scale: scale
      };
    }

    function render(){
      // clear fully
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      // sort by z for proper depth ordering (back to front)
      const sorted = particles.slice().sort((a,b) => a.z - b.z);
      // draw trails first (only for particles with trails)
      for (const p of sorted){
        if (p.trailAlpha>0 && p.trail.length>1){
          ctx.globalAlpha = p.trailAlpha*0.6;
          ctx.beginPath();
          const s0 = worldToScreen(p.trail[0].x, p.trail[0].y, p.trail[0].z);
          ctx.moveTo(s0.x, s0.y);
          for (let j=1;j<p.trail.length;j++){ const s = worldToScreen(p.trail[j].x, p.trail[j].y, p.trail[j].z); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y); }
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      // draw particles as amoeba-like blobs (with depth)
      for (const p of sorted){
        const s = worldToScreen(p.x,p.y,p.z);
        const pulse = 0.55 + 0.35*Math.sin((t*p.pS) + p.pPhi);
        const baseRadius = p.sz * camera.z * s.scale;
        if (baseRadius < 0.5) continue; // skip if too small/far
        // amoeba shape: irregular blob
        ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i=0; i<=p.blobPts; i++){
          const angle = (i / p.blobPts) * Math.PI * 2;
          const wobble = 0.7 + 0.3*Math.sin(angle*3 + p.blobPhase + t*p.pS*2);
          const r = baseRadius * wobble;
          const px = s.x + Math.cos(angle)*r;
          const py = s.y + Math.sin(angle)*r;
          if (i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
        }
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  free:${FREE_COUNT}  z:${camera.z.toFixed(2)}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
        p.stateT--; if (p.stateT<=0){ p.state = (p.state==='rest'?'explore':'rest'); p.stateT = 240 + (Math.random()*480|0); }

        }

        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*(0.003 + p.jit);
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*(0.003 + p.jit);
        // apply breeze
        p.vx += bx;
        p.vy += by;

          // cluster pull toward nearest cluster
          if (n>10 && clusters.length<12){ clusters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, m: Math.min(8, 1.2 + n*0.2) }); }
          let nearest=null, nd=1e9;
          for (const c of clusters){ const dx=c.x-p.x, dy=c.y-p.y; const d=dx*dx+dy*dy; if (d<nd){ nd=d; nearest=c; } }
          if (nearest){ const d = Math.sqrt(nd)+1; const f = Math.min(0.4, nearest.m/(d*d)); p.vx += (nearest.x - p.x)/d * f; p.vy += (nearest.y - p.y)/d * f; }
        }

        if (p.trailAlpha>0){ p.trail.push({x:p.x, y:p.y, z:p.z, a:p.trailAlpha}); if (p.trail.length>12) p.trail.shift(); }
        // move (including z)
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.z += p.vz; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99; p.vz*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;

      const perspective = 1000; // focal length
      const scale = perspective / (perspective + z);

      const sorted = particles.slice().sort((a,b) => a.z - b.z);

      for (const p of sorted){

          ctx.beginPath();
          const s0 = worldToScreen(p.trail[0].x, p.trail[0].y, p.trail[0].z);
          ctx.moveTo(s0.x, s0.y);
          for (let j=1;j<p.trail.length;j++){ const s = worldToScreen(p.trail[j].x, p.trail[j].y, p.trail[j].z); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y); }
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      for (const p of sorted){
        const s = worldToScreen(p.x,p.y,p.z);
        const pulse = 0.55 + 0.35*Math.sin((t*p.pS) + p.pPhi);
        const baseRadius = p.sz * camera.z * s.scale;
        if (baseRadius < 0.5) continue; // skip if too small/far
        // amoeba shape: irregular blob
        ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i=0; i<=p.blobPts; i++){
          const angle = (i / p.blobPts) * Math.PI * 2;
          const wobble = 0.7 + 0.3*Math.sin(angle*3 + p.blobPhase + t*p.pS*2);
          const r = baseRadius * wobble;
          const px = s.x + Math.cos(angle)*r;
          const py = s.y + Math.sin(angle)*r;
          if (i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
        }
        ctx.closePath();

    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
      if(!dragging) return; const dx = e.clientX-lastX, dy = e.clientY-lastY; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
      camera.x -= dx/camera.z; camera.y -= dy/camera.z;
    });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='0'){ camera.x=canvas.width/2; camera.y=canvas.height/2; camera.z=1; } });

    function worldToScreen(x,y,z){
      // perspective: z affects scale (closer = bigger)
      const perspective = 1000; // focal length
      const scale = perspective / (perspective + z);
      return {
        x: (x - camera.x)*camera.z*scale + canvas.width/2,
        y: (y - camera.y)*camera.z*scale + canvas.height/2,
        scale: scale
      };
    }

    function render(){
      // clear fully
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      // combine particles and artifacts for z-sorting
      const allItems = [...particles.map(p => ({...p, isParticle:true})), ...artifacts.map(a => ({...a, isArtifact:true}))];
      allItems.sort((a,b) => a.z - b.z);
      // draw in z-order
      for (const item of allItems){
        if (item.isArtifact){
          const s = worldToScreen(item.x, item.y, item.z);
          const baseSize = item.size * camera.z * s.scale;
          if (baseSize < 2) continue;

          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z*s.scale);

              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x+i*step, s.y-baseSize/2); ctx.lineTo(s.x+i*step, s.y+baseSize/2); ctx.stroke();
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x-baseSize/2, s.y+i*step); ctx.lineTo(s.x+baseSize/2, s.y+i*step); ctx.stroke();
            }
          } else if (item.type==='ring'){
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, baseSize/2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
          } else if (item.type==='spiral'){
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let a=0; a<Math.PI*4; a+=0.2){ const r = (a/(Math.PI*4))*baseSize/2; ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a+item.phase)*r, s.y + Math.sin(a+item.phase)*r); }
            ctx.stroke();
          } else if (item.type==='mesh'){
            const n=5;
            for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ const a=item.phase + (i/n)*Math.PI*2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x,s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a)*baseSize/2, s.y + Math.sin(a)*baseSize/2); ctx.stroke(); }
          } else if (item.type==='text'){
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = `${Math.max(8, baseSize*0.4)|0}px monospace`;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(item.text, s.x, s.y);
          }
        } else if (item.isParticle){
          // trails
          if (item.trailAlpha>0 && item.trail.length>1){
            ctx.globalAlpha = item.trailAlpha*0.6;
            ctx.beginPath();
            const s0 = worldToScreen(item.trail[0].x, item.trail[0].y, item.trail[0].z);
            ctx.moveTo(s0.x, s0.y);
            for (let j=1;j<item.trail.length;j++){ const s = worldToScreen(item.trail[j].x, item.trail[j].y, item.trail[j].z); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y); }
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          // amoeba blob
          const s = worldToScreen(item.x,item.y,item.z);
          const pulse = 0.55 + 0.35*Math.sin((t*item.pS) + item.pPhi);
          const baseRadius = item.sz * camera.z * s.scale;
          if (baseRadius < 0.5) continue;
          ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let i=0; i<=item.blobPts; i++){
            const angle = (i / item.blobPts) * Math.PI * 2;
            const wobble = 0.7 + 0.3*Math.sin(angle*3 + item.blobPhase + t*item.pS*2);
            const r = baseRadius * wobble;
            const px = s.x + Math.cos(angle)*r;
            const py = s.y + Math.sin(angle)*r;
            if (i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
          }
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  free:${FREE_COUNT}  z:${camera.z.toFixed(2)}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
          } else if (item.type==='spiral'){

            for (let a=0; a<Math.PI*4; a+=0.2){ const r = (a/(Math.PI*4))*baseSize/2; ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a+item.phase)*r, s.y + Math.sin(a+item.phase)*r); }
            ctx.stroke();
          } else if (item.type==='mesh'){
            const n=5;
            for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ const a=item.phase + (i/n)*Math.PI*2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x,s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a)*baseSize/2, s.y + Math.sin(a)*baseSize/2); ctx.stroke(); }
          } else if (item.type==='text'){
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = `${Math.max(8, baseSize*0.4)|0}px monospace`;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(item.text, s.x, s.y);
          }
        } else if (item.isParticle){
          // trails
          if (item.trailAlpha>0 && item.trail.length>1){
            ctx.globalAlpha = item.trailAlpha*0.6;
            ctx.beginPath();
            const s0 = worldToScreen(item.trail[0].x, item.trail[0].y, item.trail[0].z);
            ctx.moveTo(s0.x, s0.y);
            for (let j=1;j<item.trail.length;j++){ const s = worldToScreen(item.trail[j].x, item.trail[j].y, item.trail[j].z); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y); }
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          // amoeba blob
          const s = worldToScreen(item.x,item.y,item.z);
          const pulse = 0.55 + 0.35*Math.sin((t*item.pS) + item.pPhi);
          const baseRadius = item.sz * camera.z * s.scale;
          if (baseRadius < 0.5) continue;
          ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let i=0; i<=item.blobPts; i++){
            const angle = (i / item.blobPts) * Math.PI * 2;
            const wobble = 0.7 + 0.3*Math.sin(angle*3 + item.blobPhase + t*item.pS*2);
            const r = baseRadius * wobble;
            const px = s.x + Math.cos(angle)*r;
            const py = s.y + Math.sin(angle)*r;
            if (i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
          }
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  free:${FREE_COUNT}  z:${camera.z.toFixed(2)}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
        blobPts: 8 + ((Math.random()*8)|0), // amoeba vertices
        blobPhase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2

    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }

    const agents = [];

      agents.push({

    function updateClusters(){}

    // Z-layers with meaning

    };

      const type = artifactTypes[(Math.random()*artifactTypes.length)|0];
      const layerKeys = Object.keys(LAYERS);

      artifacts.push({
        type: type,

        layer: Object.keys(LAYERS).find(k => Math.abs(LAYERS[k] - (layer+zNoise)) < 8000) || 'UNKNOWN'
      });
    }
    
    // LANDMARKS: rare, large structures
    const landmarks = [];
    landmarks.push({ type:'memory_archive', x:canvas.width*0.3, y:canvas.height*0.4, z:LAYERS.LONG_TERM, size:300, alpha:0.2, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.005 });
    landmarks.push({ type:'dream_spiral', x:canvas.width*0.7, y:canvas.height*0.3, z:LAYERS.DREAMS, size:400, alpha:0.15, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.008 });
    landmarks.push({ type:'seed_constellation', x:canvas.width*0.5, y:canvas.height*0.6, z:LAYERS.SEEDS, size:350, alpha:0.18, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.003 });
    landmarks.push({ type:'event_lattice', x:canvas.width*0.2, y:canvas.height*0.7, z:LAYERS.EVENTS, size:280, alpha:0.12, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.007 });
    
    // procedurally spawn more artifacts as we explore
    function spawnArtifactNear(z, count=5){
      for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
        const type = artifactTypes[(Math.random()*artifactTypes.length)|0];
        artifacts.push({
          type: type,
          x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
          y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
          z: z + (Math.random()-0.5)*3000,
          size: 20 + Math.random()*80,
          alpha: 0.05 + Math.random()*0.15,
          phase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,

          rotSpeed: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02,

    let lastSpawnCheck = 0;

    function step(){
      t += 1;
      // gentle global breeze that slowly rotates
      const bx = Math.cos(t * 0.0018) * 0.02;
      const by = Math.sin(t * 0.0013) * 0.015;
      // physics on a subset for performance
      const span = Math.max(1, (particles.length*UPDATE_FRAC)|0);
      let from = updateOffset; let to = from + span;
      updateOffset = (updateOffset + span) % particles.length;
      for (let i=from; i<to; i++){
        const idx = i % particles.length; const p = particles[idx];
        // state transitions tweak personality over time
        p.stateT--; if (p.stateT<=0){ p.state = (p.state==='rest'?'explore':'rest'); p.stateT = 240 + (Math.random()*480|0); }
        const stateBoost = (p.state==='explore') ? 1.0 : 0.6;

        p.decisionT--; if (p.decisionT<=0){

        p.vx += bx;
        p.vy += by;

          if (e.type==='b'){

          } else if (e.type==='a'){

          p.gt--; if (p.gt<=0){ p.gx = Math.random()*canvas.width; p.gy = Math.random()*canvas.height; p.gt = 300 + (Math.random()*600|0); }
          const dx = p.gx - p.x, dy = p.gy - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          p.vx += (dx/d)*0.04; p.vy += (dy/d)*0.04;
          p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02; p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        } else {
          // local flocking: cohesion, alignment, separation (personality-weighted)
          let cx=0, cy=0, nvx=0, nvy=0, sx=0, sy=0, n=0; const R=60, R2=R*R, Rsep=18, Rsep2=Rsep*Rsep;
          for (let k=0;k<16;k++){ const q = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0];
            const dx = q.x - p.x, dy = q.y - p.y; const d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy; if (d2<R2 && d2>0){ cx += q.x; cy += q.y; nvx += q.vx; nvy += q.vy; n++; if (d2<Rsep2){ sx -= dx; sy -= dy; } }
          }
          if (n>0){

            cx/=n; cy/=n; let dx=cx-p.x, dy=cy-p.y; let d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
            const cohMult = (p.mood==='social') ? 2.0 : (p.mood==='shy') ? 0.3 : 1.0;
            p.vx += (dx/d)*(p.coh*stateBoost*cohMult);

            nvx/=n; nvy/=n; p.vx += nvx*(p.ali*stateBoost*0.6); p.vy += nvy*(p.ali*stateBoost*0.6);

          // cluster pull toward nearest cluster
          if (n>10 && clusters.length<12){ clusters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, m: Math.min(8, 1.2 + n*0.2) }); }
          let nearest=null, nd=1e9;

          if (nearest){ const d = Math.sqrt(nd)+1; const f = Math.min(0.4, nearest.m/(d*d)); p.vx += (nearest.x - p.x)/d * f; p.vy += (nearest.y - p.y)/d * f; }
        }

        // move (including z)

        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;

    // Camera controls (pan/zoom) - infinite zoom
    const camera = { x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height/2, z: 3 }; // start zoomed in
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {

      const wx = (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z + camera.x;
      const wy = (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z + camera.y;
      const factor = e.deltaY>0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.z *= factor; // no limits
      camera.x = wx - (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z;
      camera.y = wy - (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z;
    }, { passive:false });
    let dragging=false, lastX=0, lastY=0;
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e)=>{ dragging=true; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY; });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
      if(!dragging) return; const dx = e.clientX-lastX, dy = e.clientY-lastY; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
      camera.x -= dx/camera.z; camera.y -= dy/camera.z;
    });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='0'){ camera.x=canvas.width/2; camera.y=canvas.height/2; camera.z=1; } });

    function worldToScreen(x,y,z){
      // perspective: z affects scale (closer = bigger)
      const perspective = 1000; // focal length
      const scale = perspective / (perspective + z);
      return {
        x: (x - camera.x)*camera.z*scale + canvas.width/2,
        y: (y - camera.y)*camera.z*scale + canvas.height/2,
        scale: scale
      };
    }

    function render(){
      // clear fully
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      // combine particles and artifacts for z-sorting
      const allItems = [...particles.map(p => ({...p, isParticle:true})), ...artifacts.map(a => ({...a, isArtifact:true}))];
      allItems.sort((a,b) => a.z - b.z);
      // draw in z-order
      for (const item of allItems){
        if (item.isArtifact){
          const s = worldToScreen(item.x, item.y, item.z);
          const baseSize = item.size * camera.z * s.scale;
          if (baseSize < 2) continue;
          ctx.globalAlpha = item.alpha;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z*s.scale);
          if (item.type==='grid'){

            for (let i=-2;i<=2;i++){
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x+i*step, s.y-baseSize/2); ctx.lineTo(s.x+i*step, s.y+baseSize/2); ctx.stroke();
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x-baseSize/2, s.y+i*step); ctx.lineTo(s.x+baseSize/2, s.y+i*step); ctx.stroke();
            }
          } else if (item.type==='ring'){

          } else if (item.type==='spiral'){
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let a=0; a<Math.PI*4; a+=0.2){ const r = (a/(Math.PI*4))*baseSize/2; ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a+item.phase)*r, s.y + Math.sin(a+item.phase)*r); }
            ctx.stroke();
          } else if (item.type==='mesh'){
            const n=5;
            for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ const a=item.phase + (i/n)*Math.PI*2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x,s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a)*baseSize/2, s.y + Math.sin(a)*baseSize/2); ctx.stroke(); }
          } else if (item.type==='text'){
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = `${Math.max(8, baseSize*0.4)|0}px monospace`;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(item.text, s.x, s.y);
          }
        } else if (item.isParticle){
          // trails
          if (item.trailAlpha>0 && item.trail.length>1){
            ctx.globalAlpha = item.trailAlpha*0.6;
            ctx.beginPath();
            const s0 = worldToScreen(item.trail[0].x, item.trail[0].y, item.trail[0].z);
            ctx.moveTo(s0.x, s0.y);
            for (let j=1;j<item.trail.length;j++){ const s = worldToScreen(item.trail[j].x, item.trail[j].y, item.trail[j].z); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y); }
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          // amoeba blob
          const s = worldToScreen(item.x,item.y,item.z);
          const pulse = 0.55 + 0.35*Math.sin((t*item.pS) + item.pPhi);
          const baseRadius = item.sz * camera.z * s.scale;
          if (baseRadius < 0.5) continue;
          ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let i=0; i<=item.blobPts; i++){
            const angle = (i / item.blobPts) * Math.PI * 2;

    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }

        try {
```

```html
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>


```

Now I'll update the render function to handle landmarks, add procedural spawning, and wire to Ember's SSE events:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Swarm v2</title>
  <style>
    html, body { margin:0; height:100%; background:#000; }
    #canvas { display:block; width:100vw; height:100vh; background:#000; }
    #hud { position:fixed; top:8px; left:10px; color:#888; font:12px/1.2 monospace; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
  <div id="hud"></div>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

    const DPR = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    // Target a cohesive swarm; tune here
    const TARGET_COUNT = 8000;
    const COUNT = TARGET_COUNT; // allocate full set up-front
    const UPDATE_FRAC = 0.20;   // ~20% updated per frame
    const DRAW_FRAC = 1.00;     // draw all particles each frame for single-layer feel
    let updateOffset = 0;
    let drawOffset = 0;
    let t = 0; // time for breeze
    const particles = [];
    const FREE_FRAC = 0.35; // ~35% do their own thing
    const MOODS = ['curious','shy','social','wanderer'];
    let FREE_COUNT = 0;
    // COSMIC z-depth range: -50000 to +50000
    const Z_MIN = -50000, Z_MAX = 50000, Z_RANGE = Z_MAX - Z_MIN;
    for (let i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      const isFree = (Math.random() < FREE_FRAC);
      const mood = MOODS[(Math.random()*MOODS.length)|0];
      const szRoll = Math.random();
      const baseSize = (szRoll < 0.05) ? (4 + Math.random()*2) : (szRoll < 0.15) ? (0.5 + Math.random()*0.5) : (1.2 + Math.random()*1.4);
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        z: Z_MIN + Math.random()*Z_RANGE, // cosmic depth
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
        vz: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.05,  // slow z drift
        o: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.6,
        free: isFree,
        mood: mood,
        gx: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        gy: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        gt: 300 + (Math.random()*600|0),
        // per-particle "personality" weights
        coh: 0.006 + Math.random()*0.012,   // cohesion weight
        ali: 0.006 + Math.random()*0.020,   // alignment weight
        sep: 0.030 + Math.random()*0.050,   // separation weight
        jit: 0.002 + Math.random()*0.004,   // jitter
        pS:  0.004 + Math.random()*0.008,   // pulse speed
        pPhi: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,      // pulse phase
        sz:  baseSize,                      // base size (varied)
        state: (Math.random()<0.5?'explore':'rest'),
        stateT: 240 + (Math.random()*480|0),
        decisionT: 60 + (Math.random()*120|0), // decision timer
        trailAlpha: (Math.random()<0.15) ? (0.15 + Math.random()*0.25) : 0, // only some leave trails
        trail: [],
        blobPts: 8 + ((Math.random()*8)|0), // amoeba vertices
        blobPhase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2
      });
      if (particles[i].free) FREE_COUNT++;
    }

    const effects = [];
    function burst(x,y,strength=1){ effects.push({type:'b',x,y,s:strength,a:60}); }
    function attractor(x,y,strength=0.5,radius=200){ effects.push({type:'a',x,y,s:strength,r:radius,a:200}); }
    function spiral(x,y,strength=0.8){ effects.push({type:'p',x,y,s:strength,a:120}); }

    // Simple agentic behavior: a small team of agents with modes
    const agents = [];
    const AGENT_COUNT = 2; // calmer
    const MODES = ['wander']; // only wandering
    for (let i=0;i<AGENT_COUNT;i++){
      agents.push({
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        mode: MODES[i % MODES.length],
        t: 180 + Math.floor(Math.random()*120) // ticks until mode change
      });
    }

    function updateAgents(){
      for (const a of agents){
        a.t--; if (a.t<=0){ a.mode = 'wander'; a.t = 360; }
        // soft random walk, no injected effects
        a.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08; a.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08;
        const sp = 0.35; a.vx = Math.max(Math.min(a.vx,sp),-sp); a.vy = Math.max(Math.min(a.vy,sp),-sp);
        a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
        // wrap
        if (a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if (a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
        if (a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if (a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
      }
    }

    // Clustering disabled for calmer drift
    const clusters = [];
    function updateClusters(){}

    // Z-layers with meaning
    const LAYERS = {
      DEEP_MEMORY: -40000,
      LONG_TERM: -25000,
      DREAMS: -10000,
      SURFACE: 0,
      SEEDS: 10000,
      EVENTS: 25000,
      FUTURE: 40000
    };
    
    // Z-depth artifacts: base set + procedurally spawned
    const artifacts = [];
    const artifactTypes = ['grid','text','ring','spiral','mesh','constellation','wave'];
    // seed initial artifacts across layers
    for (let i=0; i<80; i++){
      const type = artifactTypes[(Math.random()*artifactTypes.length)|0];
      const layerKeys = Object.keys(LAYERS);
      const layer = LAYERS[layerKeys[(Math.random()*layerKeys.length)|0]];
      const zNoise = (Math.random()-0.5)*5000; // ±2500 from layer center
      artifacts.push({
        type: type,
        x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
        y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
        z: layer + zNoise,
        size: 20 + Math.random()*120,
        alpha: 0.05 + Math.random()*0.15,
        phase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
        rot: 0,
        rotSpeed: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02,
        text: (type==='text') ? ['memory','dream','seed','ember','pod','event','μ','∞','◊','△','⟁','⊹'][((Math.random()*12)|0)] : '',
        layer: Object.keys(LAYERS).find(k => Math.abs(LAYERS[k] - (layer+zNoise)) < 8000) || 'UNKNOWN'
      });
    }
    
    // LANDMARKS: rare, large structures
    const landmarks = [];
    landmarks.push({ type:'memory_archive', x:canvas.width*0.3, y:canvas.height*0.4, z:LAYERS.LONG_TERM, size:300, alpha:0.2, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.005 });
    landmarks.push({ type:'dream_spiral', x:canvas.width*0.7, y:canvas.height*0.3, z:LAYERS.DREAMS, size:400, alpha:0.15, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.008 });
    landmarks.push({ type:'seed_constellation', x:canvas.width*0.5, y:canvas.height*0.6, z:LAYERS.SEEDS, size:350, alpha:0.18, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.003 });
    landmarks.push({ type:'event_lattice', x:canvas.width*0.2, y:canvas.height*0.7, z:LAYERS.EVENTS, size:280, alpha:0.12, phase:0, rot:0, rotSpeed:0.007 });
    
    // procedurally spawn more artifacts as we explore
    function spawnArtifactNear(z, count=5){
      for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
        const type = artifactTypes[(Math.random()*artifactTypes.length)|0];
        artifacts.push({
          type: type,
          x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
          y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
          z: z + (Math.random()-0.5)*3000,
          size: 20 + Math.random()*80,
          alpha: 0.05 + Math.random()*0.15,
          phase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
          rot: 0,
          rotSpeed: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02,
          text: (type==='text') ? ['memory','dream','seed','ember','pod','event','μ','∞','◊','△','⟁','⊹'][((Math.random()*12)|0)] : '',
          layer: 'SPAWNED'
        });
      }
    }
    let lastSpawnCheck = 0;

    function step(){
      t += 1;
      // gentle global breeze that slowly rotates
      const bx = Math.cos(t * 0.0018) * 0.02;
      const by = Math.sin(t * 0.0013) * 0.015;
      // physics on a subset for performance
      const span = Math.max(1, (particles.length*UPDATE_FRAC)|0);
      let from = updateOffset; let to = from + span;
      updateOffset = (updateOffset + span) % particles.length;
      for (let i=from; i<to; i++){
        const idx = i % particles.length; const p = particles[idx];
        // state transitions tweak personality over time
        p.stateT--; if (p.stateT<=0){ p.state = (p.state==='rest'?'explore':'rest'); p.stateT = 240 + (Math.random()*480|0); }
        const stateBoost = (p.state==='explore') ? 1.0 : 0.6;
        // occasional "decisions" - sudden direction changes
        p.decisionT--; if (p.decisionT<=0){
          p.decisionT = 60 + (Math.random()*120|0);
          if (Math.random()<0.3){ p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.8; p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.8; } // dart
          else if (Math.random()<0.2){ p.vx *= 0.2; p.vy *= 0.2; } // pause
        }
        // gentle noise (calm) + personality jitter
        p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*(0.003 + p.jit);
        p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*(0.003 + p.jit);
        // apply breeze
        p.vx += bx;
        p.vy += by;
        // effects
        for (const e of effects){
          const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          if (e.type==='b'){
            const f = 0.5*e.s*(e.a/60)/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f;
          } else if (e.type==='a'){
            if (d<e.r){ const f = 0.6*e.s/(d*d); p.vx += (dx/d)*f; p.vy += (dy/d)*f; }
          } else if (e.type==='p'){
            const f = 0.4*e.s/d; // tangential softer
            p.vx += (-dy/d)*f; p.vy += (dx/d)*f;
          }
        }
        // mood-based behavior
        if (p.free || p.mood==='wanderer'){
          // independent goal-seeking
          p.gt--; if (p.gt<=0){ p.gx = Math.random()*canvas.width; p.gy = Math.random()*canvas.height; p.gt = 300 + (Math.random()*600|0); }
          const dx = p.gx - p.x, dy = p.gy - p.y; const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
          p.vx += (dx/d)*0.04; p.vy += (dy/d)*0.04;
          p.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02; p.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
        } else {
          // local flocking: cohesion, alignment, separation (personality-weighted)
          let cx=0, cy=0, nvx=0, nvy=0, sx=0, sy=0, n=0; const R=60, R2=R*R, Rsep=18, Rsep2=Rsep*Rsep;
          for (let k=0;k<16;k++){ const q = particles[(Math.random()*particles.length)|0];
            const dx = q.x - p.x, dy = q.y - p.y; const d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy; if (d2<R2 && d2>0){ cx += q.x; cy += q.y; nvx += q.vx; nvy += q.vy; n++; if (d2<Rsep2){ sx -= dx; sy -= dy; } }
          }
          if (n>0){
            // cohesion (social mood seeks denser areas)
            cx/=n; cy/=n; let dx=cx-p.x, dy=cy-p.y; let d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1;
            const cohMult = (p.mood==='social') ? 2.0 : (p.mood==='shy') ? 0.3 : 1.0;
            p.vx += (dx/d)*(p.coh*stateBoost*cohMult);
            // alignment
            nvx/=n; nvy/=n; p.vx += nvx*(p.ali*stateBoost*0.6); p.vy += nvy*(p.ali*stateBoost*0.6);
            // separation (shy pushes harder away)
            const sepMult = (p.mood==='shy') ? 2.5 : 1.0;
            d=Math.hypot(sx,sy)+1; p.vx += (sx/d)*(p.sep*sepMult); p.vy += (sy/d)*(p.sep*sepMult);
          }
          // curious particles spiral around local center
          if (p.mood==='curious' && n>0){ const dx=cx-p.x, dy=cy-p.y; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+1; p.vx += (-dy/d)*0.02; p.vy += (dx/d)*0.02; }
          // cluster pull toward nearest cluster
          if (n>10 && clusters.length<12){ clusters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, m: Math.min(8, 1.2 + n*0.2) }); }
          let nearest=null, nd=1e9;
          for (const c of clusters){ const dx=c.x-p.x, dy=c.y-p.y; const d=dx*dx+dy*dy; if (d<nd){ nd=d; nearest=c; } }
          if (nearest){ const d = Math.sqrt(nd)+1; const f = Math.min(0.4, nearest.m/(d*d)); p.vx += (nearest.x - p.x)/d * f; p.vy += (nearest.y - p.y)/d * f; }
        }
        // trail tracking
        if (p.trailAlpha>0){ p.trail.push({x:p.x, y:p.y, z:p.z, a:p.trailAlpha}); if (p.trail.length>12) p.trail.shift(); }
        // move (including z)
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.z += p.vz; p.vx*=0.99; p.vy*=0.99; p.vz*=0.99;
        if (p.x<0) p.x+=canvas.width; if (p.x>canvas.width) p.x-=canvas.width;
        if (p.y<0) p.y+=canvas.height; if (p.y>canvas.height) p.y-=canvas.height;
        // z wraps for cosmic depth
        if (p.z<Z_MIN) p.z+=Z_RANGE; if (p.z>Z_MAX) p.z-=Z_RANGE;
      }
      for (const e of effects) e.a--; 
      for (let i=effects.length-1; i>=0; i--) if (effects[i].a<=0) effects.splice(i,1);
      // agents
      updateAgents();
      updateClusters();
      // procedural spawning: check every 120 frames if we need more artifacts near camera
      if (t - lastSpawnCheck > 120){
        lastSpawnCheck = t;
        // estimate camera z-focus (use camera.x as proxy for z-interest)
        const focusZ = 0; // for now, spawn near surface; TODO: track camera z-focus
        if (artifacts.length < 200){ spawnArtifactNear(focusZ, 3); }
      }
      // rotate landmarks & artifacts slowly
      for (const lm of landmarks){ lm.rot += lm.rotSpeed; }
      for (const a of artifacts){ a.rot += a.rotSpeed; }
    }

    // Camera controls (pan/zoom) - infinite zoom
    const camera = { x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height/2, z: 3 }; // start zoomed in
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = e.clientX - rect.left; const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const wx = (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z + camera.x;
      const wy = (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z + camera.y;
      const factor = e.deltaY>0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.z *= factor; // no limits
      camera.x = wx - (mx - canvas.width/2)/camera.z;
      camera.y = wy - (my - canvas.height/2)/camera.z;
    }, { passive:false });
    let dragging=false, lastX=0, lastY=0;
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e)=>{ dragging=true; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY; });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', ()=> dragging=false);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
      if(!dragging) return; const dx = e.clientX-lastX, dy = e.clientY-lastY; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
      camera.x -= dx/camera.z; camera.y -= dy/camera.z;
    });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='0'){ camera.x=canvas.width/2; camera.y=canvas.height/2; camera.z=1; } });

    function worldToScreen(x,y,z){
      // perspective: z affects scale (closer = bigger)
      const perspective = 1000; // focal length
      const scale = perspective / (perspective + z);
      return {
        x: (x - camera.x)*camera.z*scale + canvas.width/2,
        y: (y - camera.y)*camera.z*scale + canvas.height/2,
        scale: scale
      };
    }

    function render(){
      // clear fully
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      // combine particles and artifacts for z-sorting
      const allItems = [...particles.map(p => ({...p, isParticle:true})), ...artifacts.map(a => ({...a, isArtifact:true}))];
      allItems.sort((a,b) => a.z - b.z);
      // draw in z-order
      for (const item of allItems){
        if (item.isArtifact){
          const s = worldToScreen(item.x, item.y, item.z);
          const baseSize = item.size * camera.z * s.scale;
          if (baseSize < 2) continue;
          ctx.globalAlpha = item.alpha;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z*s.scale);
          if (item.type==='grid'){
            const step = baseSize/4;
            for (let i=-2;i<=2;i++){
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x+i*step, s.y-baseSize/2); ctx.lineTo(s.x+i*step, s.y+baseSize/2); ctx.stroke();
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x-baseSize/2, s.y+i*step); ctx.lineTo(s.x+baseSize/2, s.y+i*step); ctx.stroke();
            }
          } else if (item.type==='ring'){
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, baseSize/2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
          } else if (item.type==='spiral'){
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let a=0; a<Math.PI*4; a+=0.2){ const r = (a/(Math.PI*4))*baseSize/2; ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a+item.phase)*r, s.y + Math.sin(a+item.phase)*r); }
            ctx.stroke();
          } else if (item.type==='mesh'){
            const n=5;
            for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ const a=item.phase + (i/n)*Math.PI*2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x,s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a)*baseSize/2, s.y + Math.sin(a)*baseSize/2); ctx.stroke(); }
          } else if (item.type==='text'){
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = `${Math.max(8, baseSize*0.4)|0}px monospace`;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(item.text, s.x, s.y);
          }
        } else if (item.isParticle){
          // trails
          if (item.trailAlpha>0 && item.trail.length>1){
            ctx.globalAlpha = item.trailAlpha*0.6;
            ctx.beginPath();
            const s0 = worldToScreen(item.trail[0].x, item.trail[0].y, item.trail[0].z);
            ctx.moveTo(s0.x, s0.y);
            for (let j=1;j<item.trail.length;j++){ const s = worldToScreen(item.trail[j].x, item.trail[j].y, item.trail[j].z); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y); }
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 0.5*camera.z);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          // amoeba blob
          const s = worldToScreen(item.x,item.y,item.z);
          const pulse = 0.55 + 0.35*Math.sin((t*item.pS) + item.pPhi);
          const baseRadius = item.sz * camera.z * s.scale;
          if (baseRadius < 0.5) continue;
          ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let i=0; i<=item.blobPts; i++){
            const angle = (i / item.blobPts) * Math.PI * 2;
            const wobble = 0.7 + 0.3*Math.sin(angle*3 + item.blobPhase + t*item.pS*2);
            const r = baseRadius * wobble;
            const px = s.x + Math.cos(angle)*r;
            const py = s.y + Math.sin(angle)*r;
            if (i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
          }
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const hud = document.getElementById('hud');
      if (hud) hud.textContent = `swarm: ${particles.length.toLocaleString()}  free:${FREE_COUNT}  z:${camera.z.toFixed(2)}`;
    }

    function loop(){ step(); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    loop();

    // SSE wiring
    try {
      const es = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
      es.onmessage = (evt) => {
        try {
          const ev = JSON.parse(evt.data);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          if (ev.type==='swarm_command'){
            const cmd = ev.command||'burst';
            if (cmd==='burst') burst((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||1);
            if (cmd==='attractor') attractor((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.5, ev.radius||200);
            if (cmd==='spiral') spiral((ev.x||0.5)*canvas.width,(ev.y||0.5)*canvas.height, ev.strength||0.8);
          }
        } catch(e){}
      };
    } catch(e){}

    // Interact: click to burst
    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left; const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      burst(x,y,1.5);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```
