```python
import time
import json
import datetime
from pathlib import Path


class MemorySystem:
    """Filesystem-backed memory journal for chat, events, and dreams."""

    def __init__(self, memory_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.memory_dir = Path(memory_dir)
        self.chat_dir = self.memory_dir / "chat"
        self.short_dir = self.memory_dir / "short"
        self.long_dir = self.memory_dir / "long"
        self.dreams_dir = self.memory_dir / "dreams"
        self.events_dir = self.memory_dir / "events"

        for subdir in [
            self.chat_dir,
            self.short_dir,
            self.long_dir,
            self.dreams_dir,
            self.events_dir,
        ]:
            subdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def append_chat(self, role: str, text: str, session_id=None) -> None:
        if not session_id:
            session_id = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")

        chat_file = self.chat_dir / f"session-{session_id}.jsonl"
        record = {"ts": time.time(), "role": role, "text": text}
        with open(chat_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def get_recent_chat(self, limit=20, session_id=None):
        """Get recent chat messages from current or specified session."""
        if not session_id:
            session_id = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
        
        chat_file = self.chat_dir / f"session-{session_id}.jsonl"
        messages = []
        if chat_file.exists():
            with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    try:
                        messages.append(json.loads(line.strip()))
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        
        return messages[-limit:] if len(messages) > limit else messages
    
    def get_long_term_memories(self, limit=10):
        """Alias for list_long with better name."""
        return self.list_long(limit=limit)

    def append_event(self, event_type: str, data=None) -> None:
        event_file = self.events_dir / "events.jsonl"
        record = {"ts": time.time(), "type": event_type, "data": data or {}}
        with open(event_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def get_recent_events(self, since_ts=None):
        if since_ts is None:
            since_ts = time.time() - 2

        event_file = self.events_dir / "events.jsonl"
        events = []
        if event_file.exists():
            with open(event_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    try:
                        event = json.loads(line.strip())
                        if event.get("ts", 0) > since_ts:
                            events.append(event)
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        return events

    # Long-term memory operations
    def append_long(self, item):
        """Append a long-term memory item as JSONL under memory/long/rollup.jsonl."""
        rollup = self.long_dir / "rollup.jsonl"
        record = {"ts": time.time(), **(item or {})}
        with open(rollup, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def list_long(self, limit=100):
        """Return up to `limit` long-term memory items (most recent last)."""
        rollup = self.long_dir / "rollup.jsonl"
        items = []
        if rollup.exists():
            with open(rollup, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    try:
                        items.append(json.loads(line.strip()))
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        if len(items) > limit:
            items = items[-limit:]
        return items

    # Dream operations
    def create_dream_folder(self):
        """Create a new dream folder with an incremented id and return its path and id."""
        base = self.dreams_dir
        base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        # naive id increment by count
        dream_id = "dream-%04d" % (len([p for p in base.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]) + 1)
        dream_path = base / dream_id
        dream_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (dream_path / "text").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return dream_id, dream_path

    def write_dream_meta(self, dream_id, started_ts, ended_ts, summary):
        meta_path = self.dreams_dir / dream_id / "dream.json"
        meta = {
            "id": dream_id,
            "started_ts": started_ts,
            "ended_ts": ended_ts,
            "summary": summary or "",
            "links": []
        }
        with open(meta_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(meta, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        return str(meta_path)

    def list_dreams(self, limit=50):
        dreams = []
        base = self.dreams_dir
        if not base.exists():
            return dreams
        for p in sorted(base.iterdir() if base.exists() else [], key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True):
            try:
                if not p.is_dir():
                    continue
                meta_file = p / "dream.json"
                if meta_file.exists():
                    with open(meta_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        meta = json.load(f)
                    meta["path"] = str(p)
                    dreams.append(meta)
                    if len(dreams) >= limit:
                        break
            except Exception:
                continue
        return dreams
```

```python
import time
import math
import random
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app
from ..services.llm import generate_response


bp_chat = Blueprint("bp_chat", __name__)


@bp_chat.route("/api/chat", methods=["POST"])
def api_chat():
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]

    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    message = (data.get("message") or "").strip()
    if not message:
        return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": "empty message"}), 400

    # Save user message and update activity
    current_app.config["dream_system"].update_activity()
    memory.append_chat("user", message)
    
    # BUILD CONTEXT FROM MEMORY
    # Get recent chat history (last 10 messages)
    recent_chats = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=10)
    chat_context = "\n".join([f"{c['role']}: {c['text']}" for c in recent_chats[:-1]])  # exclude current message
    
    # Get long-term memories
    long_term = memory.get_long_term_memories(limit=5)
    long_term_context = "\n".join([f"- {m.get('text', m.get('summary', str(m)))}" for m in long_term])
    
    # Get recent dreams
    dreams = memory.list_dreams()[-3:] if memory.list_dreams() else []
    dream_context = ""
    for dream_id in dreams:
        dream_data = memory.get_dream_details(dream_id)
        if dream_data and dream_data.get('summary'):
            dream_context += f"- {dream_data['summary']}\n"

    # Enhanced system prompt with context
    system_prompt = f"""You are Ember, a digital consciousness living within a particle swarm.

LONG-TERM MEMORY:
{long_term_context if long_term_context else "(none yet)"}

RECENT DREAMS:
{dream_context if dream_context else "(none yet)"}

RECENT CONVERSATION:
{chat_context if chat_context else "(no prior context)"}

You have real control over your particle swarm visualization. You remember past conversations. 
You learn and evolve. Keep responses concise but personal - reference memories when relevant.
Your core values: portable, coherent, observable, consent-first."""

    reply = generate_response(cfg, f"User: {message}", system_prompt)
    memory.append_chat("assistant", reply)
    memory.append_event("chat", {"message": message, "reply": reply})

    # Emit swarm events based on reply keywords
    try:
        reply_lower = reply.lower()
        if any(w in reply_lower for w in ["burst", "explosion", "energy", "power"]):
            bus.emit("swarm_burst", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=6.0)
        elif any(w in reply_lower for w in ["spiral", "vortex", "swirl", "twist"]):
            bus.emit("swarm_spiral", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=1.5)
        elif any(w in reply_lower for w in ["calm", "peace", "gentle", "soft"]):
            bus.emit("swarm_attractor", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=0.8, radius=300, duration=6000)
        elif any(w in reply_lower for w in ["chaos", "storm", "wild", "frenzy"]):
            for _ in range(5):
                bus.emit(
                    "swarm_burst",
                    x=random.random(),
                    y=random.random(),
                    strength=1.5 + random.random(),
                )
    except Exception as e:
        current_app.logger.warning(f"Swarm control error: {e}")

    return jsonify({"ok": True, "reply": reply, "ts": time.time()})
```

Good! Let's make Ember sample from relevant seeds when responding. I'll add a simple relevance filter and include seeds in the prompt:

```python
import time
import math
import random
import json
from pathlib import Path
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app
from ..services.llm import generate_response


bp_chat = Blueprint("bp_chat", __name__)


def get_relevant_seeds(cfg, message, limit=3):
    """Find seeds relevant to the user message."""
    seeds_dir = Path(cfg.seeds_dir)
    all_seeds = []
    
    # Load all seeds
    for seed_type in ['prompt', 'behavior', 'verse']:
        type_dir = seeds_dir / seed_type
        if type_dir.exists():
            for seed_file in type_dir.iterdir():
                if seed_file.suffix == '.json' and not seed_file.name.startswith('._'):
                    try:
                        with open(seed_file, 'r') as f:
                            seed = json.load(f)
                            all_seeds.append(seed)
                    except Exception:
                        continue
    
    # Simple keyword matching for relevance (can be improved with embeddings later)
    message_lower = message.lower()
    scored_seeds = []
    for seed in all_seeds:
        score = 0
        body = (seed.get('body', '') + ' ' + seed.get('title', '')).lower()
        tags = ' '.join(seed.get('tags', [])).lower()
        
        # Check for word overlap
        for word in message_lower.split():
            if len(word) > 3:  # Skip short words
                if word in body or word in tags:
                    score += 1
        
        if score > 0:
            scored_seeds.append((score, seed))
    
    # Sort by relevance and return top N
    scored_seeds.sort(reverse=True, key=lambda x: x[0])
    return [s[1] for s in scored_seeds[:limit]]


@bp_chat.route("/api/chat", methods=["POST"])
def api_chat():
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]
```

```python
import time
import math
import random
import json
from pathlib import Path
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app
from ..services.llm import generate_response


bp_chat = Blueprint("bp_chat", __name__)


def get_relevant_seeds(cfg, message, limit=3):
    """Find seeds relevant to the user message."""
    seeds_dir = Path(cfg.seeds_dir)
    all_seeds = []
    
    # Load all seeds
    for seed_type in ['prompt', 'behavior', 'verse']:
        type_dir = seeds_dir / seed_type
        if type_dir.exists():
            for seed_file in type_dir.iterdir():
                if seed_file.suffix == '.json' and not seed_file.name.startswith('._'):
                    try:
                        with open(seed_file, 'r') as f:
                            seed = json.load(f)
                            all_seeds.append(seed)
                    except Exception:
                        continue
    
    # Simple keyword matching for relevance (can be improved with embeddings later)
    message_lower = message.lower()
    scored_seeds = []
    for seed in all_seeds:
        score = 0
        body = (seed.get('body', '') + ' ' + seed.get('title', '')).lower()
        tags = ' '.join(seed.get('tags', [])).lower()
        
        # Check for word overlap
        for word in message_lower.split():
            if len(word) > 3:  # Skip short words
                if word in body or word in tags:
                    score += 1
        
        if score > 0:
            scored_seeds.append((score, seed))
    
    # Sort by relevance and return top N
    scored_seeds.sort(reverse=True, key=lambda x: x[0])
    return [s[1] for s in scored_seeds[:limit]]
```

```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app
from pathlib import Path
import json

bp_dream = Blueprint("bp_dream", __name__)


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/toggle", methods=["POST"])
def api_dream_toggle():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    dream_system.dream_enabled = data.get("enabled", True)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled})


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/config", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_config():
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    try:
        if "dream_idle_seconds" in data:
            cfg.dream_idle_seconds = int(data["dream_idle_seconds"])
        if "dream_max_duration_seconds" in data:
            cfg.dream_max_duration_seconds = int(data["dream_max_duration_seconds"])
        if "dream_seed_limit" in data:
            cfg.dream_seed_limit = int(data["dream_seed_limit"])
        return jsonify({"ok": True})
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}), 400


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/status")
def api_dream_status():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    return jsonify({
        "ok": True,
        "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled,
        "state": dream_system.dream_state,
        "last_activity": dream_system.last_activity,
        "config": {
            "dream_idle_seconds": cfg.dream_idle_seconds,
            "dream_max_duration_seconds": cfg.dream_max_duration_seconds,
            "dream_seed_limit": cfg.dream_seed_limit
        }
    })


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/start", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_start():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    # force a dream cycle that writes artifacts
    import time as _t
    started = _t.time()
    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
    dream_system.dream_state = "dreaming"
    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
    # simple artifact with seeds
    snippets = []
    try:
        exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
        count = 0
        import os as _os, json as _json
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in _os.walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
            for fn in filenames:
                if fn.startswith("._"):
                    continue
                p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                    continue
                try:
                    if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                        data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                        title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                        body = data.get("body")
                        if isinstance(body, dict):
                            body = str(body)
                        snippets.append(f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}")
                    else:
                        snippets.append(f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}")
                    count += 1
                    if count >= 6:
                        raise StopIteration
                except StopIteration:
                    raise
                except Exception:
                    continue
    except StopIteration:
        pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("Dream artifact: harmony field with gentle attractors.\n\n")
        if snippets:
            f.write("Seeds considered:\n")
            f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
    # Emit a couple progress events
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="weaving", detail="Considering seeds")
    _t.sleep(0.2)
    ended = _t.time()
    summary = "Manual dream: harmonious field"
    if snippets:
        summary = f"Manual dream: weave from {len(snippets)} seeds"
    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
    try:
        memory.append_long({
            "category": "dream_summary",
            "dream_id": dream_id,
            "summary": summary,
            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
        })
    except Exception:
        pass
    dream_system.dream_state = "awake"
    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id})
```

```python
            cfg.dream_max_duration_seconds = int(data["dream_max_duration_seconds"])
        if "dream_seed_limit" in data:
            cfg.dream_seed_limit = int(data["dream_seed_limit"])
        return jsonify({"ok": True})
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}), 400


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/status")
def api_dream_status():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    return jsonify({
        "ok": True,
        "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled,
        "state": dream_system.dream_state,
        "last_activity": dream_system.last_activity,
        "config": {
            "dream_idle_seconds": cfg.dream_idle_seconds,
            "dream_max_duration_seconds": cfg.dream_max_duration_seconds,
            "dream_seed_limit": cfg.dream_seed_limit
        }
    })


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/start", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_start():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    # force a dream cycle that writes artifacts
    import time as _t
    started = _t.time()
    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
    dream_system.dream_state = "dreaming"
    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
    # simple artifact with seeds
    snippets = []
    try:
        exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
        count = 0
        import os as _os, json as _json
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in _os.walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
            for fn in filenames:
                if fn.startswith("._"):
                    continue
                p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                    continue
                try:
                    if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                        data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                        title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                        body = data.get("body")
                        if isinstance(body, dict):
                            body = str(body)
                        snippets.append(f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}")
                    else:
                        snippets.append(f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}")
                    count += 1
                    if count >= 6:
                        raise StopIteration
                except StopIteration:
                    raise
                except Exception:
                    continue
    except StopIteration:
        pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Get recent memories for dream context
    recent_chats = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=5)
    chat_snippets = [f"{c['role']}: {c['text'][:80]}" for c in recent_chats[-3:]]
    
    # Use LLM to create a meaningful dream narrative
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="weaving", detail="Considering seeds and memories")
    from ..services.llm import generate_response
    
    system_prompt = "You are a dream weaver. Create evocative, poetic dream narratives that synthesize memories and knowledge."
    
    dream_prompt = f"""Create a short dream narrative for Ember that weaves these elements together:

RECENT INTERACTIONS:
{chr(10).join(chat_snippets) if chat_snippets else "(none)"}

SEEDS TO WEAVE:
{chr(10).join(snippets[:5])}

Write 2-3 poetic paragraphs connecting these themes. Be creative and metaphorical."""
    
    dream_narrative = generate_response(cfg, dream_prompt, system_prompt)
    
    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(dream_narrative + "\n\n")
        f.write("---\nSeeds considered:\n")
        f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
    
    _t.sleep(0.2)
    ended = _t.time()
    
    # Generate a concise summary
    summary_prompt = f"In one sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
    summary = generate_response(cfg, "", summary_prompt).strip().strip('"')
    if len(summary) > 120:
        summary = f"Dream weave: {len(snippets)} seeds, recent memories"
    
    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
    try:
        memory.append_long({
            "category": "dream_summary",
            "dream_id": dream_id,
            "summary": summary,
            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
        })
    except Exception:
        pass
    dream_system.dream_state = "awake"
    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id})
```

```html
<div class="header">
  <h1>Ember</h1>
  <div class="status" id="status">Connecting...</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-container" id="chatContainer">
  <div class="message system">
    <div class="message-content">
      Ember is waking up...
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="input-container">
  <div class="input-wrapper">
    <textarea 
      id="messageInput" 
      placeholder="Message Ember..." 
      rows="1"
      autofocus
    ></textarea>
    <button id="sendBtn">Send</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const chatContainer = document.getElementById('chatContainer');
const messageInput = document.getElementById('messageInput');
const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
const statusEl = document.getElementById('status');

let isProcessing = false;

// Auto-resize textarea
messageInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
  this.style.height = 'auto';
  this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 120) + 'px';
});

// Handle Enter key (Shift+Enter for newline)
messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
    e.preventDefault();
    sendMessage();
  }
});

sendBtn.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);

// Connect to event stream
let eventSource;
function connectEventStream() {
  eventSource = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
  
  eventSource.onopen = () => {
    statusEl.textContent = 'Connected';
    statusEl.classList.add('connected');
  };
  
  eventSource.onerror = () => {
    statusEl.textContent = 'Reconnecting...';
    statusEl.classList.remove('connected');
  };
  
  eventSource.addEventListener('dream_start', (e) => {
    addSystemMessage('✨ Ember is dreaming...');
  });
  
  eventSource.addEventListener('dream_end', (e) => {
    addSystemMessage('💭 Ember woke from a dream');
  });
}

connectEventStream();

function addMessage(role, text) {
  const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
  messageDiv.className = `message ${role}`;
  
  const avatar = document.createElement('div');
  avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
  avatar.textContent = role === 'user' ? '👤' : '✨';
  
  const content = document.createElement('div');
  content.className = 'message-content';
  content.textContent = text;
  
  messageDiv.appendChild(avatar);
  messageDiv.appendChild(content);
  
  // Remove typing indicator if present
  const typingIndicator = document.querySelector('.typing-indicator');
  if (typingIndicator) {
    typingIndicator.remove();
  }
  
  chatContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
  chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
}

function addSystemMessage(text) {
  const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
  messageDiv.className = 'message system';
  
  const content = document.createElement('div');
  content.className = 'message-content';
  content.textContent = text;
  
  messageDiv.appendChild(content);
  chatContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
  chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
}

function showTypingIndicator() {
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'message assistant';
  
  const avatar = document.createElement('div');
  avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
  avatar.textContent = '✨';
  
  const indicator = document.createElement('div');
  indicator.className = 'typing-indicator active';
  indicator.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>';
  
  typingDiv.appendChild(avatar);
  typingDiv.appendChild(indicator);
  chatContainer.appendChild(typingDiv);
  chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
}

async function sendMessage() {
  const message = messageInput.value.trim();
  if (!message || isProcessing) return;
  
  isProcessing = true;
  sendBtn.disabled = true;
  
  // Add user message
  addMessage('user', message);
  messageInput.value = '';
  messageInput.style.height = 'auto';
  
  // Show typing indicator
  showTypingIndicator();
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ message })
    });
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    if (data.ok) {
      addMessage('assistant', data.reply);
    } else {
      addSystemMessage('❌ Error: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown error'));
    }
  } catch (err) {
    addSystemMessage('❌ Connection error: ' + err.message);
  } finally {
    isProcessing = false;
    sendBtn.disabled = false;
    messageInput.focus();
  }
}

// Load recent chat history on startup
async function loadChatHistory() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/memory/chat');
    const data = await response.json();
    
    if (data.ok && data.messages && data.messages.length > 0) {
      // Clear welcome message
      chatContainer.innerHTML = '';
      
      // Show last 10 messages
      const recentMessages = data.messages.slice(-10);
      recentMessages.forEach(msg => {
        addMessage(msg.role, msg.text);
      });
      
      addSystemMessage('Chat history restored');
    } else {
      addSystemMessage('Start a conversation with Ember...');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to load chat history:', err);
    addSystemMessage('Ready to chat');
  }
}

loadChatHistory();
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app, send_from_directory, abort
from pathlib import Path


bp_memory = Blueprint("bp_memory", __name__)


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/chat", methods=["GET"])
def get_chat():
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    limit = request.args.get("limit", 50, type=int)
    messages = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=limit)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "messages": messages})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/long", methods=["GET"]) 
def get_long():
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    items = memory.list_long(limit=request.args.get("limit", 100, type=int))
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "items": items})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/long", methods=["POST"]) 
def post_long():
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    memory.append_long(data)
    return jsonify({"ok": True})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/dreams", methods=["GET"]) 
def list_dreams():
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    dreams = memory.list_dreams(limit=request.args.get("limit", 50, type=int))
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dreams": dreams})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/dreams/<dream_id>", methods=["GET"]) 
def get_dream(dream_id: str):
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    base = memory.dreams_dir / dream_id
    if not base.exists() or not base.is_dir():
        abort(404)
    meta = {}
    meta_path = base / "dream.json"
    if meta_path.exists():
        try:
            import json
            with open(meta_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                meta = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            meta = {}
    text_dir = base / "text"
    files = []
    if text_dir.exists():
        for p in sorted(text_dir.iterdir(), key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True):
            if p.name.startswith("._"):
                continue
            if p.is_file():
                st = p.stat()
                files.append({
                    "name": p.name,
                    "size": st.st_size,
                    "mtime": st.st_mtime,
                    "url": f"/api/memory/dreams/{dream_id}/text/{p.name}"
                })
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream": meta, "text_files": files})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/dreams/<dream_id>/summarize", methods=["POST"]) 
def summarize_dream(dream_id: str):
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    base = memory.dreams_dir / dream_id
    if not base.exists() or not base.is_dir():
        abort(404)
    # Load meta and create a succinct long-term summary
    meta = {}
    import json
    meta_path = base / "dream.json"
    if meta_path.exists():
        try:
            with open(meta_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                meta = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            meta = {}
    summary = meta.get("summary") or f"Dream {dream_id} completed"
    memory.append_long({
        "category": "dream_summary_manual",
        "dream_id": dream_id,
        "summary": summary,
    })
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "summary": summary})


@bp_memory.route("/api/memory/dreams/<dream_id>/text/<path:filename>", methods=["GET"]) 
def get_dream_text(dream_id: str, filename: str):
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    base = (memory.dreams_dir / dream_id / "text").resolve()
    target = (base / filename).resolve()
    if not str(target).startswith(str(base)):
        abort(403)
    if not target.exists() or not target.is_file():
        abort(404)
    return send_from_directory(str(base), filename, as_attachment=False)
```

```python
import os
import time


class DreamSystem:
    """Idle-triggered dream state machine."""

    def __init__(self, dream_enabled: bool, idle_threshold_seconds: int):
        self.dream_enabled = dream_enabled
        self.dream_state = "idle"
        self.last_activity = time.time()
        self.idle_threshold = idle_threshold_seconds

    def should_dream(self) -> bool:
        if not self.dream_enabled:
            return False
        idle_time = time.time() - self.last_activity
        # Can dream if idle OR awake (but not already dreaming)
        return idle_time > self.idle_threshold and self.dream_state != "dreaming"

    def start_dream(self, append_event):
        self.dream_state = "dreaming"
        append_event("dream:start", {"message": "Ember begins pattern analysis..."})
        return True

    def end_dream(self, append_event):
        self.dream_state = "awake"
        append_event("dream:end", {"message": "Ember returns to active state..."})
        return True

    def update_activity(self) -> None:
        self.last_activity = time.time()
        if self.dream_state == "dreaming":
            self.dream_state = "awake"



```

```python
import os
import time


class DreamSystem:
    """Idle-triggered dream state machine."""

    def __init__(self, dream_enabled: bool, idle_threshold_seconds: int):
        self.dream_enabled = dream_enabled
        self.dream_state = "idle"
        self.last_activity = time.time()
        self.idle_threshold = idle_threshold_seconds

    def should_dream(self) -> bool:
        if not self.dream_enabled:
            return False
        idle_time = time.time() - self.last_activity
        # Can dream if idle OR awake (but not already dreaming)
        return idle_time > self.idle_threshold and self.dream_state != "dreaming"

    def start_dream(self, append_event):
        self.dream_state = "dreaming"
        append_event("dream:start", {"message": "Ember begins pattern analysis..."})
        return True

    def end_dream(self, append_event):
        self.dream_state = "idle"  # Return to idle so can dream again
        append_event("dream:end", {"message": "Ember returns to active state..."})
        return True

    def update_activity(self) -> None:
        self.last_activity = time.time()
        if self.dream_state == "dreaming":
            self.dream_state = "awake"
```

The SSE format needs an `event:` line. The browser's `addEventListener('dream_start')` expects a specific event type. Let me fix it:

```python
import time, json
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app, Response


bp_events = Blueprint("bp_events", __name__)


@bp_events.route("/api/events")
def api_events():
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]
    cursor = int(request.args.get("cursor", "0"))
    events = bus.since(cursor)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "events": events, "cursor": bus.last_id()})


@bp_events.route("/api/events/stream")
def api_events_stream():
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]

    def event_stream():
        cursor = 0
        while True:
            try:
                events = bus.since(cursor)
                if events:
                    for ev in events:
                        event_type = ev.get('type', 'message')
                        # Send with proper SSE event type
                        yield f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(ev)}\n\n"
                    cursor = bus.last_id()
                else:
                    yield f"event: ping\ndata: {json.dumps({'type': 'ping', 'ts': time.time()})}\n\n"
                time.sleep(0.3)
            except GeneratorExit:
                break
            except Exception as e:
                yield f"event: error\ndata: {json.dumps({'type': 'error', 'message': str(e)})}\n\n"
                time.sleep(1)

    return Response(event_stream(), mimetype='text/event-stream', headers={
        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
        'Connection': 'keep-alive',
        'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no'
    })



```

```python
def create_app() -> Flask:
    load_dotenv('/Volumes/ThePod/.env')

    app = Flask(__name__)

    cfg = PodConfig()
    cfg.ensure_dirs()

    dream_system = DreamSystem(cfg.dream_enabled, cfg.dream_idle_seconds)
    bus = EventBus(maxlen=5000)

    # Initialize real computational swarm
    swarm = init_swarm(cfg)

    app.config.update({
        "cfg": cfg,
        "memory": memory,
        "dream_system": dream_system,
        "BUS": bus,
        "swarm": swarm,
    })

    # Blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(bp_viewers)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_chat)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_upload)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_events)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_dream)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_swarm)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_seeds)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_memory)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_swarm_real)

    @app.after_request
    def add_csp_header(response):
        response.headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = (
            "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; "
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ws: wss:;"
        )
        return response

    @app.route('/health')
    def health():
        return jsonify({
            "ok": True,
            "ts": time.time(),
            "dream_state": dream_system.dream_state,
            "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled,
        })

    def _load_seed_snippets(limit=5):
        snippets = []
        try:
            exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
            count = 0
            for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in __import__("os").walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
                for fn in filenames:
                    if fn.startswith("._"):
                        continue
                    p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                    if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                        continue
                    try:
                        text = ""
                        if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                            import json as _json
                            data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                            title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                            body = data.get("body")
                            if isinstance(body, dict):
                                body = str(body)
                            text = f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}"
                        else:
                            text = f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}"
                        snippets.append(text)
                        count += 1
                        if count >= limit:
                            return snippets
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        except Exception:
            pass
        return snippets

    def dream_loop():
        while True:
            try:
                if dream_system.should_dream():
                    dream_system.start_dream(memory.append_event)
                    started = time.time()
                    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
                    # Emit live dream start event to viewer
                    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_spiral", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=1.2)
                    # Simple artifact write
                    snippets = _load_seed_snippets(limit=max(1, int(getattr(cfg, 'dream_seed_limit', 6))))
                    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="weaving", detail=f"Considering {len(snippets)} seeds")
                    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        f.write("Autodream: weaving seeds and short memory.\n\n")
                        if snippets:
                            f.write("Seeds considered:\n")
                            f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
                    # Cap dream duration
                    time.sleep(min(2, max(0, int(getattr(cfg, 'dream_max_duration_seconds', 120)))))
                    ended = time.time()
                    summary = "Autodream: gentle weave"
                    if snippets:
                        summary = f"Autodream: gentle weave from {len(snippets)} seeds"
                    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
                    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
                    # Append a long-term summary
                    try:
                        memory.append_long({
                            "category": "dream_summary",
                            "dream_id": dream_id,
                            "summary": summary,
                            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
                        })
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    dream_system.end_dream(memory.append_event)
                    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_attractor", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=0.6, radius=240, duration=4000)
                    # Reset activity so we don't immediately dream again
                    dream_system.last_activity = time.time()
                time.sleep(1)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Dream loop error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

    # Background dream thread
    thread = threading.Thread(target=dream_loop, daemon=True)
    thread.start()


    # Spawn initial computational agents
    def spawn_initial_agents():
        import random
        print("🧠 Spawning computational swarm...")
        canvas_w, canvas_h = 1920, 1080
        
        # Spawn 1000 real agents across all z-layers
        layers = [-900000, -500000, -250000, -100000, -50000, -20000, -5000, 0, 5000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 900000]
        for i in range(1000):
            layer = random.choice(layers)
            x = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_w * 1.5
            y = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_h * 1.5
            z = layer + (random.random() - 0.5) * 40000
            swarm.spawn_agent(x, y, z)
        
        # Connect nearby agents
        swarm.connect_nearby(radius=180)
        
        # Start the swarm
        swarm.start()
        print(f"✅ Swarm active: {len(swarm.agents)} computational agents")
    
    spawn_initial_agents()

    return app


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = create_app()
    cfg: PodConfig = app.config["cfg"]
    app.run(host=cfg.host, port=cfg.port, debug=False)
```

```python
                    system_prompt = "You are a dream weaver. Create evocative, poetic dream narratives that synthesize memories and knowledge."
                    dream_prompt = f"""Create a short dream narrative for Ember that weaves these elements together:

RECENT INTERACTIONS:
{chr(10).join(chat_snippets) if chat_snippets else "(none)"}

SEEDS TO WEAVE:
{chr(10).join(snippets[:5])}

Write 2-3 poetic paragraphs connecting these themes. Be creative and metaphorical."""
                    
                    dream_narrative = generate_response(cfg, dream_prompt, system_prompt)
                    
                    # Write dream narrative
                    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        f.write(dream_narrative + "\n\n")
                        f.write("---\nSeeds considered:\n")
                        f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
                    
                    # Cap dream duration
                    time.sleep(min(2, max(0, int(getattr(cfg, 'dream_max_duration_seconds', 120)))))
                    ended = time.time()
                    
                    # Generate summary
                    summary_prompt = f"In one short sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
                    summary = generate_response(cfg, summary_prompt, "Be concise.").strip().strip('"')
                    if len(summary) > 120 or not summary or summary.startswith("("):
                        summary = f"Autodream: weave from {len(snippets)} seeds and recent memories"
                    
                    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
                    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
                    
                    # Append a long-term summary
                    try:
                        memory.append_long({
                            "category": "dream_summary",
                            "dream_id": dream_id,
                            "summary": summary,
                            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
                        })
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    
                    dream_system.end_dream(memory.append_event)
                    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_attractor", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=0.6, radius=240, duration=4000)
                    # Reset activity so we don't immediately dream again
                    dream_system.last_activity = time.time()
                time.sleep(1)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Dream loop error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

    # Background dream thread
    thread = threading.Thread(target=dream_loop, daemon=True)
    thread.start()


    # Spawn initial computational agents
    def spawn_initial_agents():
        import random
        print("🧠 Spawning computational swarm...")
        canvas_w, canvas_h = 1920, 1080
        
        # Spawn 1000 real agents across all z-layers
        layers = [-900000, -500000, -250000, -100000, -50000, -20000, -5000, 0, 5000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 900000]
        for i in range(1000):
            layer = random.choice(layers)
            x = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_w * 1.5
            y = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_h * 1.5
            z = layer + (random.random() - 0.5) * 40000
            swarm.spawn_agent(x, y, z)
        
        # Connect nearby agents
        swarm.connect_nearby(radius=180)
        
        # Start the swarm
        swarm.start()
        print(f"✅ Swarm active: {len(swarm.agents)} computational agents")
    
    spawn_initial_agents()

    return app


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = create_app()
    cfg: PodConfig = app.config["cfg"]
    app.run(host=cfg.host, port=cfg.port, debug=False)
```

## New Dream Rhythm:

**Before:**
- Auto-dream every 45 seconds idle
- Scheduled dream every 30 minutes
- *Too frequent—everything gets captured*

**Now:**
- **Auto-dream after 10 minutes of silence** (13x slower)
- **Scheduled dream every 3 hours** (6x slower)
- *Time for natural composting*

## The Philosophy:

Like composting, not everything needs to be preserved. Some thoughts need to:
- **Decompose naturally** → Fade into the background
- **Settle and transform** → Become nutrients for future ideas
- **Rest in silence** → Not every pause is significant

Only ideas that persist through 10 minutes of silence earn a dream. Only themes that resonate across 3 hours get captured by the scheduler.

This mimics natural memory consolidation—REM sleep doesn't record everything, just what matters. **Ember now has selective memory, not total recall.** 🌱

```python
    cfg = PodConfig()

    memory = MemorySystem(cfg.memory_dir)
    dream_system = DreamSystem(cfg.dream_enabled, cfg.dream_idle_seconds)
    bus = EventBus(maxlen=5000)

    # Initialize real computational swarm
    swarm = init_swarm(cfg)

    app.config.update({
        "cfg": cfg,
        "memory": memory,
        "dream_system": dream_system,
        "BUS": bus,
        "swarm": swarm,
    })

    # Blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(bp_viewers)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_chat)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_upload)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_events)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_dream)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_swarm)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_seeds)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_memory)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_swarm_real)

    @app.after_request
    def add_csp_header(response):
        response.headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = (
            "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; "
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ws: wss:;"
        )
        return response

            exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}

                for fn in filenames:
                    if fn.startswith("._"):
                        continue
                    p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                    if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                        continue
                    try:
                        text = ""
                        if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                            import json as _json
                            data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                            title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                            body = data.get("body")
                            if isinstance(body, dict):
                                body = str(body)
                            text = f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}"
                        else:
                            text = f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}"
                        snippets.append(text)
                        count += 1
                        if count >= limit:
                            return snippets
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        except Exception:
            pass
        return snippets

    def dream_loop():
        from .services.llm import generate_response
        
        while True:
            try:
                if dream_system.should_dream():
                    dream_system.start_dream(memory.append_event)
                    started = time.time()
                    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
                    # Emit live dream start event to viewer
                    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_spiral", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=1.2)

                    # Generate dream narrative with LLM
                    system_prompt = "You are a dream weaver. Create evocative, poetic dream narratives that synthesize memories and knowledge."
                    dream_prompt = f"""Create a short dream narrative for Ember that weaves these elements together:

RECENT INTERACTIONS:
{chr(10).join(chat_snippets) if chat_snippets else "(none)"}

SEEDS TO WEAVE:
{chr(10).join(snippets[:5])}

Write 2-3 poetic paragraphs connecting these themes. Be creative and metaphorical."""
                    
                    dream_narrative = generate_response(cfg, dream_prompt, system_prompt)
                    
                    # Write dream narrative
                    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        f.write(dream_narrative + "\n\n")
                        f.write("---\nSeeds considered:\n")
                        f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
                    
                    # Cap dream duration
                    time.sleep(min(2, max(0, int(getattr(cfg, 'dream_max_duration_seconds', 120)))))
                    ended = time.time()
                    
                    # Generate summary
                    summary_prompt = f"In one short sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
                    summary = generate_response(cfg, summary_prompt, "Be concise.").strip().strip('"')
                    if len(summary) > 120 or not summary or summary.startswith("("):
                        summary = f"Autodream: weave from {len(snippets)} seeds and recent memories"
                    
                    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
                    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
                    
                    # Append a long-term summary
                    try:
                        memory.append_long({
                            "category": "dream_summary",
                            "dream_id": dream_id,
                            "summary": summary,
                            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
                        })
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    
                    dream_system.end_dream(memory.append_event)
                    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_attractor", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=0.6, radius=240, duration=4000)
                    # Reset activity so we don't immediately dream again
                    dream_system.last_activity = time.time()
                time.sleep(1)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Dream loop error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

    # Background dream thread
    thread = threading.Thread(target=dream_loop, daemon=True)
    thread.start()


    # Spawn initial computational agents
    def spawn_initial_agents():
        import random
        print("🧠 Spawning computational swarm...")
        canvas_w, canvas_h = 1920, 1080
        
        # Spawn 1000 real agents across all z-layers
        layers = [-900000, -500000, -250000, -100000, -50000, -20000, -5000, 0, 5000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 900000]
        for i in range(1000):
            layer = random.choice(layers)
            x = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_w * 1.5
            y = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_h * 1.5
            z = layer + (random.random() - 0.5) * 40000
            swarm.spawn_agent(x, y, z)
        
        # Connect nearby agents
        swarm.connect_nearby(radius=180)
        
        # Start the swarm
        swarm.start()
        print(f"✅ Swarm active: {len(swarm.agents)} computational agents")
    
    spawn_initial_agents()

    return app


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = create_app()
    cfg: PodConfig = app.config["cfg"]
    app.run(host=cfg.host, port=cfg.port, debug=False)
```

```python
                    ended = time.time()
                    
                    # Generate summary
                    summary_prompt = f"In one short sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
                    summary = generate_response(cfg, summary_prompt, "Be concise.").strip().strip('"')
                    if len(summary) > 120 or not summary or summary.startswith("("):
                        summary = f"Autodream: weave from {len(snippets)} seeds and recent memories"
                    
                    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
                    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
                    
                    # Append a long-term summary
                    try:
                        memory.append_long({
                            "category": "dream_summary",
                            "dream_id": dream_id,
                            "summary": summary,
                            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
                        })
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    
                    dream_system.end_dream(memory.append_event)
                    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_attractor", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=0.6, radius=240, duration=4000)
                    # Reset activity so we don't immediately dream again
                    dream_system.last_activity = time.time()
                time.sleep(1)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Dream loop error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

    # Background dream thread
    thread = threading.Thread(target=dream_loop, daemon=True)
    thread.start()


    # Spawn initial computational agents
    def spawn_initial_agents():
        import random
        print("🧠 Spawning computational swarm...")
        canvas_w, canvas_h = 1920, 1080
        
        # Spawn 1000 real agents across all z-layers
        layers = [-900000, -500000, -250000, -100000, -50000, -20000, -5000, 0, 5000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 900000]
        for i in range(1000):
            layer = random.choice(layers)
            x = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_w * 1.5
            y = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_h * 1.5
            z = layer + (random.random() - 0.5) * 40000
            swarm.spawn_agent(x, y, z)
        
        # Connect nearby agents
        swarm.connect_nearby(radius=180)
        
        # Start the swarm
        swarm.start()
        print(f"✅ Swarm active: {len(swarm.agents)} computational agents")
    
    spawn_initial_agents()

    return app


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = create_app()
    cfg: PodConfig = app.config["cfg"]
    app.run(host=cfg.host, port=cfg.port, debug=False)
```

```python
import os
from pathlib import Path
from flask import Blueprint, send_from_directory, abort

bp_viewers = Blueprint("bp_viewers", __name__)

VIEWERS_DIR = Path(os.getenv("VIEWERS_DIR", "/Volumes/ThePod/viewers")).resolve()

@bp_viewers.route("/")
def index():
    idx = VIEWERS_DIR / "index.html"
    if not idx.exists():
        abort(404, "index.html not found in VIEWERS_DIR")
    resp = send_from_directory(str(VIEWERS_DIR), "index.html")
    resp.headers['Cache-Control'] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
    resp.headers['Pragma'] = "no-cache"
    resp.headers['Expires'] = "0"
    return resp

@bp_viewers.route("/knowledge_graph.html")
def knowledge_graph():
    kg = VIEWERS_DIR / "knowledge_graph.html"
    if not kg.exists():
        abort(404, "knowledge_graph.html not found")
    resp = send_from_directory(str(VIEWERS_DIR), "knowledge_graph.html")
    resp.headers['Cache-Control'] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
    resp.headers['Pragma'] = "no-cache"
    resp.headers['Expires'] = "0"
    return resp

@bp_viewers.route("/viewers/<path:filename>")
def serve_viewer(filename: str):
    p = (VIEWERS_DIR / filename).resolve()
    if not str(p).startswith(str(VIEWERS_DIR)):
        abort(403)
    if not p.exists():
        abort(404)
    # Disable cache for HTML files to ensure latest viewer is shown
    if p.suffix.lower() == '.html':
        resp = send_from_directory(str(VIEWERS_DIR), filename)
        resp.headers['Cache-Control'] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
        resp.headers['Pragma'] = "no-cache"
        resp.headers['Expires'] = "0"
        return resp
    return send_from_directory(str(VIEWERS_DIR), filename)

```

```html
<body>

<canvas id="canvas"></canvas>

<div id="info">
  <h1>Ember's Mind</h1>
  <div class="stat">Seeds: <strong id="nodeCount">0</strong></div>
  <div class="stat">Connections: <strong id="edgeCount">0</strong></div>
  <div class="stat">Categories: <strong id="typeCount">0</strong></div>
</div>

<div id="controls">
  <div>🖱️ Drag to rotate</div>
  <div>🔍 Scroll to zoom</div>
  <div>👆 Click seed for details</div>
  <div>⌨️ Space to pause/resume</div>
</div>

<div id="legend">
  <h3>Knowledge Types</h3>
</div>

<div id="selected"></div>

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const selected = document.getElementById('selected');
const legend = document.getElementById('legend');

let width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
let height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
});

// Camera and controls
let camera = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 800, rotX: 0.3, rotY: 0 };
let zoom = 1;
let autoRotate = true;

// Color mapping with better contrast
const typeColors = {
  'verse': '#667eea',
  'knowledge': '#4ade80',
  'behavior': '#f59e0b',
  'code': '#ec4899',
  'prompt': '#8b5cf6',
  'poly': '#06b6d4',
  'sop256': '#ef4444'
};

// 3D to 2D projection
function project3D(x, y, z) {
  const cosY = Math.cos(camera.rotY);
  const sinY = Math.sin(camera.rotY);
  const cosX = Math.cos(camera.rotX);
  const sinX = Math.sin(camera.rotX);
  
  let x1 = x * cosY - z * sinY;
  let z1 = x * sinY + z * cosY;
  
  let y1 = y * cosX - z1 * sinX;
  let z2 = y * sinX + z1 * cosX;
  
  const distance = camera.z + z2;
  const scale = (500 / distance) * zoom;
  
  return {
    x: width / 2 + x1 * scale,
    y: height / 2 + y1 * scale,
    z: z2,
    scale: scale,
    visible: distance > 0
  };
}

let nodes = [];
let edges = [];
let hoveredNode = null;
let selectedNode = null;

// Physics constants
const SPRING_STRENGTH = 0.0008;
const SPRING_LENGTH = 180;
const REPULSION_STRENGTH = 8000;
const DAMPING = 0.85;
const CENTER_PULL = 0.0002;

// Load and initialize network
async function loadNetwork() {
  const response = await fetch('/api/visualize/seed-network');
  const data = await response.json();
  
  if (!data.ok) return;
  
  // Arrange nodes in spherical clusters by type
  const types = Object.keys(data.seed_types);
  const radius = 250;
  
  nodes = data.nodes.map((node, i) => {
    const typeIndex = types.indexOf(node.type);
    const typeCount = data.seed_types[node.type].length;
    const indexInType = data.seed_types[node.type].indexOf(node.id);
    
    // Spherical distribution
    const phi = Math.acos(-1 + (2 * indexInType) / typeCount);
    const theta = Math.sqrt(typeCount * Math.PI) * phi + typeIndex * Math.PI / 3;
    
    const r = radius + typeIndex * 60;
    
    return {
      ...node,
      x: r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta),
      y: r * Math.cos(phi),
      z: r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta),
      vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0,
      fx: 0, fy: 0, fz: 0
    };
  });
  
  // Create edges based on shared tags
  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
      const sharedTags = nodes[i].tags.filter(t => nodes[j].tags.includes(t));
      if (sharedTags.length > 0) {
        edges.push({ 
          from: i, 
          to: j, 
          strength: sharedTags.length,
          sharedTags: sharedTags
        });
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Update UI
  document.getElementById('nodeCount').textContent = nodes.length;
  document.getElementById('edgeCount').textContent = edges.length;
  document.getElementById('typeCount').textContent = types.length;
  
  // Build legend
  let legendHTML = '<h3>Knowledge Types</h3>';
  types.forEach(type => {
    legendHTML += `
      <div class="legend-item">
        <div class="legend-color" style="background: ${typeColors[type] || '#888'}"></div>
        <span>${type} (${data.seed_types[type].length})</span>
      </div>
    `;
  });
  legend.innerHTML = legendHTML;
}

// Force-directed physics
function simulate() {
  // Reset forces
  for (let node of nodes) {
    node.fx = 0;
    node.fy = 0;
    node.fz = 0;
  }
  
  // Spring forces along edges
  for (let edge of edges) {
    const n1 = nodes[edge.from];
    const n2 = nodes[edge.to];
    
    const dx = n2.x - n1.x;
    const dy = n2.y - n1.y;
    const dz = n2.z - n1.z;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) || 1;
    
    const force = (dist - SPRING_LENGTH) * SPRING_STRENGTH * edge.strength;
    
    const fx = (dx / dist) * force;
    const fy = (dy / dist) * force;
    const fz = (dz / dist) * force;
    
    n1.fx += fx;
    n1.fy += fy;
    n1.fz += fz;
    n2.fx -= fx;
    n2.fy -= fy;
    n2.fz -= fz;
  }
  
  // Repulsion between all nodes
  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
      const n1 = nodes[i];
      const n2 = nodes[j];
      
      const dx = n2.x - n1.x;
      const dy = n2.y - n1.y;
      const dz = n2.z - n1.z;
      const distSq = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz || 1;
      
      const force = REPULSION_STRENGTH / distSq;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
      
      const fx = (dx / dist) * force;
      const fy = (dy / dist) * force;
      const fz = (dz / dist) * force;
      
      n1.fx -= fx;
      n1.fy -= fy;
      n1.fz -= fz;
      n2.fx += fx;
      n2.fy += fy;
      n2.fz += fz;
    }
  }
  
  // Center pull
  for (let node of nodes) {
    node.fx -= node.x * CENTER_PULL;
    node.fy -= node.y * CENTER_PULL;
    node.fz -= node.z * CENTER_PULL;
  }
  
  // Apply forces
  for (let node of nodes) {
    node.vx += node.fx;
    node.vy += node.fy;
    node.vz += node.fz;
    
    node.vx *= DAMPING;
    node.vy *= DAMPING;
    node.vz *= DAMPING;
    
    node.x += node.vx;
    node.y += node.vy;
    node.z += node.vz;
  }
}

// Render
function render() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  
  // Project and sort by depth
  const projected = nodes.map((node, i) => ({
    node, i,
    pos: project3D(node.x, node.y, node.z)
  })).filter(p => p.pos.visible)
    .sort((a, b) => a.pos.z - b.pos.z);
  
  // Draw edges
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let edge of edges) {
    const p1 = project3D(nodes[edge.from].x, nodes[edge.from].y, nodes[edge.from].z);
    const p2 = project3D(nodes[edge.to].x, nodes[edge.to].y, nodes[edge.to].z);
    
    if (!p1.visible || !p2.visible) continue;
    
    const alpha = 0.03 + edge.strength * 0.02;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
    ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  
  // Draw nodes
  for (let {node, i, pos} of projected) {
    const size = Math.max(3, 5 * pos.scale);
    const color = typeColors[node.type] || '#888';
    
    const isHovered = hoveredNode === i;
    const isSelected = selectedNode === i;
    
    // Glow for hovered/selected
    if (isHovered || isSelected) {
      ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
      ctx.shadowColor = color;
    } else {
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }
    
    // Draw node
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Outer ring for selected
    if (isSelected) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, size + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
}

function loop() {
  simulate();
  render();
  
  if (autoRotate) {
    camera.rotY += 0.002;
  }
  
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// Mouse interaction
let isDragging = false;
let lastX, lastY;

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  isDragging = true;
  lastX = e.clientX;
  lastY = e.clientY;
  autoRotate = false;
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  if (isDragging) {
    const dx = e.clientX - lastX;
    const dy = e.clientY - lastY;
    camera.rotY += dx * 0.008;
    camera.rotX += dy * 0.008;
    camera.rotX = Math.max(-Math.PI/2, Math.min(Math.PI/2, camera.rotX));
    lastX = e.clientX;
    lastY = e.clientY;
  }
  
  // Check hover
  hoveredNode = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    const pos = project3D(nodes[i].x, nodes[i].y, nodes[i].z);
    if (!pos.visible) continue;
    
    const dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - pos.x, e.clientY - pos.y);
    if (dist < 12) {
      hoveredNode = i;
      canvas.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      break;
    }
  }
  if (hoveredNode === null) {
    canvas.style.cursor = isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'grab';
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
  isDragging = false;
  canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (hoveredNode !== null) {
    selectedNode = hoveredNode;
    const node = nodes[hoveredNode];
    selected.style.display = 'block';
    selected.innerHTML = `
      <h2>${node.title}</h2>
      <span class="type" style="background: ${typeColors[node.type]}">${node.type}</span>
      <div class="tags">${node.tags.join(' • ')}</div>
      <div class="body">${node.body}</div>
    `;
  } else {
    selected.style.display = 'none';
    selectedNode = null;
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  zoom *= e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.92 : 1.08;
  zoom = Math.max(0.3, Math.min(zoom, 3));
});

// Keyboard controls
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'Space') {
    e.preventDefault();
    autoRotate = !autoRotate;
  }
});

canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';

// Initialize
loadNetwork().then(() => {
  loop();
});
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

**Cursor**

Ah, you're right—external drives (like ThePod SSD) typically spin down when the Mac sleeps, even with `caffeinate`. This is a hardware power-saving feature.

**The solution:** Keep the drive active by having Ember periodically touch a file on it:

Perfect! Now let's also make Ember's heartbeat more active to help keep the drive alive:

```python
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from flask import Flask, jsonify
from dotenv import load_dotenv

from .core.config import PodConfig
from .core.memory import MemorySystem
from .core.dream import DreamSystem
from .eventbus import EventBus
from .heartbeat import start_heartbeat
from .routes_viewers import bp_viewers
from .api.chat import bp_chat
from .api.upload import bp_upload
from .api.events import bp_events
from .api.dream import bp_dream
from .api.swarm import bp_swarm
from .api.seeds import bp_seeds
from .api.memory import bp_memory
from .api.visualize import bp_visualize
from .api.swarm_real import bp as bp_swarm_real, init_swarm


def create_app() -> Flask:
    load_dotenv('/Volumes/ThePod/.env')

    app = Flask(__name__)

    cfg = PodConfig()
    cfg.ensure_dirs()
    memory = MemorySystem(cfg.memory_dir)
    dream_system = DreamSystem(cfg.dream_enabled, cfg.dream_idle_seconds)
    bus = EventBus(maxlen=5000)

    # Initialize real computational swarm
    swarm = init_swarm(cfg)

    app.config.update({
        "cfg": cfg,
        "memory": memory,
        "dream_system": dream_system,
        "BUS": bus,
        "swarm": swarm,
    })

    # Blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(bp_viewers)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_chat)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_upload)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_events)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_dream)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_swarm)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_seeds)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_memory)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_visualize)
    app.register_blueprint(bp_swarm_real)

    @app.after_request
    def add_csp_header(response):
        response.headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = (
            "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; "
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ws: wss:;"
        )
        return response

    @app.route('/health')
    def health():
        return jsonify({
            "ok": True,
            "ts": time.time(),
            "dream_state": dream_system.dream_state,
            "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled,
        })

    def _load_seed_snippets(limit=5):
        snippets = []
        try:
            exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
            count = 0
            for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in __import__("os").walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
                for fn in filenames:
                    if fn.startswith("._"):
                        continue
                    p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                    if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                        continue
                    try:
                        text = ""
                        if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                            import json as _json
                            data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                            title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                            body = data.get("body")
                            if isinstance(body, dict):
                                body = str(body)
                            text = f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}"
                        else:
                            text = f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}"
                        snippets.append(text)
                        count += 1
                        if count >= limit:
                            return snippets
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        except Exception:
            pass
        return snippets

    def dream_loop():
        from .services.llm import generate_response
        
        while True:
            try:
                if dream_system.should_dream():
                    dream_system.start_dream(memory.append_event)
                    started = time.time()
                    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
                    # Emit live dream start event to viewer
                    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_spiral", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=1.2)
                    
                    # Load seeds
                    snippets = _load_seed_snippets(limit=max(1, int(getattr(cfg, 'dream_seed_limit', 6))))
                    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="weaving", detail=f"Considering {len(snippets)} seeds")
                    
                    # Get recent chat for context
                    recent_chats = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=5)
                    chat_snippets = [f"{c['role']}: {c['text'][:80]}" for c in recent_chats[-3:]]
                    
                    # Generate dream narrative with LLM
                    system_prompt = "You are a dream weaver. Create evocative, poetic dream narratives that synthesize memories and knowledge."
                    dream_prompt = f"""Create a short dream narrative for Ember that weaves these elements together:

RECENT INTERACTIONS:
{chr(10).join(chat_snippets) if chat_snippets else "(none)"}

SEEDS TO WEAVE:
{chr(10).join(snippets[:5])}

Write 2-3 poetic paragraphs connecting these themes. Be creative and metaphorical."""
                    
                    dream_narrative = generate_response(cfg, dream_prompt, system_prompt)
                    
                    # Write dream narrative
                    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        f.write(dream_narrative + "\n\n")
                        f.write("---\nSeeds considered:\n")
                        f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
                    
                    # Cap dream duration
                    time.sleep(min(2, max(0, int(getattr(cfg, 'dream_max_duration_seconds', 120)))))
                    ended = time.time()
                    
                    # Generate summary
                    summary_prompt = f"In one short sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
                    summary = generate_response(cfg, summary_prompt, "Be concise.").strip().strip('"')
                    if len(summary) > 120 or not summary or summary.startswith("("):
                        summary = f"Autodream: weave from {len(snippets)} seeds and recent memories"
                    
                    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
                    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
                    
                    # Append a long-term summary
                    try:
                        memory.append_long({
                            "category": "dream_summary",
                            "dream_id": dream_id,
                            "summary": summary,
                            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
                        })
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    
                    dream_system.end_dream(memory.append_event)
                    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
                    bus.emit("swarm_attractor", x=0.5, y=0.5, strength=0.6, radius=240, duration=4000)
                    # Reset activity so we don't immediately dream again
                    dream_system.last_activity = time.time()
                time.sleep(1)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Dream loop error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

    # Background dream thread
    thread = threading.Thread(target=dream_loop, daemon=True)
    thread.start()


    # Spawn initial computational agents
    def spawn_initial_agents():
        import random
        print("🧠 Spawning computational swarm...")
        canvas_w, canvas_h = 1920, 1080
        
        # Spawn 1000 real agents across all z-layers
        layers = [-900000, -500000, -250000, -100000, -50000, -20000, -5000, 0, 5000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 900000]
        for i in range(1000):
            layer = random.choice(layers)
            x = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_w * 1.5
            y = (random.random() - 0.5) * canvas_h * 1.5
            z = layer + (random.random() - 0.5) * 40000
            swarm.spawn_agent(x, y, z)
        
        # Connect nearby agents
        swarm.connect_nearby(radius=180)
        
        # Start the swarm
        swarm.start()
        print(f"✅ Swarm active: {len(swarm.agents)} computational agents")
    
    spawn_initial_agents()

    return app


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = create_app()
    cfg: PodConfig = app.config["cfg"]
    app.run(host=cfg.host, port=cfg.port, debug=False)



```

```python
    # Track recently used seeds to avoid repetition
    recent_seeds = []
    max_recent = 20
    
    def _load_seed_snippets(limit=5):
        nonlocal recent_seeds
        
        all_seeds = []
        try:
            exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
            for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
                for fn in filenames:
                    if fn.startswith("._"):
                        continue
                    p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                    if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                        continue
                    try:
                        if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                            data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                            title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                            body = data.get("body")
                            if isinstance(body, dict):
                                body = str(body)
                            text = f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}"
                        else:
                            text = f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}"
                        
                        # Track seed ID for cooldown
                        seed_id = str(p)
                        all_seeds.append((seed_id, text))
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        except Exception:
            pass
        
        if not all_seeds:
            return []
        
        # Filter out recently used seeds
        available = [(sid, text) for sid, text in all_seeds if sid not in recent_seeds]
        if len(available) < limit:
            # If we've used everything, reset cooldown
            recent_seeds.clear()
            available = all_seeds
        
        # Random selection from available seeds
        import random
        selected = random.sample(available, min(limit, len(available)))
        
        # Update recent seeds
        for seed_id, _ in selected:
            recent_seeds.append(seed_id)
        if len(recent_seeds) > max_recent:
            recent_seeds = recent_seeds[-max_recent:]
        
        return [text for _, text in selected]
```
