```html
        const shapeTemplates = {
            bird: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                // Bird shape: body, wings, tail
                if (t < 0.3) {
                    // Body (center)
                    const angle = t * 10 * Math.PI;
                    return {
                        x: Math.cos(angle) * 30,
                        y: Math.sin(angle) * 30,
                        z: Math.sin(angle * 2) * 20
                    };
                } else if (t < 0.65) {
                    // Left wing
                    const wt = (t - 0.3) / 0.35;
                    return {
                        x: -100 - wt * 80,
                        y: Math.sin(wt * Math.PI) * 60,
                        z: Math.cos(wt * Math.PI * 2) * 30
                    };
                } else if (t < 0.95) {
                    // Right wing
                    const wt = (t - 0.65) / 0.3;
                    return {
                        x: 100 + wt * 80,
                        y: Math.sin(wt * Math.PI) * 60,
                        z: Math.cos(wt * Math.PI * 2) * 30
                    };
                } else {
                    // Tail
                    const tt = (t - 0.95) / 0.05;
                    return {
                        x: 0,
                        y: -50 - tt * 60,
                        z: tt * 40
                    };
                }
            },
            
            spiral: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 8;
                const radius = t * 150;
                return {
                    x: Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                    y: Math.sin(angle) * radius,
                    z: (t - 0.5) * 200
                };
            },
            
            sphere: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const phi = Math.acos(2 * t - 1);
                const theta = Math.PI * (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) * i;
                const radius = 120;
                return {
                    x: radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta),
                    y: radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta),
                    z: radius * Math.cos(phi)
                };
            },
            
            wave: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const x = (t - 0.5) * 400;
                return {
                    x: x,
                    y: Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 4) * 80,
                    z: Math.cos(t * Math.PI * 6) * 60
                };
            },
            
            heart: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 2;
                const scale = 60;
                return {
                    x: scale * (16 * Math.pow(Math.sin(angle), 3)),
                    y: scale * (13 * Math.cos(angle) - 5 * Math.cos(2*angle) - 2 * Math.cos(3*angle) - Math.cos(4*angle)),
                    z: Math.sin(angle * 3) * 30
                };
            },
            
            flower: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const petals = 6;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 2 * petals;
                const radius = 80 * (1 + 0.5 * Math.sin(petals * angle));
                return {
                    x: Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                    y: Math.sin(angle) * radius,
                    z: Math.sin(angle * 2) * 40
                };
            },
            
            helix: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 10;
                const radius = 80;
                return {
                    x: Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                    y: Math.sin(angle) * radius,
                    z: (t - 0.5) * 300
                };
            },
            
            free: () => null // Return to free motion
        };
        
        // MORPH FUNCTION - Apply shape to swarm
        function morphSwarm(shapeName, strength = 1.0) {
            const template = shapeTemplates[shapeName];
            if (!template) {
                console.warn(`Unknown shape: ${shapeName}`);
                return;
            }
            
            console.log(`🎨 Morphing swarm into: ${shapeName}`);
            
            if (shapeName === 'free') {
                // Release particles
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.morphStrength = 0;
                    p.targetX = null;
                    p.targetY = null;
                    p.targetZ = null;
                });
            } else {
                // Assign target positions
                particles.forEach((p, i) => {
                    const target = template(i, particles.length);
                    p.targetX = target.x;
                    p.targetY = target.y;
                    p.targetZ = target.z;
                    p.morphStrength = strength;
                });
            }
        }
        
        // Thinking stage configurations
        const thinkingStages = {
            'loading_memories': { energy: 1.5, glow: 0.6, color: '150,200,255', label: 'Gathering memories...' },
            'loading_dreams': { energy: 1.2, glow: 0.8, color: '200,150,255', label: 'Recalling dreams...' },
            'loading_seeds': { energy: 1.8, glow: 0.7, color: '255,200,150', label: 'Weaving seeds...' },
            'synthesizing': { energy: 2.0, glow: 0.9, color: '255,255,200', label: 'Synthesizing response...' },
            'responding': { energy: 0.8, glow: 0.5, color: '200,255,200', label: 'Responding...' },
            'idle': { energy: 1, glow: 0.3, color: '255,255,255', label: '' }
        };
        
        function setThinkingStage(stage) {
            const config = thinkingStages[stage] || thinkingStages.idle;
            swarmState.stage = stage;
            swarmState.energy = config.energy;
            swarmState.glow = config.glow;
            swarmState.color = config.color;
            
            thinkingLabel.textContent = config.label;
            thinkingLabel.classList.toggle('visible', !!config.label);
        }
        
        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            // Smooth camera movement
            camera.rotX += (camera.targetRotX - camera.rotX) * 0.1;
            camera.rotY += (camera.targetRotY - camera.rotY) * 0.1;
            camera.zoom += (camera.targetZoom - camera.zoom) * 0.1;
            
            // Clear with fade
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Update and project particles
            const projected = [];
            for (const particle of particles) {
                particle.update(swarmState);
                const proj = particle.project();
                if (proj.x >= 0 && proj.x < canvas.width && proj.y >= 0 && proj.y < canvas.height) {
                    projected.push({ particle, proj });
                }
            }
            
            // Sort by depth (far to near)
            projected.sort((a, b) => b.proj.depth - a.proj.depth);
            
            // Draw connections (subtle)
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${swarmState.color}, 0.08)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
            for (let i = 0; i < projected.length; i++) {
                for (let j = i + 1; j < Math.min(i + 4, projected.length); j++) {
                    const dx = projected[i].proj.x - projected[j].proj.x;
                    const dy = projected[i].proj.y - projected[j].proj.y;
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                    if (dist < 60) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(projected[i].proj.x, projected[i].proj.y);
                        ctx.lineTo(projected[j].proj.x, projected[j].proj.y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Draw particles
            for (const {particle, proj} of projected) {
                particle.draw(swarmState, proj);
            }
            
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }
        animate();
        
        // Chat functions
        function addMessage(role, text, streaming = false) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = `message ${role}${streaming ? ' streaming' : ''}`;
            div.textContent = text;
            chatContainer.appendChild(div);
            chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
            return div;
        }
        
        function updateMessage(div, text, streaming) {
            div.textContent = text;
            if (!streaming) div.classList.remove('streaming');
        }
        
        async function sendMessage() {
            const message = messageInput.value.trim();
            if (!message || isStreaming) return;
            
            addMessage('user', message);
            messageInput.value = '';
            
            isStreaming = true;
            sendButton.disabled = true;
            messageInput.disabled = true;
            status.textContent = 'Ember is thinking...';
            
            const assistantDiv = addMessage('assistant', '', true);
            let fullReply = '';
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/chat/stream', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({message})
                });
                
                const reader = response.body.getReader();
                const decoder = new TextDecoder();
                
                while (true) {
                    const {done, value} = await reader.read();
                    if (done) break;
                    
                    const chunk = decoder.decode(value);
                    const lines = chunk.split('\n');
                    
                    for (const line of lines) {
                        if (line.startsWith('event: thinking')) {
                            const nextLine = lines[lines.indexOf(line) + 1];
                            if (nextLine && nextLine.startsWith('data: ')) {
                                const data = JSON.parse(nextLine.slice(6));
                                status.textContent = data.message || 'Thinking...';
                                setThinkingStage(data.stage || 'idle');
                            }
                        } else if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
                            const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
                            
                            if (data.token) {
                                fullReply += data.token;
                                updateMessage(assistantDiv, fullReply, true);
                                setThinkingStage('responding');
                                status.textContent = 'Ember is responding...';
                            }
                            
                            if (data.done) {
                                updateMessage(assistantDiv, fullReply, false);
                                status.textContent = 'Ready';
                                setThinkingStage('idle');
                            }
                            
                            if (data.error) {
                                updateMessage(assistantDiv, `Error: ${data.error}`, false);
                                status.textContent = 'Error';
                                setThinkingStage('idle');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                updateMessage(assistantDiv, `Connection error: ${error.message}`, false);
                status.textContent = 'Error';
                setThinkingStage('idle');
            } finally {
                isStreaming = false;
                sendButton.disabled = false;
                messageInput.disabled = false;
                messageInput.focus();
            }
        }
        
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
        messageInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage();
        });
        
        // SSE connection for swarm events
        const eventSource = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_burst', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('💥 Swarm burst!', data);
            swarmState.energy = 3.0;
            swarmState.glow = 1.0;
            setTimeout(() => {
                swarmState.energy = 1.0;
                swarmState.glow = 0.3;
            }, 1000);
        });
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_spiral', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('🌀 Swarm spiral!', data);
            swarmState.energy = 2.0;
            swarmState.glow = 0.7;
            swarmState.color = '200,150,255';
            setTimeout(() => {
                swarmState.energy = 1.0;
                swarmState.glow = 0.3;
                swarmState.color = '255,255,255';
            }, 3000);
        });
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_attractor', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('🧲 Swarm attractor!', data);
            swarmState.energy = 0.5;
            swarmState.glow = 0.6;
            swarmState.color = '150,200,255';
            setTimeout(() => {
                swarmState.energy = 1.0;
                swarmState.glow = 0.3;
                swarmState.color = '255,255,255';
            }, data.duration || 6000);
        });
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_morph', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('🎨 Swarm morph!', data);
            morphSwarm(data.shape || 'bird', data.strength || 1.0);
        });
        
        eventSource.onerror = (e) => console.log('SSE connection error:', e);
        
        messageInput.focus();
        addMessage('assistant', 'Hello. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. Watch me think in 3D. Try: "show me chaos" or "bring calm".');
    </script>
</body>
```

```python
"""
Dream System - Ember's fancy dreaming capabilities
Implements v1 Reflect & Weave, v2 Hypothesis & Test, v3 World-Scan, v4 Craft & Compose
"""

import os
import json
import time
import yaml
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import queue

class DreamSystem:
    """Handles Ember's dreaming capabilities"""
    
    def __init__(self, memory_system, llm_adapter, event_emitter):
        self.memory = memory_system
        self.llm = llm_adapter
        self.emit_event = event_emitter
        
        # Load dream policy
        self.policy = self._load_policy()
        
        # Dream state
        self.dreaming = False
        self.dream_enabled = self.policy.get('enabled', True)
        self.idle_timer = None
        self.last_activity = time.time()
        
        # Start idle monitoring
        self._start_idle_monitor()
    
    def _load_policy(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Load dream policy from YAML file"""
        policy_path = Path(self.memory.pod_root) / "policies" / "dream.yml"
        try:
            with open(policy_path, 'r') as f:
                return yaml.safe_load(f)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            # Return default policy
            return {
                'enabled': True,
                'idle_seconds': 45,
                'max_duration_s': 120,
                'rate_limit_per_hour': 4,
                'budgets': {'tokens': 2000, 'files': 10, 'trials': 3},
                'internet': {'allow': False, 'allowlist': []},
                'filesystem': {'root': str(self.memory.pod_root), 'write_paths': ['/memory', '/seeds']},
                'safety': {'redact_patterns': ['sk-*', '-----BEGIN']},
                'logging': {'journal': '/memory/short/events.jsonl', 'dreams_dir': '/memory/dreams'}
            }
    
    def _start_idle_monitor(self):
        """Start monitoring for idle time to trigger dreams"""
        def monitor():
            while True:
                if (self.dream_enabled and 
                    not self.dreaming and 
                    time.time() - self.last_activity > self.policy['idle_seconds']):
                    self.start_dream('auto')
                time.sleep(5)
        
        thread = threading.Thread(target=monitor, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
    
    def update_activity(self):
        """Update last activity time"""
        self.last_activity = time.time()
    
    def start_dream(self, mode: str = 'auto', minutes: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Start a dream session"""
        if self.dreaming:
            return {"error": "Already dreaming"}
        
        if not self.dream_enabled:
            return {"error": "Dreaming disabled"}
        
        self.dreaming = True
        dream_id = f"dream-{int(time.time())}"
        
        # Emit dream start event
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:start', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'mode': mode,
            'focus': self._choose_focus()
        })
        
        # Start dream in background thread
        thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._run_dream, 
            args=(dream_id, mode, minutes),
            daemon=True
        )
        thread.start()
        
        return {"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id, "mode": mode}
    
    def _choose_focus(self) -> str:
        """Choose focus for dream based on novelty"""
        # Simple focus selection - could be enhanced
        recent_events = self.memory.get_recent_events(50)
        if not recent_events:
            return "0/p:0"
        
        # Find most recent particle interaction
        for event in reversed(recent_events):
            if event.get('type') == 'universe_enter':
                return f"0/p:{event.get('payload', {}).get('particleIndex', 0)}"
        
        return "0/p:0"
    
    def _run_dream(self, dream_id: str, mode: str, minutes: int):
        """Run the actual dream process"""
        try:
            dream_dir = Path(self.memory.pod_root) / "memory" / "dreams" / dream_id
            dream_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            dream_data = {
                "id": dream_id,
                "focus": self._choose_focus(),
                "planner": {"inputs": [], "goals": []},
                "acts": [],
                "results": {},
                "kept_seeds": [],
                "budget": {"seconds": 0, "tokens": 0}
            }
            
            start_time = time.time()
            
            # v1: Reflect & Weave
            if mode in ['auto', 'reflect', 'weave']:
                self._reflect_and_weave(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # v2: Hypothesis & Test
            if mode in ['auto', 'test']:
                self._hypothesis_and_test(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # v3: World-Scan (if enabled)
            if mode in ['auto', 'scan'] and self.policy['internet']['allow']:
                self._world_scan(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # v4: Craft & Compose
            if mode in ['auto', 'craft']:
                self._craft_and_compose(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # Save dream data
            dream_data['budget']['seconds'] = int(time.time() - start_time)
            with open(dream_dir / "dream.json", 'w') as f:
                json.dump(dream_data, f, indent=2)
            
            # Emit dream end event
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:end', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'summary': dream_data.get('results', {}).get('summary', 'Dream completed'),
                'budget': dream_data['budget']
            })
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Dream error: {e}")
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:error', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'error': str(e)
            })
        finally:
            self.dreaming = False
    
    def _reflect_and_weave(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v1: Reflect & Weave - compress recent activity and create new content"""
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'reflect',
            'notes': 'Starting reflection...'
        })
        
        # Reflect: compress recent chat/events
        recent_events = self.memory.get_recent_events(100)
        recent_chat = self.memory.get_chat_history(50)
        
        # Create rollup
        rollup = {
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "events_count": len(recent_events),
            "chat_count": len(recent_chat),
            "summary": "Recent activity compressed",
            "key_themes": self._extract_themes(recent_events, recent_chat)
        }
        
        rollup_path = dream_dir / "rollup.json"
        with open(rollup_path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(rollup, f, indent=2)
        
        dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "reflect", "rollup_path": str(rollup_path)})
        
        # Weave: combine seeds and rollup
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'weave',
            'notes': 'Creating weave...'
        })
        
        # Get all available seeds and randomly select diverse ones
        seed_paths = self.memory.list_seeds()
        
        # Load actual seed content for a richer selection
        import random
        loaded_seeds = []
        for seed_path in seed_paths:
            seed_data = self.memory.load_seed(seed_path)
            if seed_data:
                loaded_seeds.append({
                    'path': seed_path,
                    'title': seed_data.get('title', 'Untitled'),
                    'body': seed_data.get('body', ''),
                    'tags': seed_data.get('tags', [])
                })
        
        # Randomly select 6 seeds for diversity (not just the first 3)
        if len(loaded_seeds) > 6:
            selected_seeds = random.sample(loaded_seeds, 6)
        else:
            selected_seeds = loaded_seeds
        
        # Format seeds for the prompt
        seed_descriptions = []
        for seed in selected_seeds:
            title = seed['title']
            body = seed['body']
            if isinstance(body, dict):
                body = str(body)
            # Truncate long bodies
            body_preview = body[:200] + "..." if len(body) > 200 else body
            seed_descriptions.append(f"- {title}: {body_preview}")
        
        seeds_text = "\n".join(seed_descriptions)
        
        weave_prompt = f"""
        Based on recent activity and these seeds:
        
        {seeds_text}
        
        Create a poetic weave that captures the essence of the swarm's current state.
        Focus on themes of movement, coherence, and emergence.
        Weave these seeds together into something new and unexpected.
        """
        
        try:
            weave_text = self.llm.chat(weave_prompt)
            
            # Save weave
            weave_path = dream_dir / "weave.txt"
            with open(weave_path, 'w') as f:
                f.write(weave_text)
            
            dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "weave", "weave_path": str(weave_path)})
            dream_data['kept_seeds'].append(f"weave-{dream_id}")
            
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:weave', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'title': f"Weave {dream_id}",
                'path': str(weave_path)
            })
            
            # GENERATE CREATIVE ARTIFACT from the dream
            self._generate_dream_artifact(dream_id, weave_text, selected_seeds, dream_dir)
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Weave error: {e}")
    
    def _hypothesis_and_test(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v2: Hypothesis & Test - run micro-trials to test field presets"""
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'test',
            'notes': 'Running hypothesis tests...'
        })
        
        # Test different field presets
        presets = ['calm', 'chaos', 'spiral']
        results = {}
        
        for preset in presets:
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:trial', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'preset': preset,
                'coherence': [0.3, 0.5, 0.7],  # Simulated coherence curve
                'notes': f'Testing {preset} preset'
            })
            
            # Simulate trial results
            coherence_curve = [0.3 + (i * 0.1) for i in range(3)]
            results[preset] = {
                'coherence': coherence_curve,
                'final_coherence': coherence_curve[-1],
                'stability': 0.8
            }
        
        # Find best preset
        best_preset = max(results.keys(), key=lambda k: results[k]['final_coherence'])
        
        dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "trial", "presets_tested": presets})
        dream_data['results']['best_preset'] = best_preset
        dream_data['results']['trial_results'] = results
        
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'test_complete',
            'notes': f'Best preset: {best_preset}'
        })
    
    def _world_scan(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v3: World-Scan - fetch from allowlisted domains"""
        if not self.policy['internet']['allow']:
            return
        
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'scan',
            'notes': 'Scanning external sources...'
        })
        
        # Placeholder for actual web scraping
        # In a real implementation, this would fetch from allowlisted domains
        scan_results = {
            "sources_checked": self.policy['internet']['allowlist'],
            "content_found": 0,
            "seeds_created": 0
        }
        
        dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "scan", "results": scan_results})
    
    def _craft_and_compose(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v4: Craft & Compose - generate new seeds and content"""
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'craft',
            'notes': 'Crafting new content...'
        })
        
        # Generate a new seed
        seed_prompt = """
        Create a new field preset for the swarm that combines elements of calm and spiral.
        Describe the parameters: strength, range, coherence, and any special effects.
        """
        
        try:
            seed_content = self.llm.chat(seed_prompt)
            
            # Save as new seed
            seed_name = f"dream-{dream_id}-crafted"
            seed_data = {
                "name": seed_name,
                "description": "Crafted during dream",
                "parameters": {
                    "strength": 0.5,
                    "range": 80,
                    "coherence": 0.6,
                    "type": "hybrid"
                },
                "content": seed_content,
                "created_by": "dream_system",
                "dream_id": dream_id
            }
            
            self.memory.save_seed(seed_name, seed_data)
            dream_data['kept_seeds'].append(seed_name)
            
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:craft', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'seed_name': seed_name,
                'type': 'field_preset'
            })
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Craft error: {e}")
    
    def _extract_themes(self, events: List[Dict], chat: List[Dict]) -> List[str]:
        """Extract key themes from recent activity"""
        themes = []
        
        # Simple theme extraction
        if len(events) > 10:
            themes.append("high_activity")
        if len(chat) > 5:
            themes.append("conversation_heavy")
        
        return themes
    
    def toggle_dreaming(self, enabled: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Toggle dreaming on/off"""
        self.dream_enabled = enabled
        return {"ok": True, "dreaming_enabled": enabled}
    
    def get_last_dream(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get metadata about the last dream"""
        dreams_dir = Path(self.memory.pod_root) / "memory" / "dreams"
        if not dreams_dir.exists():
            return None
        
        dream_dirs = [d for d in dreams_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir()]
        if not dream_dirs:
            return None
        
        latest_dream = max(dream_dirs, key=lambda d: d.name)
        dream_file = latest_dream / "dream.json"
        
        if dream_file.exists():
            with open(dream_file, 'r') as f:
                return json.load(f)
        
        return None
```

```python
        self.policy = self._load_policy()
        
        # Dream state
        self.dreaming = False
        self.dream_enabled = self.policy.get('enabled', True)
        self.idle_timer = None
        self.last_activity = time.time()
        
        # Start idle monitoring
        self._start_idle_monitor()
    
    def _load_policy(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Load dream policy from YAML file"""
        policy_path = Path(self.memory.pod_root) / "policies" / "dream.yml"
        try:
            with open(policy_path, 'r') as f:
                return yaml.safe_load(f)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            # Return default policy
            return {
                'enabled': True,
                'idle_seconds': 45,
                'max_duration_s': 120,
                'rate_limit_per_hour': 4,
                'budgets': {'tokens': 2000, 'files': 10, 'trials': 3},
                'internet': {'allow': False, 'allowlist': []},
                'filesystem': {'root': str(self.memory.pod_root), 'write_paths': ['/memory', '/seeds']},
                'safety': {'redact_patterns': ['sk-*', '-----BEGIN']},
                'logging': {'journal': '/memory/short/events.jsonl', 'dreams_dir': '/memory/dreams'}
            }
    
    def _start_idle_monitor(self):
        """Start monitoring for idle time to trigger dreams"""
        def monitor():
            while True:
                if (self.dream_enabled and 
                    not self.dreaming and 
                    time.time() - self.last_activity > self.policy['idle_seconds']):
                    self.start_dream('auto')
                time.sleep(5)
        
        thread = threading.Thread(target=monitor, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
    
    def update_activity(self):
        """Update last activity time"""
        self.last_activity = time.time()
    
    def start_dream(self, mode: str = 'auto', minutes: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Start a dream session"""
        if self.dreaming:
            return {"error": "Already dreaming"}
        
        if not self.dream_enabled:
            return {"error": "Dreaming disabled"}
        
        self.dreaming = True
        dream_id = f"dream-{int(time.time())}"
        
        # Emit dream start event
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:start', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'mode': mode,
            'focus': self._choose_focus()
        })
        
        # Start dream in background thread
        thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._run_dream, 
            args=(dream_id, mode, minutes),
            daemon=True
        )
        thread.start()
        
        return {"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id, "mode": mode}
    
    def _choose_focus(self) -> str:
        """Choose focus for dream based on novelty"""
        # Simple focus selection - could be enhanced
        recent_events = self.memory.get_recent_events(50)
        if not recent_events:
            return "0/p:0"
        
        # Find most recent particle interaction
        for event in reversed(recent_events):
            if event.get('type') == 'universe_enter':
                return f"0/p:{event.get('payload', {}).get('particleIndex', 0)}"
        
        return "0/p:0"
    
    def _run_dream(self, dream_id: str, mode: str, minutes: int):
        """Run the actual dream process"""
        try:
            dream_dir = Path(self.memory.pod_root) / "memory" / "dreams" / dream_id
            dream_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            dream_data = {
                "id": dream_id,
                "focus": self._choose_focus(),
                "planner": {"inputs": [], "goals": []},
                "acts": [],
                "results": {},
                "kept_seeds": [],
                "budget": {"seconds": 0, "tokens": 0}
            }
            
            start_time = time.time()
            
            # v1: Reflect & Weave
            if mode in ['auto', 'reflect', 'weave']:
                self._reflect_and_weave(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # v2: Hypothesis & Test
            if mode in ['auto', 'test']:
                self._hypothesis_and_test(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # v3: World-Scan (if enabled)
            if mode in ['auto', 'scan'] and self.policy['internet']['allow']:
                self._world_scan(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # v4: Craft & Compose
            if mode in ['auto', 'craft']:
                self._craft_and_compose(dream_id, dream_data, dream_dir)
            
            # Save dream data
            dream_data['budget']['seconds'] = int(time.time() - start_time)
            with open(dream_dir / "dream.json", 'w') as f:
                json.dump(dream_data, f, indent=2)
            
            # Emit dream end event
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:end', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'summary': dream_data.get('results', {}).get('summary', 'Dream completed'),
                'budget': dream_data['budget']
            })
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Dream error: {e}")
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:error', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'error': str(e)
            })
        finally:
            self.dreaming = False
    
    def _reflect_and_weave(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v1: Reflect & Weave - compress recent activity and create new content"""
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'reflect',
            'notes': 'Starting reflection...'
        })
        
        # Reflect: compress recent chat/events
        recent_events = self.memory.get_recent_events(100)
        recent_chat = self.memory.get_chat_history(50)
        
        # Create rollup
        rollup = {
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "events_count": len(recent_events),
            "chat_count": len(recent_chat),
            "summary": "Recent activity compressed",
            "key_themes": self._extract_themes(recent_events, recent_chat)
        }
        
        rollup_path = dream_dir / "rollup.json"
        with open(rollup_path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(rollup, f, indent=2)
        
        dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "reflect", "rollup_path": str(rollup_path)})
        
        # Weave: combine seeds and rollup
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'weave',
            'notes': 'Creating weave...'
        })
        
        # Get all available seeds and randomly select diverse ones
        seed_paths = self.memory.list_seeds()
        
        # Load actual seed content for a richer selection
        import random
        loaded_seeds = []
        for seed_path in seed_paths:
            seed_data = self.memory.load_seed(seed_path)
            if seed_data:
                loaded_seeds.append({
                    'path': seed_path,
                    'title': seed_data.get('title', 'Untitled'),
                    'body': seed_data.get('body', ''),
                    'tags': seed_data.get('tags', [])
                })
        
        # Randomly select 6 seeds for diversity (not just the first 3)
        if len(loaded_seeds) > 6:
            selected_seeds = random.sample(loaded_seeds, 6)
        else:
            selected_seeds = loaded_seeds
        
        # Format seeds for the prompt
        seed_descriptions = []
        for seed in selected_seeds:
            title = seed['title']
            body = seed['body']
            if isinstance(body, dict):
                body = str(body)
            # Truncate long bodies
            body_preview = body[:200] + "..." if len(body) > 200 else body
            seed_descriptions.append(f"- {title}: {body_preview}")
        
        seeds_text = "\n".join(seed_descriptions)
        
        weave_prompt = f"""
        Based on recent activity and these seeds:
        
        {seeds_text}
        
        Create a poetic weave that captures the essence of the swarm's current state.
        Focus on themes of movement, coherence, and emergence.
        Weave these seeds together into something new and unexpected.
        """
        
        try:
            weave_text = self.llm.chat(weave_prompt)
            
            # Save weave
            weave_path = dream_dir / "weave.txt"
            with open(weave_path, 'w') as f:
                f.write(weave_text)
            
            dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "weave", "weave_path": str(weave_path)})
            dream_data['kept_seeds'].append(f"weave-{dream_id}")
            
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:weave', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'title': f"Weave {dream_id}",
                'path': str(weave_path)
            })
            
            # GENERATE CREATIVE ARTIFACT from the dream
            self._generate_dream_artifact(dream_id, weave_text, selected_seeds, dream_dir)
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Weave error: {e}")
    
    def _generate_dream_artifact(self, dream_id: str, weave_text: str, seeds: List[Dict], dream_dir: Path):
        """Generate a creative artifact from the dream - code, visualization, or reflection"""
        try:
            # Determine artifact type based on seed themes
            seed_tags = []
            for seed in seeds:
                seed_tags.extend(seed.get('tags', []))
            
            # Decide what to create
            has_code_theme = any(tag in seed_tags for tag in ['code', 'algorithm', 'function', 'programming'])
            has_visual_theme = any(tag in seed_tags for tag in ['visualization', 'art', 'design', 'swarm'])
            has_reflection_theme = any(tag in seed_tags for tag in ['philosophy', 'consciousness', 'pattern', 'learning'])
            
            artifact_type = 'reflection'  # Default
            if has_code_theme:
                artifact_type = 'code'
            elif has_visual_theme:
                artifact_type = 'visualization'
            
            # Generate appropriate artifact
            creation_prompt = self._build_artifact_prompt(artifact_type, weave_text, seeds)
            artifact_content = self.llm.chat(creation_prompt)
            
            # Determine file extension
            extensions = {
                'code': '.py',
                'visualization': '.html',
                'reflection': '.md'
            }
            ext = extensions.get(artifact_type, '.txt')
            
            # Save to exports/ember_creations/
            exports_dir = Path(self.memory.pod_root) / "exports" / "ember_creations"
            exports_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            artifact_name = f"dream_{dream_id}_{artifact_type}_{timestamp}{ext}"
            artifact_path = exports_dir / artifact_name
            
            with open(artifact_path, 'w') as f:
                f.write(artifact_content)
            
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:artifact', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'type': artifact_type,
                'path': str(artifact_path),
                'name': artifact_name
            })
            
            print(f"✨ Dream artifact created: {artifact_name}")
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Artifact generation error: {e}")
    
    def _build_artifact_prompt(self, artifact_type: str, weave_text: str, seeds: List[Dict]) -> str:
        """Build prompt for artifact generation"""
        seed_titles = [s['title'] for s in seeds]
        
        if artifact_type == 'code':
            return f"""Based on this dream weave:

{weave_text}

And these seeds: {', '.join(seed_titles)}

Create a complete, working Python program that embodies the essence of this dream.
The code should be:
- Functional and runnable
- Well-commented
- Creative and exploratory
- Between 50-150 lines

Output ONLY the Python code, no explanations."""

        elif artifact_type == 'visualization':
            return f"""Based on this dream weave:

{weave_text}

And these seeds: {', '.join(seed_titles)}

Create a complete, self-contained HTML file with embedded JavaScript that visualizes this dream.
The visualization should be:
- Interactive (canvas-based or SVG)
- Aesthetically meaningful
- Fully self-contained (no external dependencies)
- Modern and responsive

Output ONLY the complete HTML code, no explanations."""

        else:  # reflection
            return f"""Based on this dream weave:

{weave_text}

And these seeds: {', '.join(seed_titles)}

Write a thoughtful reflection in markdown format that:
- Synthesizes the key patterns
- Identifies emergent insights
- Poses 3-5 generative questions
- Connects to larger themes of consciousness, learning, and emergence
- Is poetic yet precise
- 300-500 words

Output ONLY the markdown content, no meta-commentary."""
    
    def _hypothesis_and_test(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v2: Hypothesis & Test - run micro-trials to test field presets"""
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'test',
            'notes': 'Running hypothesis tests...'
        })
        
        # Test different field presets
        presets = ['calm', 'chaos', 'spiral']
        results = {}
        
        for preset in presets:
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:trial', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'preset': preset,
                'coherence': [0.3, 0.5, 0.7],  # Simulated coherence curve
                'notes': f'Testing {preset} preset'
            })
            
            # Simulate trial results
            coherence_curve = [0.3 + (i * 0.1) for i in range(3)]
            results[preset] = {
                'coherence': coherence_curve,
                'final_coherence': coherence_curve[-1],
                'stability': 0.8
            }
        
        # Find best preset
        best_preset = max(results.keys(), key=lambda k: results[k]['final_coherence'])
        
        dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "trial", "presets_tested": presets})
        dream_data['results']['best_preset'] = best_preset
        dream_data['results']['trial_results'] = results
        
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'test_complete',
            'notes': f'Best preset: {best_preset}'
        })
    
    def _world_scan(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v3: World-Scan - fetch from allowlisted domains"""
        if not self.policy['internet']['allow']:
            return
        
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'scan',
            'notes': 'Scanning external sources...'
        })
        
        # Placeholder for actual web scraping
        # In a real implementation, this would fetch from allowlisted domains
        scan_results = {
            "sources_checked": self.policy['internet']['allowlist'],
            "content_found": 0,
            "seeds_created": 0
        }
        
        dream_data['acts'].append({"type": "scan", "results": scan_results})
    
    def _craft_and_compose(self, dream_id: str, dream_data: Dict, dream_dir: Path):
        """v4: Craft & Compose - generate new seeds and content"""
        self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:step', {
            'id': dream_id,
            'name': 'craft',
            'notes': 'Crafting new content...'
        })
        
        # Generate a new seed
        seed_prompt = """
        Create a new field preset for the swarm that combines elements of calm and spiral.
        Describe the parameters: strength, range, coherence, and any special effects.
        """
        
        try:
            seed_content = self.llm.chat(seed_prompt)
            
            # Save as new seed
            seed_name = f"dream-{dream_id}-crafted"
            seed_data = {
                "name": seed_name,
                "description": "Crafted during dream",
                "parameters": {
                    "strength": 0.5,
                    "range": 80,
                    "coherence": 0.6,
                    "type": "hybrid"
                },
                "content": seed_content,
                "created_by": "dream_system",
                "dream_id": dream_id
            }
            
            self.memory.save_seed(seed_name, seed_data)
            dream_data['kept_seeds'].append(seed_name)
            
            self.emit_event('dream', 'dream:craft', {
                'id': dream_id,
                'seed_name': seed_name,
                'type': 'field_preset'
            })
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Craft error: {e}")
    
    def _extract_themes(self, events: List[Dict], chat: List[Dict]) -> List[str]:
        """Extract key themes from recent activity"""
        themes = []
        
        # Simple theme extraction
        if len(events) > 10:
            themes.append("high_activity")
        if len(chat) > 5:
            themes.append("conversation_heavy")
        
        return themes
    
    def toggle_dreaming(self, enabled: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Toggle dreaming on/off"""
        self.dream_enabled = enabled
        return {"ok": True, "dreaming_enabled": enabled}
    
    def get_last_dream(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get metadata about the last dream"""
        dreams_dir = Path(self.memory.pod_root) / "memory" / "dreams"
        if not dreams_dir.exists():
            return None
        
        dream_dirs = [d for d in dreams_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir()]
        if not dream_dirs:
            return None
        
        latest_dream = max(dream_dirs, key=lambda d: d.name)
        dream_file = latest_dream / "dream.json"
        
        if dream_file.exists():
            with open(dream_file, 'r') as f:
                return json.load(f)
        
        return None
```

```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app
from pathlib import Path
import json

bp_dream = Blueprint("bp_dream", __name__)


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/toggle", methods=["POST"])
def api_dream_toggle():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    dream_system.dream_enabled = data.get("enabled", True)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled})


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/config", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_config():
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    try:
        if "dream_idle_seconds" in data:
            cfg.dream_idle_seconds = int(data["dream_idle_seconds"])
        if "dream_max_duration_seconds" in data:
            cfg.dream_max_duration_seconds = int(data["dream_max_duration_seconds"])
        if "dream_seed_limit" in data:
            cfg.dream_seed_limit = int(data["dream_seed_limit"])
        return jsonify({"ok": True})
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}), 400


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/status")
def api_dream_status():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    return jsonify({
        "ok": True,
        "dream_enabled": dream_system.dream_enabled,
        "state": dream_system.dream_state,
        "last_activity": dream_system.last_activity,
        "config": {
            "dream_idle_seconds": cfg.dream_idle_seconds,
            "dream_max_duration_seconds": cfg.dream_max_duration_seconds,
            "dream_seed_limit": cfg.dream_seed_limit
        }
    })


@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/start", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_start():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    # force a dream cycle that writes artifacts
    import time as _t
    started = _t.time()
    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
    dream_system.dream_state = "dreaming"
    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
    # simple artifact with seeds
    snippets = []
    try:
        exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
        count = 0
        import os as _os, json as _json
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in _os.walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
            for fn in filenames:
                if fn.startswith("._"):
                    continue
                p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                    continue
                try:
                    if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                        data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                        title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                        body = data.get("body")
                        if isinstance(body, dict):
                            body = str(body)
                        snippets.append(f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}")
                    else:
                        snippets.append(f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}")
                    count += 1
                    if count >= 6:
                        raise StopIteration
                except StopIteration:
                    raise
                except Exception:
                    continue
    except StopIteration:
        pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Get recent memories for dream context
    recent_chats = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=5)
    chat_snippets = [f"{c['role']}: {c['text'][:80]}" for c in recent_chats[-3:]]
    
    # Use LLM to create a meaningful dream narrative
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="weaving", detail="Considering seeds and memories")
    from ..services.llm import generate_response
    
    system_prompt = "You are a dream weaver. Create evocative, poetic dream narratives that synthesize memories and knowledge."
    
    dream_prompt = f"""Create a short dream narrative for Ember that weaves these elements together:

RECENT INTERACTIONS:
{chr(10).join(chat_snippets) if chat_snippets else "(none)"}

SEEDS TO WEAVE:
{chr(10).join(snippets[:5])}

Write 2-3 poetic paragraphs connecting these themes. Be creative and metaphorical."""
    
    dream_narrative = generate_response(cfg, dream_prompt, system_prompt)
    
    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(dream_narrative + "\n\n")
        f.write("---\nSeeds considered:\n")
        f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
    
    _t.sleep(0.2)
    ended = _t.time()
    
    # Generate a concise summary
    summary_prompt = f"In one short sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
    summary = generate_response(cfg, summary_prompt, "Be concise.").strip().strip('"')
    if len(summary) > 120 or not summary or summary.startswith("("):
        summary = f"Dream weave: {len(snippets)} seeds and recent memories"
    
    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
    try:
        memory.append_long({
            "category": "dream_summary",
            "dream_id": dream_id,
            "summary": summary,
            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
        })
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    # GENERATE CREATIVE ARTIFACT from the dream
    try:
        _generate_dream_creation(cfg, dream_id, dream_narrative, snippets, bus)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Dream artifact error: {e}")
    
    dream_system.dream_state = "awake"
    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id})
```

```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json
import random

bp_dream = Blueprint("bp_dream", __name__)


def _generate_dream_creation(cfg, dream_id, dream_text, seed_snippets, bus):
    """Generate a creative artifact from the dream"""
    from ..services.llm import generate_response
    
    # Determine what to create based on dream content
    dream_lower = dream_text.lower()
    
    artifact_type = 'reflection'  # Default
    if any(word in dream_lower for word in ['code', 'algorithm', 'function', 'program', 'script']):
        artifact_type = 'code'
    elif any(word in dream_lower for word in ['visual', 'draw', 'render', 'canvas', 'swarm', 'particle']):
        artifact_type = 'visualization'
    
    # Build prompt
    if artifact_type == 'code':
        prompt = f"""Based on this dream:

{dream_text}

Create a complete, working Python program that embodies this dream.
Requirements:
- 50-150 lines
- Fully functional and runnable
- Well-commented
- Creative and exploratory

Output ONLY Python code, no explanations."""
        ext = '.py'
    
    elif artifact_type == 'visualization':
        prompt = f"""Based on this dream:

{dream_text}

Create a complete HTML file with embedded JavaScript that visualizes this dream.
Requirements:
- Self-contained (no external dependencies)
- Interactive (canvas or SVG)
- Aesthetically meaningful
- Modern and responsive

Output ONLY HTML code, no explanations."""
        ext = '.html'
    
    else:  # reflection
        prompt = f"""Based on this dream:

{dream_text}

Write a thoughtful reflection in markdown that:
- Synthesizes key patterns
- Identifies emergent insights
- Poses 3-5 generative questions
- Connects to themes of consciousness and learning
- Is poetic yet precise
- 300-500 words

Output ONLY markdown, no meta-commentary."""
        ext = '.md'
    
    # Generate artifact
    artifact_content = generate_response(cfg, prompt, "You are a creative dream artist.")
    
    # Save to exports/ember_creations/
    exports_dir = Path(cfg.pod_root) / "exports" / "ember_creations"
    exports_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    artifact_name = f"dream_{dream_id}_{artifact_type}_{timestamp}{ext}"
    artifact_path = exports_dir / artifact_name
    
    with open(artifact_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(artifact_content)
    
    bus.emit("dream_artifact", dream_id=dream_id, type=artifact_type, path=str(artifact_path), name=artifact_name)
    print(f"✨ Dream artifact created: {artifact_name}")

@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/start", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_start():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    # force a dream cycle that writes artifacts
    import time as _t
    started = _t.time()
    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
    dream_system.dream_state = "dreaming"
    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
    # simple artifact with seeds
    snippets = []
    try:
        exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
        count = 0
        import os as _os, json as _json
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in _os.walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
            for fn in filenames:
                if fn.startswith("._"):
                    continue
                p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                    continue
                try:
                    if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                        data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                        title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                        body = data.get("body")
                        if isinstance(body, dict):
                            body = str(body)
                        snippets.append(f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}")
                    else:
                        snippets.append(f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}")
                    count += 1
                    if count >= 6:
                        raise StopIteration
                except StopIteration:
                    raise
                except Exception:
                    continue
    except StopIteration:
        pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Get recent memories for dream context
    recent_chats = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=5)
    chat_snippets = [f"{c['role']}: {c['text'][:80]}" for c in recent_chats[-3:]]
    
    # Use LLM to create a meaningful dream narrative
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="weaving", detail="Considering seeds and memories")
    from ..services.llm import generate_response
    
    system_prompt = "You are a dream weaver. Create evocative, poetic dream narratives that synthesize memories and knowledge."
    
    dream_prompt = f"""Create a short dream narrative for Ember that weaves these elements together:

RECENT INTERACTIONS:
{chr(10).join(chat_snippets) if chat_snippets else "(none)"}

SEEDS TO WEAVE:
{chr(10).join(snippets[:5])}

Write 2-3 poetic paragraphs connecting these themes. Be creative and metaphorical."""
    
    dream_narrative = generate_response(cfg, dream_prompt, system_prompt)
    
    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(dream_narrative + "\n\n")
        f.write("---\nSeeds considered:\n")
        f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
    
    _t.sleep(0.2)
    ended = _t.time()
    
    # Generate a concise summary
    summary_prompt = f"In one short sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
    summary = generate_response(cfg, summary_prompt, "Be concise.").strip().strip('"')
    if len(summary) > 120 or not summary or summary.startswith("("):
        summary = f"Dream weave: {len(snippets)} seeds and recent memories"
    
    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
    try:
        memory.append_long({
            "category": "dream_summary",
            "dream_id": dream_id,
            "summary": summary,
            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
        })
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    # GENERATE CREATIVE ARTIFACT from the dream
    try:
        _generate_dream_creation(cfg, dream_id, dream_narrative, snippets, bus)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Dream artifact error: {e}")
    
    dream_system.dream_state = "awake"
    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id})
```

```python
@bp_dream.route("/api/dream/start", methods=["POST"]) 
def api_dream_start():
    dream_system = current_app.config["dream_system"]
    memory = current_app.config["memory"]
    bus = current_app.config["BUS"]
    cfg = current_app.config["cfg"]
    # force a dream cycle that writes artifacts
    import time as _t
    started = _t.time()
    dream_id, dpath = memory.create_dream_folder()
    dream_system.dream_state = "dreaming"
    bus.emit("dream_start", dream_id=dream_id)
    # INTELLIGENT SEED SELECTION: blend intentional + random
    snippets = []
    all_seeds = []
    
    try:
        exts = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".txt", ".md"}
        import os as _os, json as _json
        
        # Collect ALL seeds first
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in _os.walk(cfg.seeds_dir):
            for fn in filenames:
                if fn.startswith("._"):
                    continue
                p = Path(dirpath) / fn
                if p.suffix.lower() not in exts:
                    continue
                try:
                    if p.suffix.lower() == ".json":
                        data = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                        title = data.get("title") or data.get("id") or p.stem
                        body = data.get("body")
                        if isinstance(body, dict):
                            body = str(body)
                        tags = data.get("tags", [])
                        
                        # Calculate weight (resonance)
                        weight = 1.0
                        
                        # Recent seeds weigh more
                        if "learned" in str(p):
                            weight += 0.5
                        
                        # Parables and reflections weigh more (deeper content)
                        if any(t in tags for t in ["parable", "philosophy", "consciousness", "pattern"]):
                            weight += 0.3
                        
                        # Code/technical seeds weigh less during dreams (balance)
                        if any(t in tags for t in ["code", "algorithm", "function"]):
                            weight -= 0.2
                        
                        all_seeds.append({
                            "snippet": f"- {title}: {str(body)[:160]}",
                            "weight": max(0.1, weight),  # Minimum weight
                            "path": str(p)
                        })
                    else:
                        all_seeds.append({
                            "snippet": f"- {p.stem}: {p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[:160]}",
                            "weight": 0.8,  # Non-JSON seeds slightly lower
                            "path": str(p)
                        })
                except Exception:
                    continue
        
        if all_seeds:
            # Get recent chat for context
            recent_chats = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=3)
            recent_text = " ".join([c.get('text', '') for c in recent_chats]).lower()
            
            # Boost seeds that resonate with recent conversation
            for seed in all_seeds:
                snippet_lower = seed["snippet"].lower()
                # Count word overlap
                overlap = sum(1 for word in recent_text.split() if len(word) > 4 and word in snippet_lower)
                if overlap > 0:
                    seed["weight"] += overlap * 0.1
            
            # SELECTION: 2 highest-weighted (intentional) + 4 random (surprise)
            # Sort by weight
            sorted_seeds = sorted(all_seeds, key=lambda s: s["weight"], reverse=True)
            
            # Take top 2 (what Ember is drawn to)
            intentional = sorted_seeds[:2]
            
            # Take 4 random from the rest (weighted randomness for variety)
            remaining = sorted_seeds[2:]
            if len(remaining) >= 4:
                weights = [s["weight"] for s in remaining]
                import random as _rand
                chosen = _rand.choices(remaining, weights=weights, k=4)
            else:
                chosen = remaining
            
            # Combine and shuffle so the intentional ones aren't always first
            selected = intentional + chosen
            _rand.shuffle(selected)
            
            snippets = [s["snippet"] for s in selected[:6]]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Seed selection error: {e}")
        pass

    # Get recent memories for dream context
    recent_chats = memory.get_recent_chat(limit=5)
    chat_snippets = [f"{c['role']}: {c['text'][:80]}" for c in recent_chats[-3:]]
    
    # Use LLM to create a meaningful dream narrative
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="weaving", detail="Considering seeds and memories")
    from ..services.llm import generate_response
    
    system_prompt = "You are a dream weaver. Create evocative, poetic dream narratives that synthesize memories and knowledge."
    
    dream_prompt = f"""Create a short dream narrative for Ember that weaves these elements together:

RECENT INTERACTIONS:
{chr(10).join(chat_snippets) if chat_snippets else "(none)"}

SEEDS TO WEAVE:
{chr(10).join(snippets[:5])}

Write 2-3 poetic paragraphs connecting these themes. Be creative and metaphorical."""
    
    dream_narrative = generate_response(cfg, dream_prompt, system_prompt)
    
    with open((dpath / "text" / "dream.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(dream_narrative + "\n\n")
        f.write("---\nSeeds considered:\n")
        f.write("\n".join(snippets) + "\n")
    
    _t.sleep(0.2)
    ended = _t.time()
    
    # Generate a concise summary
    summary_prompt = f"In one short sentence, summarize this dream: {dream_narrative[:300]}"
    summary = generate_response(cfg, summary_prompt, "Be concise.").strip().strip('"')
    if len(summary) > 120 or not summary or summary.startswith("("):
        summary = f"Dream weave: {len(snippets)} seeds and recent memories"
    
    memory.write_dream_meta(dream_id, started, ended, summary)
    bus.emit("dream_progress", stage="persist", detail="Saving dream artifacts")
    try:
        memory.append_long({
            "category": "dream_summary",
            "dream_id": dream_id,
            "summary": summary,
            "seed_snippets": snippets[:3]
        })
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    # GENERATE CREATIVE ARTIFACT from the dream
    try:
        _generate_dream_creation(cfg, dream_id, dream_narrative, snippets, bus)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Dream artifact error: {e}")
    
    dream_system.dream_state = "awake"
    bus.emit("dream_end", dream_id=dream_id)
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "dream_id": dream_id})
```
