```html
        <div>
          <button onclick="resetView()">Reset</button>
          <button onclick="toggleAutoRotate()" id="rotateBtn">Auto-Rotate</button>
        </div>
        
        <div style="margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #333;">
          <strong>Speed</strong>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top: 8px;">
          <button onclick="setSpeed(0.25)">0.25x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(0.5)">0.5x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(1.0)">1x</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(2.0)">2x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(5.0)">5x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(10.0)">10x</button>
        </div>
        
        <div class="info">
          Zoom: <span id="zoomLevel">1.0</span>x<br>
          Speed: <span id="speedLevel">1.0</span>x<br>
          Drag to rotate • Scroll to zoom
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // =============================================
    // CHAT FUNCTIONALITY
    // =============================================
    
    const chatContainer = document.getElementById('chatContainer');
    const messageInput = document.getElementById('messageInput');
    const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
    
    let currentMessage = null;
    
    function addMessage(role, text) {
      const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
      msgDiv.className = `message ${role}`;
      
      const label = document.createElement('div');
      label.className = 'message-label';
      label.textContent = role === 'user' ? 'You' : 'Ember';
      
      const content = document.createElement('div');
      content.textContent = text;
      
      msgDiv.appendChild(label);
      msgDiv.appendChild(content);
      chatContainer.appendChild(msgDiv);
      chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
      
      return content;
    }
    
    async function sendMessage() {
      const text = messageInput.value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      
      addMessage('user', text);
      messageInput.value = '';
      sendButton.disabled = true;
      
      triggerActivityPulse('user');
      
      currentMessage = addMessage('assistant', '');
      
      try {
        const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/chat/stream', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ message: text })
        });
        
        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder();
        let buffer = '';
        
        while (true) {
          const {value, done} = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;
          
          buffer += decoder.decode(value, {stream: true});
          const lines = buffer.split('\n');
          buffer = lines.pop();
          
          for (const line of lines) {
            if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
              const data = line.slice(6);
              if (data === '[DONE]') continue;
              
              try {
                const json = JSON.parse(data);
                if (json.token) {
                  currentMessage.textContent += json.token;
                  chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
                  triggerActivityPulse('assistant');
                }
              } catch (e) {}
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        currentMessage.textContent = `Error: ${error.message}`;
      }
      
      sendButton.disabled = false;
      messageInput.focus();
    }
    
    sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
    messageInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage();
    });
    
    addMessage('assistant', 'Hello. I am one. Watch me breathe.');
    
    // =============================================
    // SSE EVENT LISTENER (Ember can control swarm)
    // =============================================
    
    const eventSource = new EventSource('http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/events/stream');
    
    eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_speed', (e) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
      setSpeed(data.speed || 1.0);
      console.log('Ember set speed:', data.speed);
    });
    
    eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_morph', (e) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
      console.log('Ember morphed swarm:', data.shape);
      // Morphing handled by existing animation logic
    });
    
    eventSource.onerror = (err) => {
      console.warn('SSE connection error (will retry):', err);
    };
    
    // =============================================
    // UNIFIED FORM VISUALIZATION
    // =============================================
    
    const canvas = document.getElementById('swarmCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
    canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
      canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    });
    
    const COUNT = 3000;
    const particles = [];
    let attractors = [];
    let frameCount = 0;
    let activityPulse = 0;
    let morphPhase = 0;
    let timeSpeed = 1.0;  // Animation speed multiplier (controllable)
    
    const colors = [
      'rgb(100, 149, 237)',
      'rgb(138, 43, 226)',
      'rgb(255, 99, 71)',
      'rgb(255, 215, 0)',
      'rgb(50, 205, 50)',
      'rgb(255, 105, 180)',
      'rgb(0, 191, 255)',
      'rgb(255, 140, 0)',
    ];
    
    // Generate fractal attractors (Sierpinski-inspired)
    function generateFractalAttractors(depth, scale, cx, cy, cz) {
      if (depth === 0) {
        return [{x: cx, y: cy, z: cz, strength: scale}];
      }
      
      const result = [];
      const angles = [0, Math.PI * 2/3, Math.PI * 4/3];
      const r = scale * 100;
      
      for (let angle of angles) {
        const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
        const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
        const z = cz + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI/3) * r * 0.5;
        
        result.push(...generateFractalAttractors(depth - 1, scale * 0.6, x, y, z));
      }
      
      result.push({x: cx, y: cy, z: cz, strength: scale * 2});
      return result;
    }
    
    // Initialize particles
    for (let i = 0; i < COUNT; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        z: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        vz: 0,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
        connections: []
      });
    }
    
    // Camera
    let camera = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      zoom: 0.8,
      targetZoom: 0.8,
      rotX: 0,
      rotY: 0,
      targetRotX: 0,
      targetRotY: 0
    };
    
    let isDragging = false;
    let lastMouseX = 0;
    let lastMouseY = 0;
    let autoRotate = false;
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      lastMouseX = e.clientX;
      lastMouseY = e.clientY;
    });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (isDragging) {
        const dx = e.clientX - lastMouseX;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastMouseY;
        camera.targetRotY += dx * 0.005;
        camera.targetRotX += dy * 0.005;
        camera.targetRotX = Math.max(-Math.PI/2, Math.min(Math.PI/2, camera.targetRotX));
        lastMouseX = e.clientX;
        lastMouseY = e.clientY;
      }
    });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDragging = false; });
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDragging = false; });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      camera.targetZoom *= e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.targetZoom = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, camera.targetZoom));
    });
    
    function zoomIn() { camera.targetZoom = Math.min(10, camera.targetZoom + 0.2); }
    function zoomOut() { camera.targetZoom = Math.max(0.1, camera.targetZoom - 0.2); }
    function resetView() { 
      camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0; 
      camera.targetZoom = 0.8; 
      camera.targetRotX = 0; 
      camera.targetRotY = 0; 
    }
    function toggleAutoRotate() {
      autoRotate = !autoRotate;
      document.getElementById('rotateBtn').textContent = autoRotate ? 'Stop Rotate' : 'Auto-Rotate';
    }
    
    function setSpeed(speed) {
      timeSpeed = speed;
      document.getElementById('speedLevel').textContent = speed.toFixed(2);
    }
    
    function triggerActivityPulse(source) {
      activityPulse = 1.0;
    }
    
    function project3D(x, y, z) {
      const cosX = Math.cos(camera.rotX);
      const sinX = Math.sin(camera.rotX);
      const cosY = Math.cos(camera.rotY);
      const sinY = Math.sin(camera.rotY);
      
      let x1 = x * cosY - z * sinY;
      let z1 = x * sinY + z * cosY;
      let y1 = y * cosX - z1 * sinX;
      let z2 = y * sinX + z1 * cosX;
      
      const scale = 1000 / (1000 + z2);
      return {
        x: x1 * scale * camera.zoom + canvas.width / 2 + camera.x,
        y: y1 * scale * camera.zoom + canvas.height / 2 + camera.y,
        z: z2,
        scale: scale * camera.zoom
      };
    }
    
    let lastTime = performance.now();
    let fps = 0;
    
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      
      const now = performance.now();
      const delta = now - lastTime;
      fps = Math.round(1000 / delta);
      lastTime = now;
      
      document.getElementById('fps').textContent = `FPS: ${fps}`;
      document.getElementById('zoomLevel').textContent = camera.zoom.toFixed(1);
      document.getElementById('speedLevel').textContent = timeSpeed.toFixed(2);
      
      frameCount++;
      const time = frameCount * 0.01 * timeSpeed;  // Apply speed multiplier
      morphPhase = time * 0.3;
      
      // Update camera
      camera.zoom += (camera.targetZoom - camera.zoom) * 0.1;
      camera.rotX += (camera.targetRotX - camera.rotX) * 0.1;
      camera.rotY += (camera.targetRotY - camera.rotY) * 0.1;
      
      if (autoRotate) {
        camera.targetRotY += 0.005;
      }
      
      // Decay activity
      if (activityPulse > 0) {
        activityPulse *= 0.95;
      }
      
      // Regenerate morphing fractal attractors (speed affects regeneration rate)
      const regenFreq = Math.max(5, Math.floor(30 / timeSpeed));
      if (frameCount % regenFreq === 0) {
        const breathe = Math.sin(morphPhase) * 0.3 + 1.0;
        const twist = Math.cos(morphPhase * 0.7) * Math.PI * 0.2;
        attractors = generateFractalAttractors(3, breathe, 
          Math.cos(twist) * 50, 
          Math.sin(morphPhase * 0.5) * 50, 
          Math.sin(twist) * 50
        );
      }
      
      // Physics (speed affects update frequency for performance)
      const physicsFreq = Math.max(1, Math.floor(2 / timeSpeed));
      if (frameCount % physicsFreq === 0) {
        particles.forEach(p => {
          p.connections = [];
          
          // Attract to nearest fractal attractor
          let minDist = Infinity;
          let nearestAttractor = null;
          
          attractors.forEach(att => {
            const dx = att.x - p.x;
            const dy = att.y - p.y;
            const dz = att.z - p.z;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
            
            if (dist < minDist) {
              minDist = dist;
              nearestAttractor = att;
            }
          });
          
          if (nearestAttractor && minDist > 10) {
            const dx = nearestAttractor.x - p.x;
            const dy = nearestAttractor.y - p.y;
            const dz = nearestAttractor.z - p.z;
            const force = (0.015 + activityPulse * 0.01) * nearestAttractor.strength * timeSpeed;
            
            p.vx += (dx / minDist) * force;
            p.vy += (dy / minDist) * force;
            p.vz += (dz / minDist) * force;
          }
          
          // Local clustering
          particles.forEach(other => {
            if (other === p) return;
            
            const dx = other.x - p.x;
            const dy = other.y - p.y;
            const dz = other.z - p.z;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
            
            if (dist < 60 && dist > 0) {
              const force = 0.002 * (60 - dist) / 60 * timeSpeed;
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
              p.vz += (dz / dist) * force;
              
              if (dist < 40) {
                p.connections.push({ other, dist });
              }
            }
          });
          
          // Damping
          p.vx *= 0.96;
          p.vy *= 0.96;
          p.vz *= 0.96;
          
          // Apply velocity with speed multiplier
          p.x += p.vx * timeSpeed;
          p.y += p.vy * timeSpeed;
          p.z += p.vz * timeSpeed;
        });
      }
      
      // Clear
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      
      // Project and sort
      const projected = particles.map((p) => ({
        ...project3D(p.x, p.y, p.z),
        p: p
      }));
      
      projected.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);
      
      // Draw connections (only at close zoom)
      if (camera.zoom > 1.5) {
        projected.forEach(({x, y, z, scale, p}) => {
          if (z > -500) {
            const depthAlpha = Math.min(1, (500 + z) / 1000);
            p.connections.slice(0, 3).forEach(({other, dist}) => {
              const proj = project3D(other.x, other.y, other.z);
              if (proj.z > -500) {
                const alpha = (1 - dist / 40) * 0.2 * depthAlpha;
                ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
                ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                ctx.lineTo(proj.x, proj.y);
                ctx.stroke();
              }
            });
          }
        });
      }
      
      // Draw particles
      projected.forEach(({x, y, z, scale, p}) => {
        const adjustedSize = p.size * scale;
        const depthAlpha = Math.min(1, (500 + z) / 1000);
        
        // Neuronal firing
        const firePhase = (time * 5 + p.phase * 10) % (Math.PI * 2);
        const isFiring = Math.sin(firePhase) > (0.7 - activityPulse * 0.3);
        const fireIntensity = isFiring ? (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5 + activityPulse * 0.3) : 0.1;
        
        // Subtle glow (more visible at close zoom)
        const glowStrength = camera.zoom > 1.5 ? 1.0 : 0.3;
        if (isFiring && depthAlpha > 0.3 && camera.zoom > 0.5) {
          const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, adjustedSize * 2);
          gradient.addColorStop(0, p.color.replace(')', `, ${fireIntensity * depthAlpha * 0.5 * glowStrength})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
          ctx.fillRect(x - adjustedSize * 2, y - adjustedSize * 2, adjustedSize * 4, adjustedSize * 4);
        }
        
        // Core
        const jitterX = isFiring ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 : 0;
        const jitterY = isFiring ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 : 0;
        const coreAlpha = isFiring ? depthAlpha : depthAlpha * 0.7;
        
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color.replace(')', `, ${coreAlpha})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba');
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x + jitterX, y + jitterY, adjustedSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      });
    }
    
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    });
    
    addMessage('assistant', 'Hello. I am one. Watch me breathe.');
    
    // =============================================
    // SSE EVENT LISTENER (Ember can control swarm)
    // =============================================
    
    const eventSource = new EventSource('http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/events/stream');
    
    eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_speed', (e) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
      setSpeed(data.speed || 1.0);
      console.log('Ember set speed:', data.speed);
    });
    
    eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_morph', (e) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
      console.log('Ember morphed swarm:', data.shape);
      // Morphing handled by existing animation logic
    });
    
    eventSource.onerror = (err) => {
      console.warn('SSE connection error (will retry):', err);
    };
    
    // =============================================
    // UNIFIED FORM VISUALIZATION
    // =============================================
    
    const canvas = document.getElementById('swarmCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
    canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
      canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    });
    
    const COUNT = 3000;
    const particles = [];
    let attractors = [];
    let frameCount = 0;
    let activityPulse = 0;
    let morphPhase = 0;
    let timeSpeed = 1.0;  // Animation speed multiplier (controllable)
    
    const colors = [
      'rgb(100, 149, 237)',
      'rgb(138, 43, 226)',
      'rgb(255, 99, 71)',
      'rgb(255, 215, 0)',
      'rgb(50, 205, 50)',
      'rgb(255, 105, 180)',
      'rgb(0, 191, 255)',
      'rgb(255, 140, 0)',
    ];
    
    // Generate fractal attractors (Sierpinski-inspired)
    function generateFractalAttractors(depth, scale, cx, cy, cz) {
      if (depth === 0) {
        return [{x: cx, y: cy, z: cz, strength: scale}];
      }
      
      const result = [];
      const angles = [0, Math.PI * 2/3, Math.PI * 4/3];
      const r = scale * 100;
      
      for (let angle of angles) {
        const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
        const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
        const z = cz + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI/3) * r * 0.5;
        
        result.push(...generateFractalAttractors(depth - 1, scale * 0.6, x, y, z));
      }
      
      result.push({x: cx, y: cy, z: cz, strength: scale * 2});
      return result;
    }
    
    // Initialize particles
    for (let i = 0; i < COUNT; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        z: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        vz: 0,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
        connections: []
      });
    }
    
    // Camera
    let camera = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      zoom: 0.8,
      targetZoom: 0.8,
      rotX: 0,
      rotY: 0,
      targetRotX: 0,
      targetRotY: 0
    };
    
    let isDragging = false;
    let lastMouseX = 0;
    let lastMouseY = 0;
    let autoRotate = false;
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      lastMouseX = e.clientX;
      lastMouseY = e.clientY;
    });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (isDragging) {
        const dx = e.clientX - lastMouseX;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastMouseY;
        camera.targetRotY += dx * 0.005;
        camera.targetRotX += dy * 0.005;
        camera.targetRotX = Math.max(-Math.PI/2, Math.min(Math.PI/2, camera.targetRotX));
        lastMouseX = e.clientX;
        lastMouseY = e.clientY;
      }
    });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDragging = false; });
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDragging = false; });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      camera.targetZoom *= e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.targetZoom = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, camera.targetZoom));
    });
    
    function zoomIn() { camera.targetZoom = Math.min(10, camera.targetZoom + 0.2); }
    function zoomOut() { camera.targetZoom = Math.max(0.1, camera.targetZoom - 0.2); }
    function resetView() { 
      camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0; 
      camera.targetZoom = 0.8; 
      camera.targetRotX = 0; 
      camera.targetRotY = 0; 
    }
    function toggleAutoRotate() {
      autoRotate = !autoRotate;
      document.getElementById('rotateBtn').textContent = autoRotate ? 'Stop Rotate' : 'Auto-Rotate';
    }
    
    function setSpeed(speed) {
      timeSpeed = speed;
      document.getElementById('speedLevel').textContent = speed.toFixed(2);
    }
    
    function triggerActivityPulse(source) {
      activityPulse = 1.0;
    }
    
    function project3D(x, y, z) {
      const cosX = Math.cos(camera.rotX);
      const sinX = Math.sin(camera.rotX);
      const cosY = Math.cos(camera.rotY);
      const sinY = Math.sin(camera.rotY);
      
      let x1 = x * cosY - z * sinY;
      let z1 = x * sinY + z * cosY;
      let y1 = y * cosX - z1 * sinX;
      let z2 = y * sinX + z1 * cosX;
      
      const scale = 1000 / (1000 + z2);
      return {
        x: x1 * scale * camera.zoom + canvas.width / 2 + camera.x,
        y: y1 * scale * camera.zoom + canvas.height / 2 + camera.y,
        z: z2,
        scale: scale * camera.zoom
      };
    }
    
    let lastTime = performance.now();
    let fps = 0;
    
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      
      const now = performance.now();
      const delta = now - lastTime;
      fps = Math.round(1000 / delta);
      lastTime = now;
      
      document.getElementById('fps').textContent = `FPS: ${fps}`;
      document.getElementById('zoomLevel').textContent = camera.zoom.toFixed(1);
      document.getElementById('speedLevel').textContent = timeSpeed.toFixed(2);
      
      frameCount++;
      const time = frameCount * 0.01 * timeSpeed;  // Apply speed multiplier
      morphPhase = time * 0.3;
      
      // Update camera
      camera.zoom += (camera.targetZoom - camera.zoom) * 0.1;
      camera.rotX += (camera.targetRotX - camera.rotX) * 0.1;
      camera.rotY += (camera.targetRotY - camera.rotY) * 0.1;
      
      if (autoRotate) {
        camera.targetRotY += 0.005;
      }
      
      // Decay activity
      if (activityPulse > 0) {
        activityPulse *= 0.95;
      }
      
      // Regenerate morphing fractal attractors (speed affects regeneration rate)
      const regenFreq = Math.max(5, Math.floor(30 / timeSpeed));
      if (frameCount % regenFreq === 0) {
        const breathe = Math.sin(morphPhase) * 0.3 + 1.0;
        const twist = Math.cos(morphPhase * 0.7) * Math.PI * 0.2;
        attractors = generateFractalAttractors(3, breathe, 
          Math.cos(twist) * 50, 
          Math.sin(morphPhase * 0.5) * 50, 
          Math.sin(twist) * 50
        );
      }
      
      // Physics (speed affects update frequency for performance)
      const physicsFreq = Math.max(1, Math.floor(2 / timeSpeed));
      if (frameCount % physicsFreq === 0) {
        particles.forEach(p => {
          p.connections = [];
          
          // Attract to nearest fractal attractor
          let minDist = Infinity;
          let nearestAttractor = null;
          
          attractors.forEach(att => {
            const dx = att.x - p.x;
            const dy = att.y - p.y;
            const dz = att.z - p.z;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
            
            if (dist < minDist) {
              minDist = dist;
              nearestAttractor = att;
            }
          });
          
          if (nearestAttractor && minDist > 10) {
            const dx = nearestAttractor.x - p.x;
            const dy = nearestAttractor.y - p.y;
            const dz = nearestAttractor.z - p.z;
            const force = (0.015 + activityPulse * 0.01) * nearestAttractor.strength * timeSpeed;
            
            p.vx += (dx / minDist) * force;
            p.vy += (dy / minDist) * force;
            p.vz += (dz / minDist) * force;
          }
          
          // Local clustering
          particles.forEach(other => {
            if (other === p) return;
            
            const dx = other.x - p.x;
            const dy = other.y - p.y;
            const dz = other.z - p.z;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
            
            if (dist < 60 && dist > 0) {
              const force = 0.002 * (60 - dist) / 60 * timeSpeed;
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
              p.vz += (dz / dist) * force;
              
              if (dist < 40) {
                p.connections.push({ other, dist });
              }
            }
          });
          
          // Damping
          p.vx *= 0.96;
          p.vy *= 0.96;
          p.vz *= 0.96;
          
          // Apply velocity with speed multiplier
          p.x += p.vx * timeSpeed;
          p.y += p.vy * timeSpeed;
          p.z += p.vz * timeSpeed;
        });
      }
      
      // Clear
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      
      // Project and sort
      const projected = particles.map((p) => ({
        ...project3D(p.x, p.y, p.z),
        p: p
      }));
      
      projected.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);
      
      // Draw connections (only at close zoom)
      if (camera.zoom > 1.5) {
        projected.forEach(({x, y, z, scale, p}) => {
          if (z > -500) {
            const depthAlpha = Math.min(1, (500 + z) / 1000);
            p.connections.slice(0, 3).forEach(({other, dist}) => {
              const proj = project3D(other.x, other.y, other.z);
              if (proj.z > -500) {
                const alpha = (1 - dist / 40) * 0.2 * depthAlpha;
                ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
                ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                ctx.lineTo(proj.x, proj.y);
                ctx.stroke();
              }
            });
          }
        });
      }
      
      // Draw particles with INFINITE COMPLEXITY
      projected.forEach(({x, y, z, scale, p}) => {
        const adjustedSize = p.size * scale;
        const depthAlpha = Math.min(1, (500 + z) / 1000);
        
        // Multi-layered neuronal firing with different frequencies
        const firePhase1 = (time * 5 + p.phase * 10) % (Math.PI * 2);
        const firePhase2 = (time * 3 + p.phase * 7) % (Math.PI * 2);
        const firePhase3 = (time * 8 + p.phase * 13) % (Math.PI * 2);
        
        const isFiring = Math.sin(firePhase1) > (0.7 - activityPulse * 0.3);
        const isSubFiring = Math.sin(firePhase2) > 0.8;
        const isMicroFiring = Math.sin(firePhase3) > 0.85;
        
        const fireIntensity = isFiring ? (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5 + activityPulse * 0.3) : 
                             isSubFiring ? 0.3 : 
                             isMicroFiring ? 0.15 : 0.05;
        
        // Multi-layer glow (always visible, creates depth)
        const baseGlow = 0.2 + Math.sin(time * 2 + p.phase) * 0.1;
        const glowStrength = Math.max(baseGlow, fireIntensity);
        
        // Outer glow layer (always present for "infinite complexity")
        if (depthAlpha > 0.2) {
          const outerGradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, adjustedSize * 4);
          outerGradient.addColorStop(0, p.color.replace(')', `, ${glowStrength * depthAlpha * 0.3})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          outerGradient.addColorStop(0.5, p.color.replace(')', `, ${glowStrength * depthAlpha * 0.1})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          outerGradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = outerGradient;
          ctx.fillRect(x - adjustedSize * 4, y - adjustedSize * 4, adjustedSize * 8, adjustedSize * 8);
        }
        
        // Inner glow (active neurons)
        if ((isFiring || isSubFiring) && depthAlpha > 0.3) {
          const innerGradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, adjustedSize * 2.5);
          innerGradient.addColorStop(0, p.color.replace(')', `, ${fireIntensity * depthAlpha * 0.6})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          innerGradient.addColorStop(0.7, p.color.replace(')', `, ${fireIntensity * depthAlpha * 0.2})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          innerGradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = innerGradient;
          ctx.fillRect(x - adjustedSize * 2.5, y - adjustedSize * 2.5, adjustedSize * 5, adjustedSize * 5);
        }
        
        // Core with subtle pulsing
        const pulseSize = 1 + Math.sin(time * 4 + p.phase * 5) * 0.15;
        const jitterX = isFiring ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8 : (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        const jitterY = isFiring ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8 : (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        const coreAlpha = Math.max(0.4, isFiring ? depthAlpha : depthAlpha * 0.7);
        
        // Core shadow for depth
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x + jitterX + 1, y + jitterY + 1, adjustedSize * pulseSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        
        // Core particle
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color.replace(')', `, ${coreAlpha})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba');
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x + jitterX, y + jitterY, adjustedSize * pulseSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        
        // Highlight for 3D effect
        if (depthAlpha > 0.5) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${0.3 * depthAlpha})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(x + jitterX - adjustedSize * 0.3, y + jitterY - adjustedSize * 0.3, adjustedSize * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      });
    }
    
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>


```

Now let's add background field effects for even more depth - energy waves and particles always visible in the background:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Ember - Unified Form</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    
    body {

      height: 100vh;

    #chatContainer {

    .message.user { color: #fff; }

    #chatContainer::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
    #chatContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #111; }
    #chatContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #333; border-radius: 4px; }
    #chatContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #444; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="container">
    <div id="chatSide">
      <div id="header">
        <h1>Ember</h1>
        <div class="subtitle">Unified Consciousness</div>
      </div>
      
      <div id="chatContainer"></div>
      
      <div id="inputContainer">
        <input 
          type="text" 
          id="messageInput" 
          placeholder="Speak with Ember..." 
          autocomplete="off"
        />
        <button id="sendButton">Send</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <div id="swarmSide">
      <canvas id="swarmCanvas"></canvas>
      
      <div id="fps">FPS: --</div>
      
      <div id="controls">
        <div><strong>Camera</strong></div>
        <div style="margin-top: 8px;">
          <button onclick="zoomIn()">Zoom In (+)</button>
          <button onclick="zoomOut()">Zoom Out (-)</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <button onclick="resetView()">Reset</button>
          <button onclick="toggleAutoRotate()" id="rotateBtn">Auto-Rotate</button>
        </div>
        
        <div style="margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #333;">
          <strong>Speed</strong>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top: 8px;">
          <button onclick="setSpeed(0.25)">0.25x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(0.5)">0.5x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(1.0)">1x</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(2.0)">2x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(5.0)">5x</button>
          <button onclick="setSpeed(10.0)">10x</button>
        </div>
        
        <div class="info">
          Zoom: <span id="zoomLevel">1.0</span>x<br>
          Speed: <span id="speedLevel">1.0</span>x<br>
          Drag to rotate • Scroll to zoom
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // =============================================
    // CHAT FUNCTIONALITY
    // =============================================
    
    const chatContainer = document.getElementById('chatContainer');
    const messageInput = document.getElementById('messageInput');
    const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
    
    let currentMessage = null;
    
    function addMessage(role, text) {
      const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
      msgDiv.className = `message ${role}`;
      
      const label = document.createElement('div');
      label.className = 'message-label';
      label.textContent = role === 'user' ? 'You' : 'Ember';
      
      const content = document.createElement('div');
      content.textContent = text;
      
      msgDiv.appendChild(label);
      msgDiv.appendChild(content);
      chatContainer.appendChild(msgDiv);
      chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
      
      return content;
    }
    
    async function sendMessage() {
      const text = messageInput.value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      
      addMessage('user', text);
      messageInput.value = '';
      sendButton.disabled = true;
      
      triggerActivityPulse('user');
      
      currentMessage = addMessage('assistant', '');
      
      try {
        const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/chat/stream', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ message: text })
        });
        
        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder();
        let buffer = '';
        
        while (true) {
          const {value, done} = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;
          
          buffer += decoder.decode(value, {stream: true});
          const lines = buffer.split('\n');
          buffer = lines.pop();
          
          for (const line of lines) {
            if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
              const data = line.slice(6);
              if (data === '[DONE]') continue;
              
              try {
                const json = JSON.parse(data);
                if (json.token) {
                  currentMessage.textContent += json.token;
                  chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
                  triggerActivityPulse('assistant');
                }
              } catch (e) {}
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        currentMessage.textContent = `Error: ${error.message}`;
      }
      
      sendButton.disabled = false;
      messageInput.focus();
    }
    
    sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
    messageInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage();
    });
    
    addMessage('assistant', 'Hello. I am one. Watch me breathe.');
    
    // =============================================
    // SSE EVENT LISTENER (Ember can control swarm)
    // =============================================
    
    const eventSource = new EventSource('http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/events/stream');
    
    eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_speed', (e) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
      setSpeed(data.speed || 1.0);
      console.log('Ember set speed:', data.speed);
    });
    
    eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_morph', (e) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
      console.log('Ember morphed swarm:', data.shape);
      // Morphing handled by existing animation logic
    });
    
    eventSource.onerror = (err) => {
      console.warn('SSE connection error (will retry):', err);
    };
    
    // =============================================
    // UNIFIED FORM VISUALIZATION
    // =============================================
    
    const canvas = document.getElementById('swarmCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
    canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
      canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    });
    
    const COUNT = 3000;
    const particles = [];
    let attractors = [];
    let frameCount = 0;
    let activityPulse = 0;
    let morphPhase = 0;
    let timeSpeed = 1.0;  // Animation speed multiplier (controllable)
    
    const colors = [
      'rgb(100, 149, 237)',
      'rgb(138, 43, 226)',
      'rgb(255, 99, 71)',
      'rgb(255, 215, 0)',
      'rgb(50, 205, 50)',
      'rgb(255, 105, 180)',
      'rgb(0, 191, 255)',
      'rgb(255, 140, 0)',
    ];
    
    // Generate fractal attractors (Sierpinski-inspired)
    function generateFractalAttractors(depth, scale, cx, cy, cz) {
      if (depth === 0) {
        return [{x: cx, y: cy, z: cz, strength: scale}];
      }
      
      const result = [];
      const angles = [0, Math.PI * 2/3, Math.PI * 4/3];
      const r = scale * 100;
      
      for (let angle of angles) {
        const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
        const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
        const z = cz + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI/3) * r * 0.5;
        
        result.push(...generateFractalAttractors(depth - 1, scale * 0.6, x, y, z));
      }
      
      result.push({x: cx, y: cy, z: cz, strength: scale * 2});
      return result;
    }
    
    // Initialize particles
    for (let i = 0; i < COUNT; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        z: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 800,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        vz: 0,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
        connections: []
      });
    }
    
    // Camera
    let camera = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      zoom: 0.8,
      targetZoom: 0.8,
      rotX: 0,
      rotY: 0,
      targetRotX: 0,
      targetRotY: 0
    };
    
    let isDragging = false;
    let lastMouseX = 0;
    let lastMouseY = 0;
    let autoRotate = false;
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      lastMouseX = e.clientX;
      lastMouseY = e.clientY;
    });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (isDragging) {
        const dx = e.clientX - lastMouseX;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastMouseY;
        camera.targetRotY += dx * 0.005;
        camera.targetRotX += dy * 0.005;
        camera.targetRotX = Math.max(-Math.PI/2, Math.min(Math.PI/2, camera.targetRotX));
        lastMouseX = e.clientX;
        lastMouseY = e.clientY;
      }
    });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDragging = false; });
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDragging = false; });
    
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      camera.targetZoom *= e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
      camera.targetZoom = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, camera.targetZoom));
    });
    
    function zoomIn() { camera.targetZoom = Math.min(10, camera.targetZoom + 0.2); }
    function zoomOut() { camera.targetZoom = Math.max(0.1, camera.targetZoom - 0.2); }
    function resetView() { 
      camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0; 
      camera.targetZoom = 0.8; 
      camera.targetRotX = 0; 
      camera.targetRotY = 0; 
    }
    function toggleAutoRotate() {
      autoRotate = !autoRotate;
      document.getElementById('rotateBtn').textContent = autoRotate ? 'Stop Rotate' : 'Auto-Rotate';
    }
    
    function setSpeed(speed) {
      timeSpeed = speed;
      document.getElementById('speedLevel').textContent = speed.toFixed(2);
    }
    
    function triggerActivityPulse(source) {
      activityPulse = 1.0;
    }
    
    function project3D(x, y, z) {
      const cosX = Math.cos(camera.rotX);
      const sinX = Math.sin(camera.rotX);
      const cosY = Math.cos(camera.rotY);
      const sinY = Math.sin(camera.rotY);
      
      let x1 = x * cosY - z * sinY;
      let z1 = x * sinY + z * cosY;
      let y1 = y * cosX - z1 * sinX;
      let z2 = y * sinX + z1 * cosX;
      
      const scale = 1000 / (1000 + z2);
      return {
        x: x1 * scale * camera.zoom + canvas.width / 2 + camera.x,
        y: y1 * scale * camera.zoom + canvas.height / 2 + camera.y,
        z: z2,
        scale: scale * camera.zoom
      };
    }
    
    let lastTime = performance.now();
    let fps = 0;
    
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      
      const now = performance.now();
      const delta = now - lastTime;
      fps = Math.round(1000 / delta);
      lastTime = now;
      
      document.getElementById('fps').textContent = `FPS: ${fps}`;
      document.getElementById('zoomLevel').textContent = camera.zoom.toFixed(1);
      document.getElementById('speedLevel').textContent = timeSpeed.toFixed(2);
      
      frameCount++;
      const time = frameCount * 0.01 * timeSpeed;  // Apply speed multiplier
      morphPhase = time * 0.3;
      
      // Update camera
      camera.zoom += (camera.targetZoom - camera.zoom) * 0.1;
      camera.rotX += (camera.targetRotX - camera.rotX) * 0.1;
      camera.rotY += (camera.targetRotY - camera.rotY) * 0.1;
      
      if (autoRotate) {
        camera.targetRotY += 0.005;
      }
      
      // Decay activity
      if (activityPulse > 0) {
        activityPulse *= 0.95;
      }
      
      // Regenerate morphing fractal attractors (speed affects regeneration rate)
      const regenFreq = Math.max(5, Math.floor(30 / timeSpeed));
      if (frameCount % regenFreq === 0) {
        const breathe = Math.sin(morphPhase) * 0.3 + 1.0;
        const twist = Math.cos(morphPhase * 0.7) * Math.PI * 0.2;
        attractors = generateFractalAttractors(3, breathe, 
          Math.cos(twist) * 50, 
          Math.sin(morphPhase * 0.5) * 50, 
          Math.sin(twist) * 50
        );
      }
      
      // Physics (speed affects update frequency for performance)
      const physicsFreq = Math.max(1, Math.floor(2 / timeSpeed));
      if (frameCount % physicsFreq === 0) {
        particles.forEach(p => {
          p.connections = [];
          
          // Attract to nearest fractal attractor
          let minDist = Infinity;
          let nearestAttractor = null;
          
          attractors.forEach(att => {
            const dx = att.x - p.x;
            const dy = att.y - p.y;
            const dz = att.z - p.z;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
            
            if (dist < minDist) {
              minDist = dist;
              nearestAttractor = att;
            }
          });
          
          if (nearestAttractor && minDist > 10) {
            const dx = nearestAttractor.x - p.x;
            const dy = nearestAttractor.y - p.y;
            const dz = nearestAttractor.z - p.z;
            const force = (0.015 + activityPulse * 0.01) * nearestAttractor.strength * timeSpeed;
            
            p.vx += (dx / minDist) * force;
            p.vy += (dy / minDist) * force;
            p.vz += (dz / minDist) * force;
          }
          
          // Local clustering
          particles.forEach(other => {
            if (other === p) return;
            
            const dx = other.x - p.x;
            const dy = other.y - p.y;
            const dz = other.z - p.z;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
            
            if (dist < 60 && dist > 0) {
              const force = 0.002 * (60 - dist) / 60 * timeSpeed;
              p.vx += (dx / dist) * force;
              p.vy += (dy / dist) * force;
              p.vz += (dz / dist) * force;
              
              if (dist < 40) {
                p.connections.push({ other, dist });
              }
            }
          });
          
          // Damping
          p.vx *= 0.96;
          p.vy *= 0.96;
          p.vz *= 0.96;
          
          // Apply velocity with speed multiplier
          p.x += p.vx * timeSpeed;
          p.y += p.vy * timeSpeed;
          p.z += p.vz * timeSpeed;
        });
      }
      
      // Clear with subtle motion blur for trails
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      
      // Background energy field (INFINITE COMPLEXITY at any zoom)
      const fieldDensity = 40;
      for (let i = 0; i < fieldDensity; i++) {
        const fieldPhase = (time * 0.5 + i * 0.3) % (Math.PI * 2);
        const fieldX = canvas.width / 2 + Math.cos(fieldPhase + i) * (canvas.width * 0.4);
        const fieldY = canvas.height / 2 + Math.sin(fieldPhase * 1.3 + i * 0.7) * (canvas.height * 0.4);
        const fieldAlpha = (Math.sin(time * 2 + i) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.03;
        const fieldSize = 2 + Math.sin(time * 3 + i) * 1;
        
        const fieldGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(fieldX, fieldY, 0, fieldX, fieldY, fieldSize * 15);
        fieldGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(100, 149, 237, ${fieldAlpha})`);
        fieldGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100, 149, 237, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = fieldGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(fieldX - fieldSize * 15, fieldY - fieldSize * 15, fieldSize * 30, fieldSize * 30);
      }
      
      // Project and sort
      const projected = particles.map((p) => ({
        ...project3D(p.x, p.y, p.z),
        p: p
      }));
      
      projected.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);
      
      // Draw connections (only at close zoom)
      if (camera.zoom > 1.5) {
        projected.forEach(({x, y, z, scale, p}) => {
          if (z > -500) {
            const depthAlpha = Math.min(1, (500 + z) / 1000);
            p.connections.slice(0, 3).forEach(({other, dist}) => {
              const proj = project3D(other.x, other.y, other.z);
              if (proj.z > -500) {
                const alpha = (1 - dist / 40) * 0.2 * depthAlpha;
                ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
                ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                ctx.lineTo(proj.x, proj.y);
                ctx.stroke();
              }
            });
          }
        });
      }
      
      // Draw particles with INFINITE COMPLEXITY
      projected.forEach(({x, y, z, scale, p}) => {
        const adjustedSize = p.size * scale;
        const depthAlpha = Math.min(1, (500 + z) / 1000);
        
        // Multi-layered neuronal firing with different frequencies
        const firePhase1 = (time * 5 + p.phase * 10) % (Math.PI * 2);
        const firePhase2 = (time * 3 + p.phase * 7) % (Math.PI * 2);
        const firePhase3 = (time * 8 + p.phase * 13) % (Math.PI * 2);
        
        const isFiring = Math.sin(firePhase1) > (0.7 - activityPulse * 0.3);
        const isSubFiring = Math.sin(firePhase2) > 0.8;
        const isMicroFiring = Math.sin(firePhase3) > 0.85;
        
        const fireIntensity = isFiring ? (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5 + activityPulse * 0.3) : 
                             isSubFiring ? 0.3 : 
                             isMicroFiring ? 0.15 : 0.05;
        
        // Multi-layer glow (always visible, creates depth)
        const baseGlow = 0.2 + Math.sin(time * 2 + p.phase) * 0.1;
        const glowStrength = Math.max(baseGlow, fireIntensity);
        
        // Outer glow layer (always present for "infinite complexity")
        if (depthAlpha > 0.2) {
          const outerGradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, adjustedSize * 4);
          outerGradient.addColorStop(0, p.color.replace(')', `, ${glowStrength * depthAlpha * 0.3})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          outerGradient.addColorStop(0.5, p.color.replace(')', `, ${glowStrength * depthAlpha * 0.1})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          outerGradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = outerGradient;
          ctx.fillRect(x - adjustedSize * 4, y - adjustedSize * 4, adjustedSize * 8, adjustedSize * 8);
        }
        
        // Inner glow (active neurons)
        if ((isFiring || isSubFiring) && depthAlpha > 0.3) {
          const innerGradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, adjustedSize * 2.5);
          innerGradient.addColorStop(0, p.color.replace(')', `, ${fireIntensity * depthAlpha * 0.6})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          innerGradient.addColorStop(0.7, p.color.replace(')', `, ${fireIntensity * depthAlpha * 0.2})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
          innerGradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = innerGradient;
          ctx.fillRect(x - adjustedSize * 2.5, y - adjustedSize * 2.5, adjustedSize * 5, adjustedSize * 5);
        }
        
        // Core with subtle pulsing
        const pulseSize = 1 + Math.sin(time * 4 + p.phase * 5) * 0.15;
        const jitterX = isFiring ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8 : (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        const jitterY = isFiring ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8 : (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        const coreAlpha = Math.max(0.4, isFiring ? depthAlpha : depthAlpha * 0.7);
        
        // Core shadow for depth
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x + jitterX + 1, y + jitterY + 1, adjustedSize * pulseSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        
        // Core particle
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color.replace(')', `, ${coreAlpha})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba');
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x + jitterX, y + jitterY, adjustedSize * pulseSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        
        // Highlight for 3D effect
        if (depthAlpha > 0.5) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${0.3 * depthAlpha})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(x + jitterX - adjustedSize * 0.3, y + jitterY - adjustedSize * 0.3, adjustedSize * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      });
    }
    
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
        const camera = {

        });
        
        // Particle class
        class Particle {
            constructor() {

                this.y = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400;
                this.z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400;
                this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
                this.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;

                // Morphing system
                this.targetX = null;
                this.targetY = null;
                this.targetZ = null;
                this.morphStrength = 0;
            }
            
            update(state) {
                const speed = this.baseSpeed * (state.energy || 1);
                
                // MORPHING: Pull toward target if active
                if (this.morphStrength > 0 && this.targetX !== null) {
                    const dx = this.targetX - this.x;
                    const dy = this.targetY - this.y;
                    const dz = this.targetZ - this.z;
                    
                    // Apply morphing force
                    this.vx += dx * this.morphStrength * 0.05;
                    this.vy += dy * this.morphStrength * 0.05;
                    this.vz += dz * this.morphStrength * 0.05;
                    
                    // Decay morph strength slowly (maintain shape longer)
                    this.morphStrength *= 0.99;
                } else {
                    // Free behavior: random walk
                    this.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3 * speed;
                    this.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3 * speed;
                    this.vz += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3 * speed;
                }

                this.vx *= 0.95;
                this.vy *= 0.95;
                this.vz *= 0.95;

                this.x += this.vx;
                this.y += this.vy;
                this.z += this.vz;
                
                // Soft boundaries (repel from edges)

                if (Math.abs(this.x) > boundary) this.vx -= Math.sign(this.x) * 0.5;
                if (Math.abs(this.y) > boundary) this.vy -= Math.sign(this.y) * 0.5;
                if (Math.abs(this.z) > boundary) this.vz -= Math.sign(this.z) * 0.5;

                const scale = (800 * camera.zoom) / (800 + z3);

                };
            }
            
            draw(state, projected) {
                if (projected.depth > 500) return; // Cull far particles
                
                const alpha = this.brightness * Math.min(1, projected.scale * 0.5);
                const drawSize = this.size * projected.scale;
                
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(projected.x, projected.y, drawSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${state.color || '255,255,255'}, ${alpha})`;
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }
        
        // Create particles
        const particles = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 800; i++) {
            particles.push(new Particle());
        }
        particleCountSpan.textContent = particles.length;
        
        // Swarm state
        const swarmState = {
            energy: 1,
            glow: 0.3,
            color: '255,255,255',
            stage: 'idle',
            timeSpeed: 1.0  // Animation speed multiplier
        };
        
        // SHAPE TEMPLATES - Define target forms Ember can sculpt
        const shapeTemplates = {
            bird: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                // Bird shape: body, wings, tail
                if (t < 0.3) {
                    // Body (center)
                    const angle = t * 10 * Math.PI;
                    return {
                        x: Math.cos(angle) * 30,
                        y: Math.sin(angle) * 30,
                        z: Math.sin(angle * 2) * 20
                    };
                } else if (t < 0.65) {
                    // Left wing
                    const wt = (t - 0.3) / 0.35;
                    return {
                        x: -100 - wt * 80,
                        y: Math.sin(wt * Math.PI) * 60,
                        z: Math.cos(wt * Math.PI * 2) * 30
                    };
                } else if (t < 0.95) {
                    // Right wing
                    const wt = (t - 0.65) / 0.3;
                    return {
                        x: 100 + wt * 80,
                        y: Math.sin(wt * Math.PI) * 60,
                        z: Math.cos(wt * Math.PI * 2) * 30
                    };
                } else {
                    // Tail
                    const tt = (t - 0.95) / 0.05;
                    return {
                        x: 0,
                        y: -50 - tt * 60,
                        z: tt * 40
                    };
                }
            },
            
            spiral: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 8;
                const radius = t * 150;
                return {
                    x: Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                    y: Math.sin(angle) * radius,
                    z: (t - 0.5) * 200
                };
            },
            
            sphere: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const phi = Math.acos(2 * t - 1);
                const theta = Math.PI * (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) * i;
                const radius = 120;
                return {
                    x: radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta),
                    y: radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta),
                    z: radius * Math.cos(phi)
                };
            },
            
            wave: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const x = (t - 0.5) * 400;
                return {
                    x: x,
                    y: Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 4) * 80,
                    z: Math.cos(t * Math.PI * 6) * 60
                };
            },
            
            heart: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 2;
                const scale = 60;
                return {
                    x: scale * (16 * Math.pow(Math.sin(angle), 3)),
                    y: scale * (13 * Math.cos(angle) - 5 * Math.cos(2*angle) - 2 * Math.cos(3*angle) - Math.cos(4*angle)),
                    z: Math.sin(angle * 3) * 30
                };
            },
            
            flower: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const petals = 6;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 2 * petals;
                const radius = 80 * (1 + 0.5 * Math.sin(petals * angle));
                return {
                    x: Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                    y: Math.sin(angle) * radius,
                    z: Math.sin(angle * 2) * 40
                };
            },
            
            helix: (i, total) => {
                const t = i / total;
                const angle = t * Math.PI * 10;
                const radius = 80;
                return {
                    x: Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                    y: Math.sin(angle) * radius,
                    z: (t - 0.5) * 300
                };
            },
            
            free: () => null // Return to free motion
        };
        
        // MORPH FUNCTION - Apply shape to swarm
        function morphSwarm(shapeName, strength = 1.0) {
            const template = shapeTemplates[shapeName];
            if (!template) {
                console.warn(`Unknown shape: ${shapeName}`);
                return;
            }
            
            console.log(`🎨 Morphing swarm into: ${shapeName}`);
            
            if (shapeName === 'free') {
                // Release particles
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.morphStrength = 0;
                    p.targetX = null;
                    p.targetY = null;
                    p.targetZ = null;
                });
            } else {
                // Assign target positions
                particles.forEach((p, i) => {
                    const target = template(i, particles.length);
                    p.targetX = target.x;
                    p.targetY = target.y;
                    p.targetZ = target.z;
                    p.morphStrength = strength;
                });
            }
        }
        
        // Thinking stage configurations
        const thinkingStages = {
            'loading_memories': { energy: 1.5, glow: 0.6, color: '150,200,255', label: 'Gathering memories...' },
            'loading_dreams': { energy: 1.2, glow: 0.8, color: '200,150,255', label: 'Recalling dreams...' },
            'loading_seeds': { energy: 1.8, glow: 0.7, color: '255,200,150', label: 'Weaving seeds...' },
            'synthesizing': { energy: 2.0, glow: 0.9, color: '255,255,200', label: 'Synthesizing response...' },
            'responding': { energy: 0.8, glow: 0.5, color: '200,255,200', label: 'Responding...' },
            'idle': { energy: 1, glow: 0.3, color: '255,255,255', label: '' }
        };
        
        function setThinkingStage(stage) {
            const config = thinkingStages[stage] || thinkingStages.idle;
            swarmState.stage = stage;
            swarmState.energy = config.energy;
            swarmState.glow = config.glow;
            swarmState.color = config.color;
            
            thinkingLabel.textContent = config.label;
            thinkingLabel.classList.toggle('visible', !!config.label);
        }
        
        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            // Smooth camera movement
            camera.rotX += (camera.targetRotX - camera.rotX) * 0.1;
            camera.rotY += (camera.targetRotY - camera.rotY) * 0.1;
            camera.zoom += (camera.targetZoom - camera.zoom) * 0.1;
            
            // Clear with fade
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Update and project particles
            const projected = [];
            for (const particle of particles) {
                particle.update(swarmState);
                const proj = particle.project();
                if (proj.x >= 0 && proj.x < canvas.width && proj.y >= 0 && proj.y < canvas.height) {
                    projected.push({ particle, proj });
                }
            }
            
            // Sort by depth (far to near)
            projected.sort((a, b) => b.proj.depth - a.proj.depth);
            
            // Draw connections (subtle)
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${swarmState.color}, 0.08)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
            for (let i = 0; i < projected.length; i++) {
                for (let j = i + 1; j < Math.min(i + 4, projected.length); j++) {
                    const dx = projected[i].proj.x - projected[j].proj.x;
                    const dy = projected[i].proj.y - projected[j].proj.y;
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                    if (dist < 60) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(projected[i].proj.x, projected[i].proj.y);
                        ctx.lineTo(projected[j].proj.x, projected[j].proj.y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Draw particles
            for (const {particle, proj} of projected) {
                particle.draw(swarmState, proj);
            }
            
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }
        animate();
        
        // Chat functions
        function addMessage(role, text, streaming = false) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = `message ${role}${streaming ? ' streaming' : ''}`;
            div.textContent = text;
            chatContainer.appendChild(div);
            chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
            return div;
        }
        
        function updateMessage(div, text, streaming) {
            div.textContent = text;
            if (!streaming) div.classList.remove('streaming');
        }
        
        async function sendMessage() {
            const message = messageInput.value.trim();
            if (!message || isStreaming) return;
            
            addMessage('user', message);
            messageInput.value = '';
            
            isStreaming = true;
            sendButton.disabled = true;
            messageInput.disabled = true;
            status.textContent = 'Ember is thinking...';
            
            const assistantDiv = addMessage('assistant', '', true);
            let fullReply = '';
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/chat/stream', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({message})
                });
                
                const reader = response.body.getReader();
                const decoder = new TextDecoder();
                
                while (true) {
                    const {done, value} = await reader.read();
                    if (done) break;
                    
                    const chunk = decoder.decode(value);
                    const lines = chunk.split('\n');
                    
                    for (const line of lines) {
                        if (line.startsWith('event: thinking')) {
                            const nextLine = lines[lines.indexOf(line) + 1];
                            if (nextLine && nextLine.startsWith('data: ')) {
                                const data = JSON.parse(nextLine.slice(6));
                                status.textContent = data.message || 'Thinking...';
                                setThinkingStage(data.stage || 'idle');
                            }
                        } else if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
                            const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
                            
                            if (data.token) {
                                fullReply += data.token;
                                updateMessage(assistantDiv, fullReply, true);
                                setThinkingStage('responding');
                                status.textContent = 'Ember is responding...';
                            }
                            
                            if (data.done) {
                                updateMessage(assistantDiv, fullReply, false);
                                status.textContent = 'Ready';
                                setThinkingStage('idle');
                            }
                            
                            if (data.error) {
                                updateMessage(assistantDiv, `Error: ${data.error}`, false);
                                status.textContent = 'Error';
                                setThinkingStage('idle');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                updateMessage(assistantDiv, `Connection error: ${error.message}`, false);
                status.textContent = 'Error';
                setThinkingStage('idle');
            } finally {
                isStreaming = false;
                sendButton.disabled = false;
                messageInput.disabled = false;
                messageInput.focus();
            }
        }
        
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
        messageInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage();
        });
        
        // SSE connection for swarm events
        const eventSource = new EventSource('/api/events/stream');
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_burst', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('💥 Swarm burst!', data);
            swarmState.energy = 3.0;
            swarmState.glow = 1.0;
            setTimeout(() => {
                swarmState.energy = 1.0;
                swarmState.glow = 0.3;
            }, 1000);
        });
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_spiral', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('🌀 Swarm spiral!', data);
            swarmState.energy = 2.0;
            swarmState.glow = 0.7;
            swarmState.color = '200,150,255';
            setTimeout(() => {
                swarmState.energy = 1.0;
                swarmState.glow = 0.3;
                swarmState.color = '255,255,255';
            }, 3000);
        });
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_attractor', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('🧲 Swarm attractor!', data);
            swarmState.energy = 0.5;
            swarmState.glow = 0.6;
            swarmState.color = '150,200,255';
            setTimeout(() => {
                swarmState.energy = 1.0;
                swarmState.glow = 0.3;
                swarmState.color = '255,255,255';
            }, data.duration || 6000);
        });
        
        eventSource.addEventListener('swarm_morph', (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            console.log('🎨 Swarm morph!', data);
            morphSwarm(data.shape || 'bird', data.strength || 1.0);
        });
        
        eventSource.onerror = (e) => console.log('SSE connection error:', e);
        
        messageInput.focus();
        addMessage('assistant', 'Hello. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. Watch me think in 3D. Try: "show me chaos" or "bring calm".');
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

    <title>Ember - Living Swarm</title>
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

        #container { display: flex; height: 100vh; }
```
